text_mt: For one desirous of spiritual lustre, three [oblations are made] with the Great Vyāhṛtis.

sanskrit_iast: yāḥ srucy āpas traidham tāḥ karoty agnihotra sthālyām gārhapatyasya paścād añjalau ca patnyāḥ |
meaning: याः स्रुच्य् आपस् त्रैधम् ताः करोत्य् अग्निहोत्र स्थाल्याम् गार्हपत्यस्य पश्चाद् अञ्जलौ च पत्न्याः ।
text_mt: The water that is in the sruc he divides into three parts: in the Agnihotra pot, behind the Gārhapatya, and in the folded hands of the wife.

sanskrit_iast: sam tvā sṛjāmi prajayā dhanena ity añjalau |
meaning: सम् त्वा सृजामि प्रजया धनेन इत्य् अञ्जलौ ।
text_mt: Into the folded hands [of the wife], with: 'I unite you with offspring, with wealth.'
Having heated the sruc-ladle, he sets it down.
The standard duties of the sacrificer are to the south.

sanskrit_iast: upa prayanto adhvaram ayam agniḥ sahasriṇa ubhā vām ayam te yonir ayam iha asya pratnām iti ṣaṇṇām triḥ prathamām uttamām ca |
meaning: उप प्रयन्तो अध्वरम् अयम् अग्निः सहस्रिण उभा वाम् अयम् ते योनिर् अयम् इह अस्य प्रत्नाम् इति षण्णाम् त्रिः प्रथमाम् उत्तमाम् च ।
text_mt: Of the six verses beginning with 'Approaching the sacrifice', 'This Agni, possessing a thousand', 'Both of you', 'This is your place of origin', 'This one here', and 'His ancient [path]', [he recites] the first and the last three times.

sanskrit_iast: āyurdā agne asya āyur me dehi varcodā agne asi varco me dehi tanūpā agne asi tanvam me pāhy agne yan ma ūnam tanvas tan ma ā pṛṇa | indhānās tvā śatam himā dyumantam samidhīmahi | vayasvanto vayas kṛtam sahasvantaḥ sahas kṛtam | agne sapatna dambhanam adabdhāso adābhyam | iti japitvā |
meaning: आयुर्दा अग्ने अस्य आयुर् मे देहि वर्चोदा अग्ने असि वर्चो मे देहि तनूपा अग्ने असि तन्वम् मे पाह्य् अग्ने यन् म ऊनम् तन्वस् तन् म आ पृण । इन्धानास् त्वा शतम् हिमा द्युमन्तम् समिधीमहि । वयस्वन्तो वयस् कृतम् सहस्वन्तः सहस् कृतम् । अग्ने सपत्न दम्भनम् अदब्धासो अदाभ्यम् । इति जपित्वा ।
text_mt: Having murmured: 'Giver of life, O Agni, give life to me; giver of lustre, O Agni, give lustre to me; protector of the body, O Agni, protect my body; O Agni, what of my body is deficient, that fill up for me. Kindling you for a hundred winters, may we kindle you radiant; possessing vigour, [we kindle] the maker of vigour, possessing strength, the maker of strength; O Agni, the destroyer of rivals, uninjured, [we kindle] the uninjurable;'

sanskrit_iast: citra avaso svasti te pāram aśīya iti triḥ |
meaning: चित्र अवसो स्वस्ति ते पारम् अशीय इति त्रिः ।
text_mt: three times: 'O Citrāvasu, may I safely attain your farther shore;'

sanskrit_iast: sam tvam agne sūryasya varcasā āgathāḥ samṛṣīṇām stutena sam ṛṣīṇām stutena sam priyeṇa dhāmnā sam aham āyuṣā sam varcasā sam prajayā sam priyeṇa dhāmnā sam rāyas poṣeṇa ṣīya ity upaviśya |
meaning: सम् त्वम् अग्ने सूर्यस्य वर्चसा आगथाः समृषीणाम् स्तुतेन सम् ऋषीणाम् स्तुतेन सम् प्रियेण धाम्ना सम् अहम् आयुषा सम् वर्चसा सम् प्रजया सम् प्रियेण धाम्ना सम् रायस् पोषेण षीय इत्य् उपविश्य ।
text_mt: and having sat down [with]: 'You, O Agni, have united with the lustre of the sun, with the praise of the ṛṣis, with your dear abode; may I unite with life, with lustre, with offspring, with my dear abode, with increase of wealth;'

sanskrit_iast: ambha sthāmbho vo bhakṣīya maha stha maho vo bhakṣīya ūrja stha ūrjam vo bhakṣīya rāyas poṣa stha rāyas poṣam vo bhakṣīya | revatī ramadhvam asmin yonāv asmiṃl loke asmin goṣṭhe asmin kṣaye asyām āśiṣy asyām pratiṣṭhāyām iha eva stha ito mā apagāta iti gām abhyeti |
meaning: अम्भ स्थाम्भो वो भक्षीय मह स्थ महो वो भक्षीय ऊर्ज स्थ ऊर्जम् वो भक्षीय रायस् पोष स्थ रायस् पोषम् वो भक्षीय । रेवती रमध्वम् अस्मिन् योनाव् अस्मिंल् लोके अस्मिन् गोष्ठे अस्मिन् क्षये अस्याम् आशिष्य् अस्याम् प्रतिष्ठायाम् इह एव स्थ इतो मा अपगात इति गाम् अभ्येति ।
text_mt: he approaches the cow with: 'You are water, may I enjoy your water; you are greatness, may I enjoy your greatness; you are vigor, may I enjoy your vigor; you are increase of wealth, may I enjoy your increase of wealth. Rejoice, O bountiful ones, in this womb, in this world, in this cowpen, in this dwelling, in this blessing, in this foundation; be right here, do not depart hence.'

sanskrit_iast: saṃhitā asi viśva rūpy ūjā mā āviśa gaupatyena ity asyā lalāṭam upaspṛśya |
meaning: संहिता असि विश्व रूप्य् ऊजा मा आविश गौपत्येन इत्य् अस्या ललाटम् उपस्पृश्य ।
text_mt: Having touched her forehead with: 'You are Saṃhitā, possessing all forms; enter into me with vigor, with lordship over cattle;'

sanskrit_iast: upa tvā agna iti tṛcena agne tvam na iti ca dvaipadena gārhapatyam |
meaning: उप त्वा अग्न इति तृचेन अग्ने त्वम् न इति च द्वैपदेन गार्हपत्यम् ।
text_mt: [he attends upon] the Gārhapatya with the triplet 'To you, O Agni' and the two-line stanza 'O Agni, you to us;'

sanskrit_iast: iḷa ehy adita ehi sūnṛta ehi iti gām abhyeti |
meaning: इऌअ एह्य् अदित एहि सूनृत एहि इति गाम् अभ्येति ।
text_mt: he approaches the cow with: 'Come, O Iḷā; come, O Aditi; come, O pleasant speech;'

sanskrit_iast: somānam svaraṇam iti tṛcena uttarato anvāhārya pacanam |
meaning: सोमानम् स्वरणम् इति तृचेन उत्तरतो अन्वाहार्य पचनम् ।
text_mt: [he attends upon] the Anvāhāryapacana from the north with the triplet 'The extractor, the caller;'

sanskrit_iast: antareṇa gārhapatya āhavanīyau māhitram japitvā āhavanīyam upatiṣṭhate |
meaning: अन्तरेण गार्हपत्य आहवनीयौ माहित्रम् जपित्वा आहवनीयम् उपतिष्ठते ।
text_mt: having murmured the Māhitra hymn between the Gārhapatya and the Āhavanīya, he attends upon the Āhavanīya;

sanskrit_iast: tat savitur vareṇyam kadā cana starīr asi pari te dūlabha iti trir etām |
meaning: तत् सवितुर् वरेण्यम् कदा चन स्तरीर् असि परि ते दूलभ इति त्रिर् एताम् ।
text_mt: [he recites] this [verse] three times: 'That excellent [splendour] of Savitṛ', 'Never are you barren', 'Around you, hard to deceive'.

sanskrit_iast: sarveṣu tu juhvan mahā vyāhṛtibhis tisras tisraḥ samidho abhyādadhāty āhavanīye vai eka hāvī |
meaning: सर्वेषु तु जुह्वन् महा व्याहृतिभिस् तिस्रस् तिस्रः समिधो अभ्यादधात्य् आहवनीये वै एक हावी ।
text_mt: Offering on all [fires], however, he places three kindling-sticks on each with the great mystical utterances; or on the Āhavanīya alone if offering on one [fire].

sanskrit_iast: daivas tantur asy anu tvā rabhe mā aham tvad vyavacchitsi ity āhavanīyasya dakṣiṇato aṅgārān upaspṛśya |
meaning: दैवस् तन्तुर् अस्य् अनु त्वा रभे मा अहम् त्वद् व्यवच्छित्सि इत्य् आहवनीयस्य दक्षिणतो अङ्गारान् उपस्पृश्य ।
text_mt: Having touched the embers to the south of the Āhavanīya with: 'You are the divine thread; I take hold of you; may I not be severed from you,'

sanskrit_iast: tato asi tantur asy anu mā saṃtanuhi prajayā paśubhī rāyas poṣeṇa suprajās tvena suvīryeṇa mānuṣas tantur asy anu mā rabhasva mā tvam mad vyavacchitthā asāv iti jyeṣṭhasya putrasya nāma abhivyāhṛtya yāvanto vā bhavanti |
meaning: ततो असि तन्तुर् अस्य् अनु मा संतनुहि प्रजया पशुभी रायस् पोषेण सुप्रजास् त्वेन सुवीर्येण मानुषस् तन्तुर् अस्य् अनु मा रभस्व मा त्वम् मद् व्यवच्छित्था असाव् इति ज्येष्ठस्य पुत्रस्य नाम अभिव्याहृत्य यावन्तो वा भवन्ति ।
text_mt: and having uttered the name of the eldest son, or as many [sons] as there are, with: 'You are stretched; you are the thread; extend me along with offspring, with cattle, with increase of wealth, with good offspring, with manly vigor. You are the human thread; take hold of me; do not be severed from me, N.N.,'

sanskrit_iast: satyena avabhṛtham abhyavaimy apsu vratam ity ācamya vācam visṛjate |
meaning: सत्येन अवभृथम् अभ्यवैम्य् अप्सु व्रतम् इत्य् आचम्य वाचम् विसृजते ।
text_mt: Having sipped water with: 'With truth I go down to the purificatory bath, the observance among the waters,' he releases his speech.

sanskrit_iast: bhūr bhuvaḥ svaḥ suprajāḥ prajābhir bhūyāsam supoṣaḥ poṣaiḥ suvīro vīrair abhayam te abhayam no astu manasā tvā upatiṣṭhe lokam upaimi svaś ca ity āhavanīyam |
meaning: भूर् भुवः स्वः सुप्रजाः प्रजाभिर् भूयासम् सुपोषः पोषैः सुवीरो वीरैर् अभयम् ते अभयम् नो अस्तु मनसा त्वा उपतिष्ठे लोकम् उपैमि स्वश् च इत्य् आहवनीयम् ।
text_mt: [He reveres] the Āhavanīya with: 'Bhūr, bhuvaḥ, svaḥ! May I be rich in offspring through offspring, rich in nourishment through nourishments, rich in heroes through heroes. May there be safety for you, safety for us! With mind I revere you; I enter the world and heaven.'
Standing in that very place, [he reveres] the other two [fires]:

sanskrit_iast: abhayam te abhayam no astu vācā tvā upatiṣṭhe prajām upaimi paśūṃś ca iti gārhapatyam |
meaning: अभयम् ते अभयम् नो अस्तु वाचा त्वा उपतिष्ठे प्रजाम् उपैमि पशूंश् च इति गार्हपत्यम् ।
text_mt: the Gārhapatya with: 'May there be safety for you, safety for us! With speech I revere you; I enter offspring and cattle;'

sanskrit_iast: abhayam te abhayam no astu prāṇena tvā upatiṣṭhe vyānam upaimy āyuś ca ity anvāhārya pacanam |
meaning: अभयम् ते अभयम् नो अस्तु प्राणेन त्वा उपतिष्ठे व्यानम् उपैम्य् आयुश् च इत्य् अन्वाहार्य पचनम् ।
text_mt: the Anvāhāryapacana with: 'May there be safety for you, safety for us! With out-breath I revere you; I enter circulating breath and life-span;'

sanskrit_iast: abhayam vo abhayam no astu kāmena va upatiṣṭhate vittim upaimi bhūtim ca iti sarvān |
meaning: अभयम् वो अभयम् नो अस्तु कामेन व उपतिष्ठते वित्तिम् उपैमि भूतिम् च इति सर्वान् ।
text_mt: all [the fires] with: 'May there be safety for you [all], safety for us! With desire I revere you; I enter acquisition and prosperity.'
[The rest is] identical, from the kindling-stick [rite] up to the release of the observance.
Or [the same procedure applies] both in the evening and in the morning.
Or there is no revering in the morning.

sanskrit_iast: pravatsyann agnīn samīkṣate abhayam vo abhayam no astv iti |
meaning: प्रवत्स्यन्न् अग्नीन् समीक्षते अभयम् वो अभयम् नो अस्त्व् इति ।
text_mt: When about to set out on a journey, he looks at the fires with: 'May there be safety for you, safety for us!'

sanskrit_iast: narya prajām me pāhi mānuṣān mā bhayāt pāhi iti gārhapatyam |
meaning: नर्य प्रजाम् मे पाहि मानुषान् मा भयात् पाहि इति गार्हपत्यम् ।
text_mt: [He looks at] the Gārhapatya with: 'O protector of men, guard my offspring; guard me from human danger!'

sanskrit_iast: atharya pitum me pāhi pitryān mā bhayāt pāhi ity anvāhārya pacanam |
meaning: अथर्य पितुम् मे पाहि पित्र्यान् मा भयात् पाहि इत्य् अन्वाहार्य पचनम् ।
text_mt: [He looks at] the Anvāhāryapacana with: 'O Atharya, guard my food; guard me from danger concerning the ancestors!'

sanskrit_iast: tam uttareṇa gatvā śaṃsya paśūn me pāhi daivān mā bhayāt pāhi ity āhavanīyam |
meaning: तम् उत्तरेण गत्वा शंस्य पशून् मे पाहि दैवान् मा भयात् पाहि इत्य् आहवनीयम् ।
text_mt: Having gone north of it, [he looks at] the Āhavanīya with: 'O praiseworthy one, guard my cattle; guard me from divine danger!'

sanskrit_iast: annam annam iti trīṇi padāny abhyuddhṛtyā sakāśād vāg yamanam |
meaning: अन्नम् अन्नम् इति त्रीणि पदान्य् अभ्युद्धृत्या सकाशाद् वाग् यमनम् ।
text_mt: Taking three steps with: 'Food, food,' [and walking] away from their sight, he restrains his speech.

sanskrit_iast: saṃdhi velayor vā ācamya vācam yatvā punar ācamya mahā vyāhṛtibhir visargaḥ |
meaning: संधि वेलयोर् वा आचम्य वाचम् यत्वा पुनर् आचम्य महा व्याहृतिभिर् विसर्गः ।
text_mt: Or at the two twilight times, having sipped water, restrained his speech, and sipped water again, the release [of speech] is made with the great mystical utterances.

sanskrit_iast: cakṣur viṣaye agnīnām vācam yacchet | proṣyāyan |
meaning: चक्षुर् विषये अग्नीनाम् वाचम् यच्छेत् । प्रोष्यायन् ।
text_mt: Returning from a journey, he should restrain his speech within the range of sight of the fires.
And in that same manner [he performs] the looking [at them].

sanskrit_iast: āganma vṛtra hantamam asmabhyam vasuvittamam | agne saṃrāḷ abhi dyumnam abhi saha ā yacchasva | śaṃsya paśūn me ajugupas tān me pāhy eva daivān mā bhayād ajugupas tasmān mā pāhy eva ity āhavanīyam |
meaning: आगन्म वृत्र हन्तमम् अस्मभ्यम् वसुवित्तमम् । अग्ने संराऌ अभि द्युम्नम् अभि सह आ यच्छस्व । शंस्य पशून् मे अजुगुपस् तान् मे पाह्य् एव दैवान् मा भयाद् अजुगुपस् तस्मान् मा पाह्य् एव इत्य् आहवनीयम् ।
text_mt: [He reveres] the Āhavanīya with: 'We have come to the best slayer of Vṛtra, the best winner of wealth for us. O sovereign Agni, grasp splendour, grasp power! O praiseworthy one, you have guarded my cattle; keep on guarding them for me! You have guarded me from divine danger; keep on guarding me from it!'

sanskrit_iast: tṛṇa apacayanam samid ādhānam ca sarveṣu |
meaning: तृण अपचयनम् समिद् आधानम् च सर्वेषु ।
text_mt: [Then follow] the removing of grass and the placing of a kindling-stick on all [fires].

sanskrit_iast: ayam agniḥ purīṣyo rayimān puṣṭi vardhanaḥ | agne purīṣyā abhi dyumnam abhi saha ā yacchasva | atharya pitum me ajugupsas tam me pāhy eva pitryān mā bhayād ajugupas tasmān mā pāhy eva ity anvāhārya pacanam |
meaning: अयम् अग्निः पुरीष्यो रयिमान् पुष्टि वर्धनः । अग्ने पुरीष्या अभि द्युम्नम् अभि सह आ यच्छस्व । अथर्य पितुम् मे अजुगुप्सस् तम् मे पाह्य् एव पित्र्यान् मा भयाद् अजुगुपस् तस्मान् मा पाह्य् एव इत्य् अन्वाहार्य पचनम् ।
text_mt: [He reveres] the Anvāhāryapacana with: 'This Agni is of the earth-mound, rich in wealth, increaser of nourishment. O Agni of the earth-mound, grasp splendour, grasp power! O Atharya, you have guarded my food; keep on guarding it for me! You have guarded me from danger concerning the ancestors; keep on guarding me from it!'

sanskrit_iast: ayam agnir gṛha patir gārhapatyāt prajāyā vasuvittamaḥ | agne gṛha pate abhi dyumnam abhi saha ā yacchasva | narya prajām me ajugupas tām me pāhy eva mānuṣān mā bhayād ajugupas tan mān mā pāhy eva iti gārhapatyam |
meaning: अयम् अग्निर् गृह पतिर् गार्हपत्यात् प्रजाया वसुवित्तमः । अग्ने गृह पते अभि द्युम्नम् अभि सह आ यच्छस्व । नर्य प्रजाम् मे अजुगुपस् ताम् मे पाह्य् एव मानुषान् मा भयाद् अजुगुपस् तन् मान् मा पाह्य् एव इति गार्हपत्यम् ।
text_mt: [He reveres] the Gārhapatya with: 'This Agni, the master of the house, is from the Gārhapatya the best winner of wealth through offspring. O Agni, master of the house, grasp splendour, grasp power! O protector of men, you have guarded my offspring; keep on guarding them for me! You have guarded me from human danger; keep on guarding me from it!'
Departed [from the sacrificial enclosure], he stays abroad from the fires.

sanskrit_iast: vāstoṣ patīyam dhrauvye daśarātra avara ardhe samprayāteṣu |
meaning: वास्तोष् पतीयम् ध्रौव्ये दशरात्र अवर अर्धे सम्प्रयातेषु ।
text_mt: When they have set out together, the offering to Vāstoṣpati [is performed] for stability during the latter part of a ten-night period.

sanskrit_iast: agniṣṭhasya dakṣiṇe yukta upohya cīvaram vāstoṣ pate pratijānīhi ity anūcya vāstoṣ pate śagmaya iti yajati |
meaning: अग्निष्ठस्य दक्षिणे युक्त उपोह्य चीवरम् वास्तोष् पते प्रतिजानीहि इत्य् अनूच्य वास्तोष् पते शग्मय इति यजति ।
text_mt: Having placed a cloth on the south yoked [draft-animal] of the cart holding the fire, after reciting [the invitatory verse]: 'O Vāstoṣpati, recognize [us],' he recites the offering verse: 'O Vāstoṣpati, an agreeable...'
And when the offering is made, he should abandon [the fire] that was not ritually established.

sanskrit_iast: samārohayamāṇo gārhapatye pāṇī pratitapya prāṇān sammṛśaty ehi me prāṇān āroha iti |
meaning: समारोहयमाणो गार्हपत्ये पाणी प्रतितप्य प्राणान् सम्मृशत्य् एहि मे प्राणान् आरोह इति ।
text_mt: Causing [the fires] to ascend into himself, having warmed his hands over the Gārhapatya, he touches his vital breaths with: 'Come, ascend into my vital breaths.'

sanskrit_iast: sakṛt sakṛn mantreṇa dvir dvis tūṣṇīm |
meaning: सकृत् सकृन् मन्त्रेण द्विर् द्विस् तूष्णीम् ।
text_mt: [He touches each] once with the mantra, twice silently.

sanskrit_iast: ayam te yonir iti vāraṇī pratitapati |
meaning: अयम् ते योनिर् इति वारणी प्रतितपति ।
text_mt: Or he warms the two churning-sticks with: 'This is your birthplace.'

sanskrit_iast: sakṛt sakṛn mantreṇa dvir dvis tūṣṇīm |
meaning: सकृत् सकृन् मन्त्रेण द्विर् द्विस् तूष्णीम् ।
text_mt: [He warms them] once with the mantra, twice silently.
And the churning [takes place] before sunset.

sanskrit_iast: upāvaroha jāta vedaḥ punas tvam devebhyo havyam vaha naḥ prajānan | āyuḥ prajām rayim asmāsu dhehy ariṣṭo dīdihi no duroṇe | ity ātmano araṇyor upāvarohya manthanam |
meaning: उपावरोह जात वेदः पुनस् त्वम् देवेभ्यो हव्यम् वह नः प्रजानन् । आयुः प्रजाम् रयिम् अस्मासु धेह्य् अरिष्टो दीदिहि नो दुरोणे । इत्य् आत्मनो अरण्योर् उपावरोह्य मन्थनम् ।
text_mt: The churning [is performed] after causing [the fire] to descend from himself or from the churning-sticks with: 'Descend, O Jātavedas; again bring our oblation to the gods, knowing [the way]. Bestow upon us life, offspring, and wealth; shine uninjured in our dwelling.'
When the Full Moon sacrifice is concluded, an offering to Indra Vimṛdh [is performed].
'Indra [has seized] the dominion,' and 'Like a fierce beast' [are the verses for Indra Vimṛdh].

sanskrit_iast: juṣṭo damūnā agne śardha iti sviṣṭakṛtaḥ |
meaning: जुष्टो दमूना अग्ने शर्ध इति स्विष्टकृतः ।
text_mt: 'Welcome in the dwelling,' and 'O Agni, the host' are [the verses] for the Sviṣṭakṛt.
When the New Moon sacrifice is concluded, [an offering is performed] to Aditi.
The [verses] for the Sviṣṭakṛt are those of the [offering to Indra] Vimṛdh.

sanskrit_iast: anāgate parvaṇy amāvāsye pravṛtte abhyudita iṣṭiḥ |
meaning: अनागते पर्वण्य् अमावास्ये प्रवृत्ते अभ्युदित इष्टिः ।
text_mt: If the New Moon rite is begun before the New Moon day has arrived, the Abhyuditeṣṭi [offering for sunrise over the rite is performed]

sanskrit_iast: agnaye dātra indrāya pradātre viṣṇave śipiviṣṭāya iti |
meaning: अग्नये दात्र इन्द्राय प्रदात्रे विष्णवे शिपिविष्टाय इति ।
text_mt: to Agni Dātṛ, to Indra Pradātṛ, and to Viṣṇu Śipiviṣṭa.
If knowing this after [the grains] are measured out, he should divide those very [portions].
'O Agni, giver,' and 'O Agni, from the great...' [are the verses for Agni Dātṛ].
'Thousands, hundreds do thou bring...' [and 'Bring us, O Indra...'] [are for Indra Pradātṛ].
The sacrificial fee is a bow and three arrows.

sanskrit_iast: na abhyāvṛttiḥ piṇḍa pitṛ yajñasya asti |
meaning: न अभ्यावृत्तिः पिण्ड पितृ यज्ञस्य अस्ति ।
text_mt: There is no repetition of the Piṇḍapitṛyajña.

sanskrit_iast: atīte parvaṇy amāvāsye pravṛtte abhyuddṛṣṭa iṣṭi |
meaning: अतीते पर्वण्य् अमावास्ये प्रवृत्ते अभ्युद्दृष्ट इष्टि ।
text_mt: If the New Moon rite is begun when the New Moon day has passed, the Abhyuddṛṣṭeṣṭi [offering for moonrise over the rite is performed].
[The offerings are] to Agni Pathikṛt, to Indra Vṛtrahan, [and] to Vaiśvānara.
"For thou knowest, o disposer, the [pathway] of the gods…" [and]
"For the slaying of Vṛtra, [thou didst strike down] Dānu's son…" [are the puronuvākyā and yājyā for the first two].

sanskrit_iast: ṛtāvānam vaiśvānaram ṛtasya jyotiṣas patim | ajasram bhānum īmahe | nābhim yajñānām |
meaning: ऋतावानम् वैश्वानरम् ऋतस्य ज्योतिषस् पतिम् । अजस्रम् भानुम् ईमहे । नाभिम् यज्ञानाम् ।
text_mt: "The righteous Vaiśvānara, master of the light of truth, / the unceasing splendor do we seek, the navel of sacrifices" [is the verse for Vaiśvānara].
The sacrificial fee is a staff and a pair of sandals.
And when [this rite] is concluded, the New Moon sacrifice [is performed].

sanskrit_iast: nābhy āvṛttiḥ piṇḍa pitṛ yajñasya asti |
meaning: नाभ्य् आवृत्तिः पिण्ड पितृ यज्ञस्य अस्ति ।
text_mt: There is no repetition of the Piṇḍapitṛyajña.
[An offering is made] to Agni Agnimat when [fires] are brought forward into one fire after another;

sanskrit_iast: pathi kṛte antareṇa vihāram cakrīvati vṛtte niyata atipattau ca |
meaning: पथि कृते अन्तरेण विहारम् चक्रीवति वृत्ते नियत अतिपत्तौ च ।
text_mt: to [Agni] Pathikṛt when a wheeled carriage passes between the ritual enclosures, or when an established rule is transgressed;
to [Agni] Vīti when [the fires] are mutually commingled;
to [Agni] Saṃvarga when [mingled] with a forest-fire;
to Pūṣan Pathikṛt when one is about to set out on a journey;
to Agni Kāma for someone desiring everything;

sanskrit_iast: vrata pataye vratya velām proṣyā vratyam vā caritvā |
meaning: व्रत पतये व्रत्य वेलाम् प्रोष्या व्रत्यम् वा चरित्वा ।
text_mt: to [Agni] Vratapati having spent the time for observance away from home, or having performed an unvowed act;
to the Maruts when twins are born [to a wife or cow].

sanskrit_iast: agnim agnim havīmabhir agninā agniḥ samidhyate |
meaning: अग्निम् अग्निम् हवीमभिर् अग्निना अग्निः समिध्यते ।
text_mt: "Agni after Agni with invocations…" [and] "Agni is kindled by Agni…" [are the verses for Agni Agnimat];

sanskrit_iast: agna ā yāhi vītaye yo agnim deva vītaye |
meaning: अग्न आ याहि वीतये यो अग्निम् देव वीतये ।
text_mt: "Agni, come to the feast…" [and] "He who [brings] Agni to the feast of gods…" [for Agni Vīti];

sanskrit_iast: kayā no agne vivasas tvām agne mānuṣīḥ |
meaning: कया नो अग्ने विवसस् त्वाम् अग्ने मानुषीः ।
text_mt: "With what [service] dost thou attend upon us, Agni…" [and] "Thee, Agni, human [generations]…" [for Agni Vivici];

sanskrit_iast: kuvit su no mā no asmin mahā dhane |
meaning: कुवित् सु नो मा नो अस्मिन् महा धने ।
text_mt: "Surely to us…" [and] "Do not in this great contest…" [for Agni Saṃvarga];

sanskrit_iast: vayam u tvā pathas pate pathas pathaḥ |
meaning: वयम् उ त्वा पथस् पते पथस् पथः ।
text_mt: "And thee, o Lord of paths…" [and] "Path after path…" [for Pūṣan Pathikṛt];

sanskrit_iast: agniḥ pareṣu dhāmasu kāmo bhūtasya bhavyasya | saṃrāḷ eko vi rājati | aśyāma tam |
meaning: अग्निः परेषु धामसु कामो भूतस्य भव्यस्य । संराऌ एको वि राजति । अश्याम तम् ।
text_mt: "Agni in the highest abodes, desire of what has been and what is to be, / the sole sovereign shines forth; may we attain him" [for Agni Kāma];

sanskrit_iast: tvam agne vratabhṛt śucir agne devān iha ā vaha | upa yajñam haviś ca naḥ | vratāni bibhrad vratapā adābhyo bhavā no dūto ajaraḥ suvīraḥ | dadhar ratnāni sumṛlīko agne gopāya no jīvase jāta vedaḥ |
meaning: त्वम् अग्ने व्रतभृत् शुचिर् अग्ने देवान् इह आ वह । उप यज्ञम् हविश् च नः । व्रतानि बिभ्रद् व्रतपा अदाभ्यो भवा नो दूतो अजरः सुवीरः । दधर् रत्नानि सुमृलीको अग्ने गोपाय नो जीवसे जात वेदः ।
text_mt: "Thou, Agni, vow-bearer, pure, o Agni, bring the gods hither, / unto our sacrifice and oblation. / Upholding the vows, guardian of vows, unassailable, be our youthful, heroic messenger. / Holding treasures, gracious, o Agni Jātavedas, protect us so that we may live" [for Agni Vratabhṛt];

sanskrit_iast: kṛṣṇā rajāṃsi patsutas tve vasūni purvaṇīka hotaḥ |
meaning: कृष्णा रजांसि पत्सुतस् त्वे वसूनि पुर्वणीक होतः ।
text_mt: "The black spaces underfoot…" [and] "In thee, o Hotṛ of many faces, all goods…" [for Agni Kṣāmavat];

sanskrit_iast: marutas tveṣa sadṛśa ā yāta yamāv iva | śubhrā hiraṇya khādayaḥ | vāta tviṣo marutaḥ śriye kam iti vā |
meaning: मरुतस् त्वेष सदृश आ यात यमाव् इव । शुभ्रा हिरण्य खादयः । वात त्विषो मरुतः श्रिये कम् इति वा ।
text_mt: "O Maruts, of flashing appearance, come like twins, / bright, with golden rings…" or "The Maruts of wind-like brilliance for beauty…" [for the Maruts].

sanskrit_iast: jñātayo asaṃvidānā bahu devatām iṣṭim nirvaperan |
meaning: ज्ञातयो असंविदाना बहु देवताम् इष्टिम् निर्वपेरन् ।
text_mt: Kinsmen who are at variance should offer a sacrifice with many deities.

sanskrit_iast: agniḥ prathamo vasubhir no avyāt somo rudrair abhi rakṣatu tmanā | indro ṃrudbhir ṛtuthā kṛṣotv ādityair no varuṇaḥ śarma yaṃsat | sam agnir vasubhir no avyāt sam somo rudriyābhis tanūbhiḥ | sam indro rāta havyo marudbhiḥ sam ādityair varuṇo viśva vedāḥ |
meaning: अग्निः प्रथमो वसुभिर् नो अव्यात् सोमो रुद्रैर् अभि रक्षतु त्मना । इन्द्रो ंरुद्भिर् ऋतुथा कृषोत्व् आदित्यैर् नो वरुणः शर्म यंसत् । सम् अग्निर् वसुभिर् नो अव्यात् सम् सोमो रुद्रियाभिस् तनूभिः । सम् इन्द्रो रात हव्यो मरुद्भिः सम् आदित्यैर् वरुणो विश्व वेदाः ।
text_mt: "May Agni as first protect us with the Vasus; may Soma protect us with the Rudras by himself; / may Indra with the Maruts act in season; may Varuṇa with the Ādityas grant us protection. / Together may Agni protect us with the Vasus; together may Soma with the Rudrian bodies; / together may Indra, to whom oblations are made, with the Maruts; together may all-knowing Varuṇa with the Ādityas" [are the puronuvākyā and yājyā].
And they should murmur [the hymn known as] Saṃjñāna.

sanskrit_iast: agninā rayim gayasphāna ity ājya bhāgau |
meaning: अग्निना रयिम् गयस्फान इत्य् आज्य भागौ ।
text_mt: "[May we win] wealth through Agni…" and "Increaser of the home…" are the two butter-portion verses.

sanskrit_iast: agniḥ somo varuṇo mitra indro bṛhaspatiḥ savitā yaḥ sahasrī | pūṣā no gobhir avasā sarasvatī tvaṣṭā rūpāṇi samanaktu yajñaiḥ | tvaṣṭā rūpāṇi dadhatī sarasvatī pūṣā bhagam savitā me dadātu | bṛhaspatir dadad indro balam me mitraḥ kṣatram varuṇaḥ somo agniḥ |
meaning: अग्निः सोमो वरुणो मित्र इन्द्रो बृहस्पतिः सविता यः सहस्री । पूषा नो गोभिर् अवसा सरस्वती त्वष्टा रूपाणि समनक्तु यज्ञैः । त्वष्टा रूपाणि दधती सरस्वती पूषा भगम् सविता मे ददातु । बृहस्पतिर् ददद् इन्द्रो बलम् मे मित्रः क्षत्रम् वरुणः सोमो अग्निः ।
text_mt: "Agni, Soma, Varuṇa, Mitra, Indra, Bṛhaspati, Savitṛ who possesses thousands, / Pūṣan with cows, Sarasvatī with aid, may Tvaṣṭṛ consecrate the forms through sacrifices. / May Tvaṣṭṛ, conferring forms, Sarasvatī, Pūṣan, Savitṛ grant me fortune; / may Bṛhaspati, granting, Indra [grant] me power, Mitra dominion, Varuṇa, Soma, Agni" [are the puronuvākyā and yājyā].

sanskrit_iast: nū no rāsva sahasravad uta no brahmann aviṣa iti sviṣṭakṛtaḥ |
meaning: नू नो रास्व सहस्रवद् उत नो ब्रह्मन्न् अविष इति स्विष्टकृतः ।
text_mt: "Now grant us a thousandfold…" and "And further, o Priest, protect us…" are [the verses] for the Sviṣṭakṛt [offering].
The sequence of the deities in the insertions is as in the puronuvākyā;
On the Full Moon day of Phālguna is the performance of the non-consecrated sessions;

sanskrit_iast: vasiṣṭha yajñasya amāvāsyāyām sākam prasthāyyasya ca |
meaning: वसिष्ठ यज्ञस्य अमावास्यायाम् साकम् प्रस्थाय्यस्य च ।
text_mt: of the Vasiṣṭhayajña on the New Moon day, and of the Sākamprasthāyya.
Fifteen years [is the duration] of the Dākṣāyaṇayajña;
or one year each for all of them.

sanskrit_iast: na prayuñjānasya nityau darśa pūrṇa māsau vartete |
meaning: न प्रयुञ्जानस्य नित्यौ दर्श पूर्ण मासौ वर्तेते ।
text_mt: The regular New and Full Moon sacrifices do not occur for one performing [any of these].
The Full Moon offerings take place on the preceding day;
the [cake] to Agni and the milk and curd offering to Indra [take place] on the Full Moon day.

sanskrit_iast: apara pakṣam dīkṣita vrato atithibhyo dadāti |
meaning: अपर पक्षम् दीक्षित व्रतो अतिथिभ्यो ददाति ।
text_mt: During the dark half of the month, keeping the vow of an initiate, he gives to guests;

sanskrit_iast: abhyañjana hata avika palpūlitāni na vaste |
meaning: अभ्यञ्जन हत अविक पल्पूलितानि न वस्ते ।
text_mt: He does not wear clothes that are treated with ointment, sheared sheep-wool, or bleached with alkaline water.
He should not reach satiation.

sanskrit_iast: somam rājānam candramasam bhakṣayāmi iti manasā dhyāyann aśnāti |
meaning: सोमम् राजानम् चन्द्रमसम् भक्षयामि इति मनसा ध्यायन्न् अश्नाति ।
text_mt: He eats while meditating in his mind: "I consume King Soma, the Moon."
On the New Moon day, [there is a cake] for Agni and a curd offering for Mitra and Varuṇa.

sanskrit_iast: purā śamyor vākād ūrdhvam vā anāvāhya vājino yajati |
meaning: पुरा शम्योर् वाकाद् ऊर्ध्वम् वा अनावाह्य वाजिनो यजति ।
text_mt: Either before the Śaṃyu formula or after it, without having invoked [them], he recites the offering verse for the Vājins.

sanskrit_iast: uttame prayāje nigacchanti yathā artham ca sūkta vāke |
meaning: उत्तमे प्रयाजे निगच्छन्ति यथा अर्थम् च सूक्त वाके ।
text_mt: They enter at the last fore-offering and appropriately in the Sūktavāka.

sanskrit_iast: vājino devā havir joṣayiṣyante vardhayiṣyante maho jyāyaḥ kariṣyante |
meaning: वाजिनो देवा हविर् जोषयिष्यन्ते वर्धयिष्यन्ते महो ज्यायः करिष्यन्ते ।
text_mt: [The Sūktavāka formula is:] 'The divine Vājins shall enjoy the oblation, shall grow strong, shall make [it] very great.'

sanskrit_iast: śam no bhavantu vājino vāje vāja ity ūrdhvajñur anavānam yajati |
meaning: शम् नो भवन्तु वाजिनो वाजे वाज इत्य् ऊर्ध्वज्ञुर् अनवानम् यजति ।
text_mt: With knees raised, he recites the offering verse in one breath: 'May the Vājins be auspicious to us at the contest' (śam no bhavantu vājino vāje vāje).

sanskrit_iast: vājinasya agne vīhi ity anuvaṣaṭ kāraḥ |
meaning: वाजिनस्य अग्ने वीहि इत्य् अनुवषट् कारः ।
text_mt: The secondary vaṣaṭ-call is: 'O Agni, partake of the whey' (vājinasya agne vīhi).

sanskrit_iast: yajamāno brahmā hotā adhvaryur āgnīdhraś ca samupahūya bhakṣayanti |
meaning: यजमानो ब्रह्मा होता अध्वर्युर् आग्नीध्रश् च समुपहूय भक्षयन्ति ।
text_mt: Having invited one another, the sacrificer, the Brahman, the Hotṛ, the Adhvaryu, and the Āgnīdhra consume [it].
The sacrificer is the first and the last [to partake].

sanskrit_iast: yan me retaḥ pra dhāvati yad vā siktam pra jāyate | rājñā somena tad vayam asmāsu dhārayāmasi | vājo asi vājinam asi vājo mayi dhehi iti bhakṣa mantraḥ |
meaning: यन् मे रेतः प्र धावति यद् वा सिक्तम् प्र जायते । राज्ञा सोमेन तद् वयम् अस्मासु धारयामसि । वाजो असि वाजिनम् असि वाजो मयि धेहि इति भक्ष मन्त्रः ।
text_mt: The formula for consuming is: 'What seed of mine runs forth, or what poured out is generated, / that, through King Soma, we hold fast within ourselves. / You are strength (vāja), you are whey (vājina); bestow strength in me.'

sanskrit_iast: agnīṣomīyaḥ sa upāṃśu yājaḥ sāmnāyyam ca aindram paurṇamāsyām |
meaning: अग्नीषोमीयः स उपांशु याजः साम्नाय्यम् च ऐन्द्रम् पौर्णमास्याम् ।
text_mt: [also] the [cake] for Agni and Soma with the low-voice offering, and the curd and milk offering for Indra on the Full Moon day.
And the vows are those of the Dākṣāyaṇa sacrifice.
[and a cake] for Indra and Agni, [and] a curd offering for Mitra and Varuṇa on the New Moon day.
both sets of oblations [are offered] in a single sacrifice.

sanskrit_iast: arcantas tv asmākam agne adhvaram ity uttarasya āgneyasya |
meaning: अर्चन्तस् त्व् अस्माकम् अग्ने अध्वरम् इत्य् उत्तरस्य आग्नेयस्य ।
text_mt: The verses 'Arcantas tvā' and 'Asmākam agne adhvaram' belong to the second [cake] for Agni.
he performs, however, the Piṇḍapitṛyajña.

sanskrit_iast: na śaunaka yajñe sākam prasthāyye ca vikāro hotum asti |
meaning: न शौनक यज्ञे साकम् प्रस्थाय्ये च विकारो होतुम् अस्ति ।
text_mt: In the Śaunaka sacrifice and in the Sākamprasthāyya there is no modification for the Hotṛ.
By the Sārvaseni sacrifice, the Vasiṣṭha sacrifice is explained.
These are the sessions of the New and Full Moon sacrifices.
And the kindling verses are fifteen in number.
He sacrifices continuously, except on the change of the moon.
They call [this] the Munyayana.
[Oblations] for Agni, for Indra, and for the Viśve Devas;
He sacrifices continuously, except on the change of the moon.
Without having undergone initiation, he puts on a black antelope skin.
They call [this] the Turāyaṇa.

sanskrit_iast: aindrāgna āgnendro vā vaiśvadevo dyāvā pṛthivīyaś ca vrīhi yavānām |
meaning: ऐन्द्राग्न आग्नेन्द्रो वा वैश्वदेवो द्यावा पृथिवीयश् च व्रीहि यवानाम् ।
text_mt: For rice and barley, [the offerings are] for Indra and Agni, or for Agni and Indra, for the Viśve Devas, and for Heaven and Earth.

sanskrit_iast: imam yajñam yā te dhāmāni divi iti |
meaning: इमम् यज्ञम् या ते धामानि दिवि इति ।
text_mt: [The verses for the offering to Soma are] 'Imam yajñam' and 'Yā te dhāmāni divi'.
For the offering to Soma, a honey-mixture is the sacrificial fee.
[For the Viśve Devas:] 'Ā ghā ye' and 'Sukarmāṇaḥ surucaḥ'.
And the offerings for the Viśve Devas and Heaven and Earth are [performed] in a low voice.
A first-born calf is the sacrificial fee.

sanskrit_iast: samāna tantrā vā darśa pūrṇa māsābhyām |
meaning: समान तन्त्रा वा दर्श पूर्ण मासाभ्याम् ।
text_mt: Or it shares the ritual procedure with the New and Full Moon sacrifices.
Or the New and Full Moon sacrifices [themselves are performed] with the new grains.
Or [one performs] the Agnihotra with barley gruel evening and morning.

sanskrit_iast: agnihotrīm vā navān ādayitvā tasyai dugdhena sāyam prātar agnihotram juhuyāt |
meaning: अग्निहोत्रीम् वा नवान् आदयित्वा तस्यै दुग्धेन सायम् प्रातर् अग्निहोत्रम् जुहुयात् ।
text_mt: Or, having fed the Agnihotra cow with the new grains, he should offer the Agnihotra evening and morning with her milk.

sanskrit_iast: gārhapatye vā sthālī pākam śrapayitvā āgrayaṇa devatābhyaḥ sviṣṭakṛc caturthībhyaḥ svāhā kāreṇa āhavanīye juhuyāt |
meaning: गार्हपत्ये वा स्थाली पाकम् श्रपयित्वा आग्रयण देवताभ्यः स्विष्टकृच् चतुर्थीभ्यः स्वाहा कारेण आहवनीये जुहुयात् ।
text_mt: Or, having cooked a domestic mess of boiled rice on the Gārhapatya, he should offer it in the Āhavanīya with the svāhā-call to the deities of the Āgrayaṇa, with Sviṣṭakṛt as the fourth.
The performance of the Cāturmāsyas [takes place] on the Full Moon day of Phālguna.
The sacrifice to Agni Vaiśvānara and Parjanya takes place on the preceding full-moon day.
The [verses] for Parjanya are: "In whose ordinance" (yasya vrate).
On the next [full-moon day] is the Vaiśvadeva [sacrifice].
one to the Maruts with their own power;
The golden-handed one for help (hiraṇyapāṇim ūtaye) [and] Raise up (udīraya) [are the verses for Savitṛ].
And the verses for the churning of fire [are recited] when the oblations have been deposited.

sanskrit_iast: abhi tvā deva savituḥ | mahī dyauḥ | tvām agne puṣkarād iti ca tisraḥ | uta bruvantu jantava iti jātāya | ā yam haste na khādinam iti hastena dhāryamāṇāya | uttare prahriyamāṇāya | agninā agniḥ samidhyate | tvam hy agne agninā | tam marjayanta ity agni manthanīyāḥ |
meaning: अभि त्वा देव सवितुः । मही द्यौः । त्वाम् अग्ने पुष्कराद् इति च तिस्रः । उत ब्रुवन्तु जन्तव इति जाताय । आ यम् हस्ते न खादिनम् इति हस्तेन धार्यमाणाय । उत्तरे प्रह्रियमाणाय । अग्निना अग्निः समिध्यते । त्वम् ह्य् अग्ने अग्निना । तम् मर्जयन्त इत्य् अग्नि मन्थनीयाः ।
text_mt: "Towards thee, divine Savitṛ" (abhi tvā deva savituḥ), "Great is heaven" (mahī dyauḥ), and "Thee, O Agni, from the lotus" (tvām agne puṣkarād iti)—these three [verses]; "And let the creatures say" (uta bruvantu jantavaḥ) when [the fire] is born; "Him who is held in the hand like a ring" (ā yaṃ haste na khādinam) when it is held in the hand; the two following [verses] when it is being carried forward; "By fire is fire kindled" (agninā agniḥ samidhyate), "For thou, O Agni, by fire" (tvaṃ hy agne agninā), [and] "Him they cleansed" (taṃ marjayanta)—these are the verses for the churning of fire.
Between the fourth and the last [there are] four:

sanskrit_iast: duro agna ājyasya vyantu | uṣāsā naktā agna ājyasya vītām | daivyā hotārā agna ājyasya vītām | tisro devīr agna ājyasya vyantu |
meaning: दुरो अग्न आज्यस्य व्यन्तु । उषासा नक्ता अग्न आज्यस्य वीताम् । दैव्या होतारा अग्न आज्यस्य वीताम् । तिस्रो देवीर् अग्न आज्यस्य व्यन्तु ।
text_mt: "May the doors, O Agni, partake of the clarified butter"; "May Dawn and Night, O Agni, partake of the clarified butter"; "May the two divine Hotṛs, O Agni, partake of the clarified butter"; "May the three goddesses, O Agni, partake of the clarified butter."
And the [offerings] to Savitṛ and to Heaven and Earth are [made] in a low voice.
A first-born calf is the sacrificial gift.
Between the first and the second, however, there are six:

sanskrit_iast: devīr dvāro vasuvane vasudheyasya vyantu | devī uṣāsā naktā vasuvane vasu dheyasya vītām | devī joṣṭrī vasuvane vasudheyasya vītām | devī ūrja āhutī vasuvane vasudheyasya vītām | devī uṣāsā naktā vasuvane vasudheyasya vītām | devī joṣṭrī vasuvane vasudheyasya vītām | devīs tisras tisro devīr vasuvane vasudheyasya vyantu |
meaning: देवीर् द्वारो वसुवने वसुधेयस्य व्यन्तु । देवी उषासा नक्ता वसुवने वसु धेयस्य वीताम् । देवी जोष्ट्री वसुवने वसुधेयस्य वीताम् । देवी ऊर्ज आहुती वसुवने वसुधेयस्य वीताम् । देवी उषासा नक्ता वसुवने वसुधेयस्य वीताम् । देवी जोष्ट्री वसुवने वसुधेयस्य वीताम् । देवीस् तिस्रस् तिस्रो देवीर् वसुवने वसुधेयस्य व्यन्तु ।
text_mt: "May the divine Doors partake of the wealth-holding at the winning of wealth"; "May the divine Dawn and Night partake of the wealth-holding at the winning of wealth"; "May the two divine Joṣṭrīs partake of the wealth-holding at the winning of wealth"; "May the two divine Refreshment-oblations partake of the wealth-holding at the winning of wealth"; "May the divine Dawn and Night partake of the wealth-holding at the winning of wealth"; "May the two divine Joṣṭrīs partake of the wealth-holding at the winning of wealth"; "May the three divine, the three goddesses partake of the wealth-holding at the winning of wealth."
When it is concluded, the Full Moon sacrifice [takes place].

sanskrit_iast: māṃsa anaśanam brahmacaryam prān adhaḥ śeta ṛtu kāle vā jāyām upeyāt satya vadanam ca antarāla vratāni |
meaning: मांस अनशनम् ब्रह्मचर्यम् प्रान् अधः शेत ऋतु काले वा जायाम् उपेयात् सत्य वदनम् च अन्तराल व्रतानि ।
text_mt: Abstaining from eating meat, chastity, sleeping on the ground facing eastward—or he may approach his wife during her fertile period—and speaking the truth are the observances for the interval.
On the full-moon day of Āṣāḍha is the Varuṇapraghāsa sacrifice for the Phālguna performance;
on the full-moon day of Śravaṇa for the Caitra performance.
The [oblations] ending with that to Pūṣan are the same as in the Vaiśvadeva sacrifice.

sanskrit_iast: aindrāgno vāruṇī payasyā mārutī kāyaś ca |
meaning: ऐन्द्राग्नो वारुणी पयस्या मारुती कायश् च ।
text_mt: [The remaining oblations are:] one to Indra and Agni, a curd offering to Varuṇa, one to the Maruts, and one to Ka (Prajāpati).

sanskrit_iast: imam me varuṇa tat tvā yāmi |
meaning: इमम् मे वरुण तत् त्वा यामि ।
text_mt: "Hear this my call, O Varuṇa" (imaṃ me varuṇa) [and] "Therefore I ask of thee" (tat tvā yāmi) [are the verses for Varuṇa].
"O Maruts, whatever indeed you" (maruto yad dha yūyam) [and] "To us" (asmān) [are the verses for the Maruts].
"The Golden Embryo" (hiraṇyagarbhaḥ) [and] "He who breathes" (yaḥ prāṇataḥ) [are the verses for Ka].
And they bring forward [the fire] from the Āhavanīya into the [new] fire[-altar].

sanskrit_iast: pra devam devyā iti tisṛṇām āsīnaḥ prathamām |
meaning: प्र देवम् देव्या इति तिसृणाम् आसीनः प्रथमाम् ।
text_mt: Of the three [verses beginning with] "Forth the god with divine" (pra devam devyā), he recites the first while seated.
"At Iḷā's [place] thee" (iḷāyās tvā) [he recites] while the two fuel-bundles are being laid down.

sanskrit_iast: agne viśvebhiḥ svanīka sīda hotar ni hotā tvam dūtaḥ |
meaning: अग्ने विश्वेभिः स्वनीक सीद होतर् नि होता त्वम् दूतः ।
text_mt: "O Agni, with all [thy faces] of fair countenance" (agne viśvebhiḥ svanīka), "Sit down, O Hotṛ" (sīda hotar), "Down the Hotṛ" (ni hotā), "Thou, the messenger" (tvaṃ dūtaḥ)—

sanskrit_iast: yatra ca āsīnaḥ prathamām anvavocat tat sthitvā utsṛjyate |
meaning: यत्र च आसीनः प्रथमाम् अन्ववोचत् तत् स्थित्वा उत्सृज्यते ।
text_mt: And where he recited the first while seated, having stood there, he is dismissed.
The Hotṛ's duties [are performed] at the northern sacrificial altar.
He strews the grass-bunch of the Adhvaryu.

sanskrit_iast: vāruṇyā niṣkāṣeṇa avabhṛtham avaiti yathā some |
meaning: वारुण्या निष्काषेण अवभृथम् अवैति यथा सोमे ।
text_mt: With the scraped scrapings of the offering to Varuṇa, he goes down to the purificatory bath as at the Soma sacrifice.
The rest is identical with the Vaiśvadeva sacrifice.
On the full-moon day of Kārttika is the Sākamedha sacrifice for the Phālguna performance;
on the full-moon day of Mārgaśīrṣa (Āgrahāyaṇī) for the Caitra performance.

sanskrit_iast: agnaye anīkavate pūrvasyām paurṇamāsyām iṣṭiḥ pūrva ahṇe |
meaning: अग्नये अनीकवते पूर्वस्याम् पौर्णमास्याम् इष्टिः पूर्व अह्णे ।
text_mt: The sacrifice to Agni Anīkavat takes place on the preceding full-moon day, in the forenoon.

sanskrit_iast: anīkair dveṣo ardaya agne viśvābhir ūtibhiḥ | rayim no dehi jīvase | sainānīkena |
meaning: अनीकैर् द्वेषो अर्दय अग्ने विश्वाभिर् ऊतिभिः । रयिम् नो देहि जीवसे । सैनानीकेन ।
text_mt: "With thy faces crush hostility, O Agni, with all thy helps" (anīkair dveṣo ardaya agne viśvābhir ūtibhiḥ), "Give us wealth to live" (rayiṃ no dehi jīvase), [and] "With his troop-face" (sainānīkena) [are the verses].
At midday, [the sacrifice] to the Sāṃtapana Maruts [takes place].

sanskrit_iast: agninā rayim gayasphāna ity ājya bhāgau |
meaning: अग्निना रयिम् गयस्फान इत्य् आज्य भागौ ।
text_mt: "By Agni wealth" (agninā rayim) [and] "Increaser of the home" (gayasphānaḥ) are the two clarified-butter portions.

sanskrit_iast: gṛha medhāsa ā gata pra budhnyā vaḥ |
meaning: गृह मेधास आ गत प्र बुध्न्या वः ।
text_mt: "Come, O household-sacrificers" (gṛhamedhāsa ā gata) [and] "Forth your deep-founded" (pra budhnyā vaḥ) [are the verses].

sanskrit_iast: tvām citra śravastama yad vāhiṣṭham iti sviṣṭakṛtaḥ |
meaning: त्वाम् चित्र श्रवस्तम यद् वाहिष्ठम् इति स्विष्टकृतः ।
text_mt: "Thee of most wondrous fame" (tvāṃ citraśravastama) [and] "Which is most conveying" (yad vāhiṣṭham) are [the verses] for [Agni] Sviṣṭakṛt.

sanskrit_iast: ājya bhāga prabhṛtī ijyā iḷā antā |
meaning: आज्य भाग प्रभृती इज्या इऌआ अन्ता ।
text_mt: The sacrifice begins with the two clarified-butter portions and ends with the Iḷā.

sanskrit_iast: tasya niṣkāṣam prātaḥ pūrṇa darvyam hutvā iṣṭim marudbhyaḥ krīḷibhyaḥ |
meaning: तस्य निष्काषम् प्रातः पूर्ण दर्व्यम् हुत्वा इष्टिम् मरुद्भ्यः क्रीऌइभ्यः ।
text_mt: Having offered in the morning the scraping of that [vessel] in a full ladle, [there is] a sacrifice to the sportive Maruts.
[The verses are:] krīḷaṁ vaḥ and parvataścit.
The offerings of the Varuṇapraghāsa up to the one to Indra-Agni [are performed];
and [there are offerings] to Mahendra and to Viśvakarman.

sanskrit_iast: vācas patim yā te dhāmāni paramāṇi iti |
meaning: वाचस् पतिम् या ते धामानि परमाणि इति ।
text_mt: [The verses are:] vācaspatim and yā te dhāmāni paramāṇi.
And the offering to Viśvakarman is [recited] in a low voice.
And one fire is brought forward.
There is neither the Vājina offering nor a purificatory bath.
The rest is the same as the Varuṇapraghāsa.

sanskrit_iast: apara ahṇe pitryā tri havir iṣṭiḥ |
meaning: अपर अह्णे पित्र्या त्रि हविर् इष्टिः ।
text_mt: In the afternoon, [there is] the three-oblation sacrifice to the ancestors.

sanskrit_iast: somāya pitṛmate pitṛbhyo vā somavadbhyaḥ pitṛbhyo barhiṣadbhyaḥ pitṛbhyo agniṣvāttebhyaḥ |
meaning: सोमाय पितृमते पितृभ्यो वा सोमवद्भ्यः पितृभ्यो बर्हिषद्भ्यः पितृभ्यो अग्निष्वात्तेभ्यः ।
text_mt: [The oblations are] to Soma accompanied by the ancestors, or to the ancestors accompanied by Soma, to the ancestors seated on the sacrificial grass, [and] to the ancestors consumed by Agni.

sanskrit_iast: agniś ca kavya vāhanaḥ sviṣṭakṛd bhavati |
meaning: अग्निश् च कव्य वाहनः स्विष्टकृद् भवति ।
text_mt: And Agni Kavyavāhana is the Sviṣṭakṛt.

sanskrit_iast: tvam soma pra cikitaḥ somo dhenum tvam soma pitṛbhir iti somasya pitṛmataḥ |
meaning: त्वम् सोम प्र चिकितः सोमो धेनुम् त्वम् सोम पितृभिर् इति सोमस्य पितृमतः ।
text_mt: Tvaṁ soma pra cikitaḥ, somo dhenum, [and] tvaṁ soma pitṛbhiḥ are for Soma accompanied by the ancestors.

sanskrit_iast: udīratām aṅgiraso ye naḥ pūrva iti somavatām |
meaning: उदीरताम् अङ्गिरसो ये नः पूर्व इति सोमवताम् ।
text_mt: Udīratām and aṅgiraso naḥ pūrvāḥ are for those accompanied by Soma.

sanskrit_iast: upahūtā āham pitṝn barhiṣada iti barhiṣadām |
meaning: उपहूता आहम् पितॄन् बर्हिषद इति बर्हिषदाम् ।
text_mt: Upahūtāḥ and ahaṁ pitṝn barhiṣadaḥ are for those seated on the sacrificial grass.

sanskrit_iast: ava sṛja ye ca iha agniṣvāttā ity agniṣvāttānām |
meaning: अव सृज ये च इह अग्निष्वात्ता इत्य् अग्निष्वात्तानाम् ।
text_mt: Ava sṛja and ye ceha agniṣvāttāḥ are for those consumed by Agni.

sanskrit_iast: eka ekā yājyā dve dve pūrve puronuvākye |
meaning: एक एका याज्या द्वे द्वे पूर्वे पुरोनुवाक्ये ।
text_mt: There is one consecratory verse for each, [and] the two preceding are the introductory verses.

sanskrit_iast: ye tātṛṣus tvam agna īḷita ity agneḥ kavya vāhanasya |
meaning: ये तातृषुस् त्वम् अग्न ईऌइत इत्य् अग्नेः कव्य वाहनस्य ।
text_mt: Ye tātṛṣuḥ and tvam agna īḷitaḥ are for Agni Kavyavāhana.
Wearing the sacred thread over the right shoulder, he recites the offering verse to these deities.
And he adopts [this posture] at the places of the insertion of a deity's name;
Jātūkarṇya [says]: [He does so] wearing the sacred thread over the left shoulder.

sanskrit_iast: sampraiṣeṣu svadhā śabde kriyamāṇe ye svdhāmahe svadhā nama iti ye yajāmaha vaṣaṭ kārayoḥ sthāne |
meaning: सम्प्रैषेषु स्वधा शब्दे क्रियमाणे ये स्व्धामहे स्वधा नम इति ये यजामह वषट् कारयोः स्थाने ।
text_mt: When the word svadhā is used in the ritual summonses, ye svadhāmahe and svadhā namaḥ [are substituted] in place of the ye yajāmahe and the vaṣaṭ-call.
They act south of the Anvāhāryapacana [fire], inside an enclosure.
He stands to the south, facing the sacrificial altar.
The ritual acts with muttered mantras are [performed] silently.

sanskrit_iast: uśantas tvā ity ekām sāmidhenīm trir anūcya na ārṣeyam āha |
meaning: उशन्तस् त्वा इत्य् एकाम् सामिधेनीम् त्रिर् अनूच्य न आर्षेयम् आह ।
text_mt: Having recited three times the single kindling verse uśantas tvā, he does not recite the ancestral lineage.

sanskrit_iast: apabarhiṣaḥ prayājān iṣṭvā no agne sucetunā tvam soma mahe bhagam iti jīvanavantāv ājya bhāgau |
meaning: अपबर्हिषः प्रयाजान् इष्ट्वा नो अग्ने सुचेतुना त्वम् सोम महे भगम् इति जीवनवन्ताव् आज्य भागौ ।
text_mt: Having sacrificed the fore-offerings without sacrificial grass, [he recites] no agne sucetunā and tvaṁ soma mahe bhagam, [the two verses] containing [words for] life, for the two clarified butter portions.
Having invoked the Iḷā, they do not eat it.
Having smelled the portions, they cast them away;

sanskrit_iast: ayā viṣṭhā janayan karvarāṇi sa hi ghṛṇiru urur varāya gātuḥ | sa patyudaid dharuṇam madhvo agram svām yat tanūm tanvām airayata | iti japanta uttareṇa anvāhārya pacanam gatvā |
meaning: अया विष्ठा जनयन् कर्वराणि स हि घृणिरु उरुर् वराय गातुः । स पत्युदैद् धरुणम् मध्वो अग्रम् स्वाम् यत् तनूम् तन्वाम् ऐरयत । इति जपन्त उत्तरेण अन्वाहार्य पचनम् गत्वा ।
text_mt: Muttering ayā viṣṭhā janayan karvarāṇi sa hi ghṛṇir urur varāya gātuḥ / sa patyud aid dharuṇaṁ madhvo agraṁ svāṁ yat tanūṁ tanvām airayata //, having gone north of the Anvāhāryapacana [fire],

sanskrit_iast: susaṃdṛśam tvā vayam akṣann amīmadanta upa ū ṣu śṛṇuhi ity āhavanīyam upasthāya |
meaning: सुसंदृशम् त्वा वयम् अक्षन्न् अमीमदन्त उप ऊ षु शृणुहि इत्य् आहवनीयम् उपस्थाय ।
text_mt: and having reverenced the Āhavanīya [fire] with susaṁdṛśaṁ tvā vayam, akṣann amīmadanta, and upo ṣu śṛṇuhi;

sanskrit_iast: mano nv ā huvāmaha iti tṛcena dakṣiṇa agnim |
meaning: मनो न्व् आ हुवामह इति तृचेन दक्षिण अग्निम् ।
text_mt: [and reverenced] the Southern fire with the triplet mano nv ā huvāmahe;

sanskrit_iast: ā ma etu manaḥ punar iti brūyuḥ |
meaning: आ म एतु मनः पुनर् इति ब्रूयुः ।
text_mt: they should say: ā ma etu manaḥ punaḥ;

sanskrit_iast: agnim tam manya iti tṛcena agne tvam na iti ca dvaipadena gārhapatyam |
meaning: अग्निम् तम् मन्य इति तृचेन अग्ने त्वम् न इति च द्वैपदेन गार्हपत्यम् ।
text_mt: and [having reverenced] the Gārhapatya [fire] with the triplet agniṁ taṁ manye and with the two-verse hymn agne tvaṁ naḥ;
and having reverenced the Sun with tac cakṣuḥ;
having sacrificed the two after-offerings without sacrificial grass;

sanskrit_iast: na sūkta vāke yajamānasya nāma gṛhṇāti |
meaning: न सूक्त वाके यजमानस्य नाम गृह्णाति ।
text_mt: he does not utter the name of the sacrificer in the Sūktavāka.
Having concluded the Tryambaka [offerings, there is] a mess of boiled rice for Mitra;
[The verses are:] mitrasya carṣaṇīdhṛtaḥ and mahān ādityaḥ.
When it is completed, [the sacrifice is concluded according to] the Full Moon sacrifice.
The offerings of the Vaiśvadeva sacrifice up to that to Pūṣan [are performed];

sanskrit_iast: śunā sīryo vāyavyam payaḥ sauryaś ca |
meaning: शुना सीर्यो वायव्यम् पयः सौर्यश् च ।
text_mt: and [there are offerings] to Śunāsīrau, milk to Vāyu, and [an offering] to Sūrya.

sanskrit_iast: śunā sīrāv imām śunam naḥ phālāḥ |
meaning: शुना सीराव् इमाम् शुनम् नः फालाः ।
text_mt: [For Śunāsīrau, the verses are:] śunāsīrāv imām and śunaṁ naḥ phālāḥ.
[For Vāyu, the verses are:] tava vāyav ṛtaspate and adhvaryavaś cakṛvāṁsaḥ.

sanskrit_iast: taraṇir viśva darśato divo rukma iti |
meaning: तरणिर् विश्व दर्शतो दिवो रुक्म इति ।
text_mt: [For Sūrya, the verses are:] taraṇir viśvadarśataḥ and divo rukmaḥ.
The rest is the same as the Vaiśvadeva [parvan].
However, [the rite is that of] the Full Moon sacrifice if [the fire] is not churned.

sanskrit_iast: indraś ca naḥ śunā sīrāv imam yajñam mimikṣatām | garbhān dhattam svastaye | yayor idam bhuvanam ā viveśa yayor ānando nihoto mahaś ca | śunā sīrāv ṛtubhiḥ saṃvidānā indravantā havir idam juṣethām |
meaning: इन्द्रश् च नः शुना सीराव् इमम् यज्ञम् मिमिक्षताम् । गर्भान् धत्तम् स्वस्तये । ययोर् इदम् भुवनम् आ विवेश ययोर् आनन्दो निहोतो महश् च । शुना सीराव् ऋतुभिः संविदाना इन्द्रवन्ता हविर् इदम् जुषेथाम् ।
text_mt: "May Indra and Śunāsīra sprinkle this sacrifice of ours; / establish embryos for wellbeing; / into whom this whole world has entered, in whom joy and greatness are placed; / O Śunāsīra, united with the seasons, accompanied by Indra, enjoy this oblation!"

sanskrit_iast: indrāya śunā sīrāya srucā juhutanā haviḥ | juṣatām prati medhiraḥ | pra havyāni ghṛtavanty asmai haryaśvāya bharatā sajoṣāḥ | indra ṛbhubhir brahmaṇā saṃvidānaḥ śunā sīrī havir idam juṣasva |
meaning: इन्द्राय शुना सीराय स्रुचा जुहुतना हविः । जुषताम् प्रति मेधिरः । प्र हव्यानि घृतवन्त्य् अस्मै हर्यश्वाय भरता सजोषाः । इन्द्र ऋभुभिर् ब्रह्मणा संविदानः शुना सीरी हविर् इदम् जुषस्व ।
text_mt: "To Indra Śunāsīra offer the oblation with the ladle; / let the wise one enjoy it in return; / bring forth oblations rich in ghee to him who has tawny steeds, in unison; / O Indra, united with the Ṛbhus through prayer, O Śunāsīrī, enjoy this oblation!"
[The invitatory and offering verses for Sītā, etc., are] "Prosperity we would invoke, desiring horses..." (RV 4.57.4–8).

sanskrit_iast: sāka medhair iṣṭvā anvakṣam śunā sīryam |
meaning: साक मेधैर् इष्ट्वा अन्वक्षम् शुना सीर्यम् ।
text_mt: Having performed the Sākamedha sacrifices, [one performs] the Śunāsīrya immediately following.
Or on the full moon of the month of Māgha.
The concluding dismissal is with a soma sacrifice, an animal sacrifice, or an iṣṭi.

sanskrit_iast: pañca varṣeṣu pūrve dyuḥ śunā sīryam apare dyur vaiśvadevam |
meaning: पञ्च वर्षेषु पूर्वे द्युः शुना सीर्यम् अपरे द्युर् वैश्वदेवम् ।
text_mt: Over five years, [the sequence is]: on the preceding day the Śunāsīrya, on the following day the Vaiśvadeva.
When a rule is transgressed, there is an expiation.
When a required item is lacking, there is a substitute.

sanskrit_iast: bhūr bhuvaḥ svaḥ svāhā | āyāś ca agne asy anabhiśastiś ca satyam ittvam ayā asi | ayāsā manasā kṛto ayāḥ san havyam ūhiṣe | ayā naḥ kṛṇuhi bheṣajam | svāhā | iti prāyaś citta āhutī sarveṣu doṣeṣu |
meaning: भूर् भुवः स्वः स्वाहा । आयाश् च अग्ने अस्य् अनभिशस्तिश् च सत्यम् इत्त्वम् अया असि । अयासा मनसा कृतो अयाः सन् हव्यम् ऊहिषे । अया नः कृणुहि भेषजम् । स्वाहा । इति प्रायश् चित्त आहुती सर्वेषु दोषेषु ।
text_mt: "Bhūr bhuvaḥ svaḥ svāhā!" [and] "O Agni, you are the expedient and the protection from reproach; truly you are the expedient; / made by an expedient mind, being the expedient, you have borne the oblation; / O expedient one, bring healing to us, svāhā!"—these are the two expiatory oblations in all faults.
The Āhavanīya is [the fire] for all oblations.
Four ladlefuls [of ghee are used] in expiations.

sanskrit_iast: anantaram doṣāt prāyaś cittam na hy anirhate doṣe pravṛttir uttarasya asti |
meaning: अनन्तरम् दोषात् प्रायश् चित्तम् न ह्य् अनिर्हते दोषे प्रवृत्तिर् उत्तरस्य अस्ति ।
text_mt: The expiation [is performed] immediately after the fault; for if the fault has not been removed, there is no progression of the subsequent [rite].

sanskrit_iast: pratyakṣa vihitam ca ekeṣu doṣeṣu prāyaś cittam tatra ubhe kuryāt sarva prāyaś cittam ca ādhikārikam ca |
meaning: प्रत्यक्ष विहितम् च एकेषु दोषेषु प्रायश् चित्तम् तत्र उभे कुर्यात् सर्व प्रायश् चित्तम् च आधिकारिकम् च ।
text_mt: And when an expiation is expressly prescribed for certain faults, one should perform both: the universal expiation and the specific one.

sanskrit_iast: anuddhṛtam ced āhavanīyam abhyastam iyād bahuvidā brāhmaṇena uddharaṇam | jāta rūpam ca kuśe prabadhya agrato haranti | rajatam abhyudite | varo dakṣiṇā |
meaning: अनुद्धृतम् चेद् आहवनीयम् अभ्यस्तम् इयाद् बहुविदा ब्राह्मणेन उद्धरणम् । जात रूपम् च कुशे प्रबध्य अग्रतो हरन्ति । रजतम् अभ्युदिते । वरो दक्षिणा ।
text_mt: If the sun sets while the Āhavanīya has not been brought forward, the bringing forward [is performed] by a learned brāhmaṇa; and having tied gold onto a kuśa-blade, they carry it in front; silver, if the sun has risen; the choice [cow] is the sacrificial fee.

sanskrit_iast: āhavanīye anugate gārhapatyād uddharaṇam agnaye ca iṣṭir jyotiṣmate |
meaning: आहवनीये अनुगते गार्हपत्याद् उद्धरणम् अग्नये च इष्टिर् ज्योतिष्मते ।
text_mt: If the Āhavanīya has gone out, the bringing forward is from the Gārhapatya, and an iṣṭi to Agni Jyotiṣmat [is performed].
[The verses are] "Upward, O Agni, [thy flames] pure..." (RV 8.44.17) [and] "...with light..." (RV 10.156.4).

sanskrit_iast: gārhapatye anugate pūrvam adhyavasāya āhavanīyam anyam praṇīya juhuyāt |
meaning: गार्हपत्ये अनुगते पूर्वम् अध्यवसाय आहवनीयम् अन्यम् प्रणीय जुहुयात् ।
text_mt: If the Gārhapatya has gone out, having settled the previous Āhavanīya, having brought forward another [fire], he should offer.
Or having caused [the fires] to ascend [into the kindling sticks], he should move away toward the north.

sanskrit_iast: ubhayor anugatayor gārhapatya ulmukād uttara araṇyā manthanam |
meaning: उभयोर् अनुगतयोर् गार्हपत्य उल्मुकाद् उत्तर अरण्या मन्थनम् ।
text_mt: If both have gone out, churning [is done] from a brand of the Gārhapatya with the upper churning-stick.

sanskrit_iast: ulmuke avidyamāne araṇī bhasmanā saṃspṛśya agnaye ca tapasvate janadvate pāvakavata iṣṭiḥ |
meaning: उल्मुके अविद्यमाने अरणी भस्मना संस्पृश्य अग्नये च तपस्वते जनद्वते पावकवत इष्टिः ।
text_mt: If no brand exists, having touched the two churning-sticks with ashes, there is an iṣṭi to Agni Tapasvat, Janadvat, and Pāvakavat.

sanskrit_iast: ā yāhi tapasā janeṣv ā agne pāvako arciṣā | upa imām suṣṭutim mama | ā no yāhi tapasā janeṣv ā agne pāvaka dīdyat | havyā deveṣu no dadhat |
meaning: आ याहि तपसा जनेष्व् आ अग्ने पावको अर्चिषा । उप इमाम् सुष्टुतिम् मम । आ नो याहि तपसा जनेष्व् आ अग्ने पावक दीद्यत् । हव्या देवेषु नो दधत् ।
text_mt: "Come with heat among men, O Agni, the purifier, with flame, / unto this, my fine praise; / come to us with heat among men, O Agni, purifier, shining, / placing our oblations among the gods."

sanskrit_iast: ity abhyuditayos tv abhyastamitayor vā anyena vā naṣṭayoḥ kāraṇena agny ādheyena utpādayet |
meaning: इत्य् अभ्युदितयोस् त्व् अभ्यस्तमितयोर् वा अन्येन वा नष्टयोः कारणेन अग्न्य् आधेयेन उत्पादयेत् ।
text_mt: If the sun rises or sets [over unchurned or extinguished fires], or if both are lost due to some other cause, he should produce [them] by the establishment of the fires.

sanskrit_iast: upasṛṣṭā ced agnihotrī vāśyeta sūyavasād iti yava samuṣṭim prayacchet |
meaning: उपसृष्टा चेद् अग्निहोत्री वाश्येत सूयवसाद् इति यव समुष्टिम् प्रयच्छेत् ।
text_mt: If the Agnihotra-cow bellows when approached [for milking], he should give her a fistful of barley with [the formula] "From good pasture..." (RV 1.164.40).

sanskrit_iast: upviśec cet | yasmād bhīṣā niṣīdasi tato no abhayam kṛdhi | prajābhyaḥ sarvābhyo mḷa namo rudrāya mīḷhuṣe | ity ārdra daṇḍena utthāpya udasthād devy aditir āyur yajña patāv adhāt | indrāya kṛṇvatī bhāgam mitrāya varuṇāya ca | ity anumantrayet |
meaning: उप्विशेच् चेत् । यस्माद् भीषा निषीदसि ततो नो अभयम् कृधि । प्रजाभ्यः सर्वाभ्यो मॢअ नमो रुद्राय मीऌहुषे । इत्य् आर्द्र दण्डेन उत्थाप्य उदस्थाद् देव्य् अदितिर् आयुर् यज्ञ पताव् अधात् । इन्द्राय कृण्वती भागम् मित्राय वरुणाय च । इत्य् अनुमन्त्रयेत् ।
text_mt: If she sits down, having raised her with a wet stick with [the verse] "From whatever fear you sit down, make us free from danger from that; / be gracious to all our offspring; homage to Rudra, the bountiful!", he should follow [her] with the formula: "Goddess Aditi has stood up; she has placed life in the sacrificer, / making a share for Indra, for Mitra, and for Varuṇa."

sanskrit_iast: haviṣi skanne acchāyam vo yayor ojasā skabhitā rajāṃsi vīryebhir vīratamā śaviṣṭhā | yā patyete apratītā sahobhir viṣṇū agan vruṇā pūrva hūtau | ity adbhir upanīya askān adhita prājani | divam devāṃs tṛtīyam yajño agāt tato mā draviṇam aṣṭv antarikṣam pitṝṃs tṛtīyam yajño agāt tato mā draviṇam aṣṭu pṛthivīm manuṣyāṃs tṛtīyam yajño agāt tato mā draviṇam aṣṭv ity anumantrayeta |
meaning: हविषि स्कन्ने अच्छायम् वो ययोर् ओजसा स्कभिता रजांसि वीर्येभिर् वीरतमा शविष्ठा । या पत्येते अप्रतीता सहोभिर् विष्णू अगन् व्रुणा पूर्व हूतौ । इत्य् अद्भिर् उपनीय अस्कान् अधित प्राजनि । दिवम् देवांस् तृतीयम् यज्ञो अगात् ततो मा द्रविणम् अष्ट्व् अन्तरिक्षम् पितॄंस् तृतीयम् यज्ञो अगात् ततो मा द्रविणम् अष्टु पृथिवीम् मनुष्यांस् तृतीयम् यज्ञो अगात् ततो मा द्रविणम् अष्ट्व् इत्य् अनुमन्त्रयेत ।
text_mt: If the oblation is spilled, having brought it near with water with [the verse] "Unto you two whose might propped up the realms, who are the most heroic and mighty in prowess, / who rule unopposed with power—Viṣṇu and Varuṇa have come to the first invocation", he should follow it with the formula: "It has spilled; it has been placed; it has been engendered; / a third of the sacrifice has gone to the sky, to the gods: from there let wealth reach me! A third of the sacrifice has gone to the intermediate region, to the Fathers: from there let wealth reach me! A third of the sacrifice has gone to the earth, to men: from there let wealth reach me!"

sanskrit_iast: yad brāhmaṇo jugupsur na bhakṣayed etad duṣṭasya lakṣaṇam |
meaning: यद् ब्राह्मणो जुगुप्सुर् न भक्षयेद् एतद् दुष्टस्य लक्षणम् ।
text_mt: That which a fastidious brāhmaṇa would not consume is the characteristic mark of what is spoiled.
If a remainder exists, the completion [is performed] with that.
In the absence of a remainder, he should produce another.

sanskrit_iast: tasmin dravye avidyamāne yat sāma anyatamam manyeta tat pratinidadhyāt |
meaning: तस्मिन् द्रव्ये अविद्यमाने यत् साम अन्यतमम् मन्येत तत् प्रतिनिदध्यात् ।
text_mt: If that substance is not available, he should substitute whatever he deems most similar.
This is the rule for substitutes.

sanskrit_iast: apratta daivate duṣṭe na āvṛttir asti hautrasya anyadd haviḥ saṃskṛtya prayacched devatāyai |
meaning: अप्रत्त दैवते दुष्टे न आवृत्तिर् अस्ति हौत्रस्य अन्यद्द् हविः संस्कृत्य प्रयच्छेद् देवतायै ।
text_mt: If [an oblation] is spoiled before being offered to the deity, there is no repetition of the Hotṛ's duties; having prepared another oblation, he should offer it to the deity.

sanskrit_iast: na āvṛttiḥ pratta doṣe asti lupyate sviṣṭakṛd iḷam bhakṣāś ca |
meaning: न आवृत्तिः प्रत्त दोषे अस्ति लुप्यते स्विष्टकृद् इऌअम् भक्षाश् च ।
text_mt: There is no repetition when the fault occurs after the offering; the Sviṣṭakṛt, the iḍā, and the portions to be eaten are omitted.

sanskrit_iast: anyāsu devatāsv iṣṭāsu duṣṭena vā śeṣavati tantre pradānam āvartate |
meaning: अन्यासु देवतास्व् इष्टासु दुष्टेन वा शेषवति तन्त्रे प्रदानम् आवर्तते ।
text_mt: If other deities have been sacrificed to, or if [sacrificed] with a spoiled [portion] while the ritual framework still has a remainder, the presentation is repeated.

sanskrit_iast: kṛtasya anāvṛttir guṇa lope samnipāta pradhānatvāt |
meaning: कृतस्य अनावृत्तिर् गुण लोपे सम्निपात प्रधानत्वात् ।
text_mt: There is no repetition of what has already been done when a secondary element is omitted, because the main sacrificial act is what accomplishes the purpose.
He should indeed mutter it after [the act], [says] Jātūkarṇya.

sanskrit_iast: anyābhyo gṛhīte anyāsu vā āvāhitāsu coditābhyaḥ prayacched ājyena āvāhitā yajet |
meaning: अन्याभ्यो गृहीते अन्यासु वा आवाहितासु चोदिताभ्यः प्रयच्छेद् आज्येन आवाहिता यजेत् ।
text_mt: If [an oblation] has been taken for other [deities], or if other [deities] have been invoked, he should give it to those prescribed; he should sacrifice to the invoked [deities] with clarified butter.

sanskrit_iast: iṣṭi paśu bandheṣu some ca prāyaś cittam brahmā juhoti |
meaning: इष्टि पशु बन्धेषु सोमे च प्रायश् चित्तम् ब्रह्मा जुहोति ।
text_mt: In the iṣṭis, animal sacrifices, and soma sacrifices, the Brahman priest offers the expiation.

sanskrit_iast: ṛgvede ced doṣaḥ syād bhūḥ svāhā iti gārhapatye |
meaning: ऋग्वेदे चेद् दोषः स्याद् भूः स्वाहा इति गार्हपत्ये ।
text_mt: If there is a fault concerning the Ṛgveda, [the offering is made] in the Gārhapatya with "Bhūḥ svāhā!"

sanskrit_iast: yajur vede ced bhuvaḥ svāhā ity anvāhārya pacane |
meaning: यजुर् वेदे चेद् भुवः स्वाहा इत्य् अन्वाहार्य पचने ।
text_mt: If concerning the Yajurveda, in the Anvāhāryapacana with "Bhuvaḥ svāhā!"

sanskrit_iast: sāma vede cet svaḥ svāhā ity āhavanīye |
meaning: साम वेदे चेत् स्वः स्वाहा इत्य् आहवनीये ।
text_mt: If concerning the Sāmaveda, in the Āhavanīya with "Svaḥ svāhā!"

sanskrit_iast: bhūr bhuvaḥ svaḥ svāhā ity ajñāpayāne doṣe |
meaning: भूर् भुवः स्वः स्वाहा इत्य् अज्ञापयाने दोषे ।
text_mt: If the fault is unknown, with "Bhūr bhuvaḥ svaḥ svāhā!"
If he sets out on a journey without having paid reverent homage [to the fires], he pays reverent homage in every direction.
If he has paid reverent homage but does not set out, [he acts] as one returning from a journey.
If he has caused [the fires] to ascend [into the kindling sticks] but does not set out, churning [must be performed].
There is no reverent homage to the two kindling sticks.

sanskrit_iast: na ahomena anijyayā vā agnīn utsṛjet |
meaning: न अहोमेन अनिज्यया वा अग्नीन् उत्सृजेत् ।
text_mt: He should not let the fires go out through lack of daily offering or through lack of performing the seasonal/new-and-full-moon sacrifices.

sanskrit_iast: prāyaś cittam tu kṛtvā atītāni karmāṇi pratinidadhyāt pratinidadhyāt |
meaning: प्रायश् चित्तम् तु कृत्वा अतीतानि कर्माणि प्रतिनिदध्यात् प्रतिनिदध्यात् ।
text_mt: Having performed an expiation, however, he should compensate for the omitted rites, he should compensate.
The wife and the sacrificer [eat] fast-food.
They should eat before the driving away of the calves,

sanskrit_iast: yad anyan māṃsa lavaṇa mithuna māṣebhyo yena ca dravyeṇa yakṣyamāṇaḥ syāt |
meaning: यद् अन्यन् मांस लवण मिथुन माषेभ्यो येन च द्रव्येण यक्ष्यमाणः स्यात् ।
text_mt: anything other than meat, salt, sexual intercourse, kidney beans, and the material with which he intends to sacrifice.

sanskrit_iast: agnīn anvādadhīta iṣṭi paśu bandheṣu pūrve dyuḥ |
meaning: अग्नीन् अन्वादधीत इष्टि पशु बन्धेषु पूर्वे द्युः ।
text_mt: On the day before the sacrifices and the animal sacrifice, he should add fuel to the fires:
On the Āhavanīya fire with the last Great Utterance,
on the Gārhapatya fire with the first,
on the southern fire with the middle one,
On the Āhavanīya, the tenth [piece] with all [the Great Utterances together].

sanskrit_iast: mahā vyāhṛtīnām vā sthāne catasro vihavyasya ānupūrvyeṇa |
meaning: महा व्याहृतीनाम् वा स्थाने चतस्रो विहव्यस्य आनुपूर्व्येण ।
text_mt: Or, in place of the Great Utterances, four [pieces] with [the first four verses] of the Vihavya hymn in proper sequence,

sanskrit_iast: apa naḥ śośucad agham iti sapta agne naya yas tvā hṛdā tvam no agne adharād iti vā daśabhiḥ |
meaning: अप नः शोशुचद् अघम् इति सप्त अग्ने नय यस् त्वा हृदा त्वम् नो अग्ने अधराद् इति वा दशभिः ।
text_mt: Or with the seven verses 'May our sin blaze away...', [or] with the ten [verses] beginning 'O Agni, lead...', 'Whoever to you with his heart...', and 'You to us, O Agni, from below...'.

sanskrit_iast: pra agnaye vācam imam stomam iti ca upasthānam sūktābhyām |
meaning: प्र अग्नये वाचम् इमम् स्तोमम् इति च उपस्थानम् सूक्ताभ्याम् ।
text_mt: And attendance [on the fires] with the two hymns: 'Forth to Agni speech...' and 'This praise...'.
with the Great Utterances is that of Paiṅgya;

sanskrit_iast: piṇḍa pitṛ yajño apara ahṇe amāvāsyāyām |
meaning: पिण्ड पितृ यज्ञो अपर अह्णे अमावास्यायाम् ।
text_mt: The Piṇḍapitṛyajña (ancestral ball-offering) takes place in the afternoon on the New Moon day.

sanskrit_iast: dakṣiṇa agneḥ purastāt śūrpam sthālīm sphyam pātrīm ulūkhala musale ca saṃsādya |
meaning: दक्षिण अग्नेः पुरस्तात् शूर्पम् स्थालीम् स्फ्यम् पात्रीम् उलूखल मुसले च संसाद्य ।
text_mt: Having arranged to the east of the southern fire a winnowing basket, a cooking pot, a wooden sword, a dish, and a mortar and pestle,

sanskrit_iast: gārhapatyasya paścād dakṣiṇa agneṣu kuśeṣu sphyam nidhāya |
meaning: गार्हपत्यस्य पश्चाद् दक्षिण अग्नेषु कुशेषु स्फ्यम् निधाय ।
text_mt: and having laid down the wooden sword to the west of the Gārhapatya on kuśa grasses directed towards the southern fire,
above it the paddy in the dish,
and to the east in the winnowing basket the cooking pot,

sanskrit_iast: ācya savyam jānu nīcā muṣṭinā vrīhīn gṛhṇāti pitṝn dhyāyan |
meaning: आच्य सव्यम् जानु नीचा मुष्टिना व्रीहीन् गृह्णाति पितॄन् ध्यायन् ।
text_mt: having bent his left knee, he takes the paddy with his fist turned downward, meditating upon the fathers.

sanskrit_iast: yathā adhobila śritaḥ sa syāt patnyā sakṛt phalī kṛtān dakṣiṇa agnau śrapayitvā abhighārya pratyañcam udvāsya avasavi parisamuhya paristīrya paryukṣya dakṣiṇam jānv ācya yajña upavītī prān āsīno mekṣaṇena juhoti |
meaning: यथा अधोबिल श्रितः स स्यात् पत्न्या सकृत् फली कृतान् दक्षिण अग्नौ श्रपयित्वा अभिघार्य प्रत्यञ्चम् उद्वास्य अवसवि परिसमुह्य परिस्तीर्य पर्युक्ष्य दक्षिणम् जान्व् आच्य यज्ञ उपवीती प्रान् आसीनो मेक्षणेन जुहोति ।
text_mt: So that it may rest with its hollow downward; having cooked [the grains] on the southern fire once husked by the wife, having basted it, having taken it down towards the west, having swept [the fire] counter-clockwise, having strewn grass around, having sprinkled water around, having bent his right knee, wearing the sacred thread over the left shoulder, sitting facing east, he makes an offering with the stirring stick:

sanskrit_iast: agnaye kavya vāhanāya svāhā somāya pitṛmate svāhā yamāya aṅgirasvate pitṛmate svāhā iti |
meaning: अग्नये कव्य वाहनाय स्वाहा सोमाय पितृमते स्वाहा यमाय अङ्गिरस्वते पितृमते स्वाहा इति ।

sanskrit_iast: mekṣaṇam anuprahṛtya dakṣiṇā dakṣiṇa agner apahatā asurā rakṣāṃsi vediṣada iti sphyena unmṛjya abhyukṣya | ye rūpāṇi pratimuñcamānā asurāḥ santaḥ svadhayā caranti | parāpuro nipuro ye bharanty agniṣ tāṃl lokāt pra ṇudāty asmāt | ity ulmukam unmṛṣṭasya dakṣiṇa ardhe nidhāya mūle kuśān sakṛl lūnān unmṛṣṭe nidhāya asāv avanenikṣva ye ca tvām atra anv iti pitur nāma ādiśya kuśeṣv apo niṣiñcaty avācīna pāṇinā |
meaning: मेक्षणम् अनुप्रहृत्य दक्षिणा दक्षिण अग्नेर् अपहता असुरा रक्षांसि वेदिषद इति स्फ्येन उन्मृज्य अभ्युक्ष्य । ये रूपाणि प्रतिमुञ्चमाना असुराः सन्तः स्वधया चरन्ति । परापुरो निपुरो ये भरन्त्य् अग्निष् तांल् लोकात् प्र णुदात्य् अस्मात् । इत्य् उल्मुकम् उन्मृष्टस्य दक्षिण अर्धे निधाय मूले कुशान् सकृल् लूनान् उन्मृष्टे निधाय असाव् अवनेनिक्ष्व ये च त्वाम् अत्र अन्व् इति पितुर् नाम आदिश्य कुशेष्व् अपो निषिञ्चत्य् अवाचीन पाणिना ।
text_mt:
"To Agni, conveyor of the funeral cakes, svāhā! To Soma accompanied by the fathers, svāhā! To Yama accompanied by the Aṅgirases and accompanied by the fathers, svāhā!" / Having thrown in the stirring stick, to the south of the southern fire, having scraped [the ground] with the wooden sword with the formula: "Smitten are the Asuras and the Rakṣases that sit on the altar," having sprinkled it, [and reciting:] "The Asuras who, putting on various forms, wander according to their own will, who carry away fortresses and barriers, may Agni expel them from this world!"
having placed a firebrand on the southern half of the scraped ground, having placed at their roots kuśa grass cut in a single stroke upon the scraped ground, saying: "O [Name], wash yourself, and those who follow you here," mentioning the name of his father, he pours water upon the kuśa grass with his palm turned downwards.
In the same manner, to the south, for the grandfather,

sanskrit_iast: asāv etat te ye ca tvām atra anv iti piṇḍān yathā avanejitam nidhāya |
meaning: असाव् एतत् ते ये च त्वाम् अत्र अन्व् इति पिण्डान् यथा अवनेजितम् निधाय ।
text_mt: Having placed down the rice balls in the same order as the washing, saying: "O [Name], this is for you, and those who follow you here;"
both [balls] in the case of a single [maternal or paternal] division among the fathers.
Or rather, to those to whom the father [offers, to those the son offers].

sanskrit_iast: atra pitaro mādayadhvam yathā bhāgam pitara āvṛṣāyadhvam iti |
meaning: अत्र पितरो मादयध्वम् यथा भागम् पितर आवृषायध्वम् इति ।
text_mt: [He recites:] "Here, O fathers, exhilarate yourselves; like bulls, O fathers, exhilarate yourselves, each according to his share!"

sanskrit_iast: amīmadanta pitaro yathā bhāgam avīvṛṣata it pratiparyāvṛtya |
meaning: अमीमदन्त पितरो यथा भागम् अवीवृषत इत् प्रतिपर्यावृत्य ।
text_mt: having turned back, [saying:] "The fathers have exhilarated themselves; like bulls they have exhilarated themselves, each according to his share."

sanskrit_iast: namo vaḥ pitaro jīvāya namo vaḥ pitaraḥ śoṣāya | namo vaḥ pitaro ghorāya namo vaḥ pitaro rasāya | namo vaḥ pitaro balāya namo vaḥ pitaro mṛtyave | namo vaḥ pitaro manyave namo vaḥ pitaraḥ svadhāyai | namo vaḥ pitaraḥ pitaro namo vaḥ | ye atra pitaraḥ pitaraḥ stha yūyam teṣām śreṣṭhā bhūyāstha | ya iha pitaro manuṣyā vayam teṣām śreṣṭhā bhūyāsma | yā atra pitaraḥ svadhā yuṣmākam sā | ya iha pitara edhatur asmākam sa | gṛhān naḥ pitaro datta iti |
meaning: नमो वः पितरो जीवाय नमो वः पितरः शोषाय । नमो वः पितरो घोराय नमो वः पितरो रसाय । नमो वः पितरो बलाय नमो वः पितरो मृत्यवे । नमो वः पितरो मन्यवे नमो वः पितरः स्वधायै । नमो वः पितरः पितरो नमो वः । ये अत्र पितरः पितरः स्थ यूयम् तेषाम् श्रेष्ठा भूयास्थ । य इह पितरो मनुष्या वयम् तेषाम् श्रेष्ठा भूयास्म । या अत्र पितरः स्वधा युष्माकम् सा । य इह पितर एधतुर् अस्माकम् स । गृहान् नः पितरो दत्त इति ।
text_mt:
Having poured water for washing in the very same way, [he recites:] / "Homage to you, O fathers, for life! Homage to you, O fathers, for drying up! Homage to you, O fathers, for dread! Homage to you, O fathers, for sap! Homage to you, O fathers, for strength! Homage to you, O fathers, for death! / Homage to you, O fathers, for wrath! Homage to you, O fathers, for the svadhā-call! Homage to you, O fathers, O fathers, homage to you! Whichever fathers are there, you are fathers; may you be the best among them!"
"Whichever men are fathers here, may we be the best among them! Whatever svadhā is there, O fathers, let that be yours! Whatever prosperity is here, O fathers, let that be ours! Give us homes, O fathers!"

sanskrit_iast: etad vaḥ pitaro vāso vadhvam pitara iti trīṇi sūtrāṇy upanyasya |
meaning: एतद् वः पितरो वासो वध्वम् पितर इति त्रीणि सूत्राण्य् उपन्यस्य ।
text_mt: Having laid down three threads, [saying:] "This is your garment, O fathers; wrap yourselves in it, O fathers!"

sanskrit_iast: ūrjam vahantīr amṛtam ghṛtam payaḥ kīlālam parisrutam | svadhā stha tarpayata naḥ pitṝn ity udaka śeṣam ninīya |
meaning: ऊर्जम् वहन्तीर् अमृतम् घृतम् पयः कीलालम् परिस्रुतम् । स्वधा स्थ तर्पयत नः पितॄन् इत्य् उदक शेषम् निनीय ।
text_mt: having poured out the remainder of the water, [reciting:] "Bringing nourishment, nectar, ghee, milk, sweet drink, and foaming liquor; you are svadhā, satisfy our fathers!"

sanskrit_iast: madhyama piṇḍam patnī putra kāmā prāśnīyāt | ā dhatta pitaro garbham kumāram puṣkara srajam | yathā iha puruṣo asat | iti |
meaning: मध्यम पिण्डम् पत्नी पुत्र कामा प्राश्नीयात् । आ धत्त पितरो गर्भम् कुमारम् पुष्कर स्रजम् । यथा इह पुरुषो असत् । इति ।
text_mt: The wife desirous of a son should eat the middle ball, [saying:] "Place a fetus [in me], O fathers, a boy garlanded with lotuses, so that there may be a man here."
and having thrown after it the grass cut in a single stroke,
the Agnihotra [is performed] with barley gruel alone in the evening and morning.
And the offering is made by oneself on the change of the moon.

sanskrit_iast: etena eva dharmeṇa anāhita agneḥ piṇḍa pitṛ yajñaḥ kriyeta |
meaning: एतेन एव धर्मेण अनाहित अग्नेः पिण्ड पितृ यज्ञः क्रियेत ।
text_mt: By this very rule the Piṇḍapitṛyajña of one who has not set up the sacred fires should be performed.
The duty of the Brahman priest is properly to the south [of the fires].
The reversal is occasioned by the sacrificer.
His seat is to the front of the sacrificer.
The casting away of the blade of grass is identical to that of the Hotṛ.
And at the beginning of an action, and when there is a change of place,

sanskrit_iast: bṛhaspatir brahmā sa yajñam pātu sa yajña patim sa mām pātu bṛhaspatir daivo brahma aham mānuṣo bhūr bhuvaḥ svar om ity upaviśya |
meaning: बृहस्पतिर् ब्रह्मा स यज्ञम् पातु स यज्ञ पतिम् स माम् पातु बृहस्पतिर् दैवो ब्रह्म अहम् मानुषो भूर् भुवः स्वर् ओम् इत्य् उपविश्य ।
text_mt: Having sat down with: 'Bṛhaspati is the Brahman priest; may he protect the sacrifice, may he protect the lord of the sacrifice, may he protect me. Bṛhaspati is the divine Brahman, I am the human. Bhūr bhuvaḥ svar, om,'
and [he undertakes] witnessing over all actions;
[and] restraining speech during [actions] accompanied by mantras.

sanskrit_iast: sarvāsu gatiṣu yathā vrajanty anyathā tataḥ pratyāyanti |
meaning: सर्वासु गतिषु यथा व्रजन्त्य् अन्यथा ततः प्रत्यायन्ति ।
text_mt: In all movements, in whatever way they go forward, in the reverse way they return from there.
He follows along when the fire is being brought forward.
His sitting down takes place together with the kindling wood.
A horse is [given] to the Brahman priest at the setting up of the sacred fires,

sanskrit_iast: karma prasavāya āmantrita om ity uktvā yathā karma prasauti |
meaning: कर्म प्रसवाय आमन्त्रित ओम् इत्य् उक्त्वा यथा कर्म प्रसौति ।
text_mt: Addressed for authorization of an action, having said 'Om', he authorizes [it] according to the action.
Restraint of speech [takes place] at the time of the Praṇītā water.

sanskrit_iast: iṣṭe ca sviṣṭakṛtyā anuyāja prasavena visargaḥ |
meaning: इष्टे च स्विष्टकृत्या अनुयाज प्रसवेन विसर्गः ।
text_mt: And when the Sviṣṭakṛt offering has been offered, release [occurs] through the authorization of the after-offerings.

sanskrit_iast: mitrasya tvā cakṣuṣā pratīkṣa iti prāśitram pratīkṣya |
meaning: मित्रस्य त्वा चक्षुषा प्रतीक्ष इति प्राशित्रम् प्रतीक्ष्य ।
text_mt: Having looked at the Prāśitra portion with: 'I look at thee with the eye of Mitra,'

sanskrit_iast: devasya tvā savituḥ prasave aśvinor bāhubhyām pūṣṇo hastābhyām pratigṛhṇāmi iti prtigṛhya |
meaning: देवस्य त्वा सवितुः प्रसवे अश्विनोर् बाहुभ्याम् पूष्णो हस्ताभ्याम् प्रतिगृह्णामि इति प्र्तिगृह्य ।
text_mt: having accepted [it] with: 'At the impulse of the divine Savitṛ, with the arms of the Aśvins, with the hands of Pūṣan, I accept thee,'

sanskrit_iast: pṛthivyās tvā nābhau sādayāmy adityā upastha iti prāg daṇḍam sthaṇḍile nidhāya |
meaning: पृथिव्यास् त्वा नाभौ सादयाम्य् अदित्या उपस्थ इति प्राग् दण्डम् स्थण्डिले निधाय ।
text_mt: having placed it on the bare ground with the handle to the east with: 'On the navel of the earth I set thee, in the lap of Aditi,'
and having taken the Prāśitra portion with the ring finger and the thumb,

sanskrit_iast: agneṣ ṭvā āsyena prāśnāmi iti prāśya asaṃkhādan |
meaning: अग्नेष् ट्वा आस्येन प्राश्नामि इति प्राश्य असंखादन् ।
text_mt: having consumed it without chewing with: 'With the mouth of Agni I consume thee,'

sanskrit_iast: prāṇapā asi prāṇam me pāhi iti nāsike mukham ca |
meaning: प्राणपा असि प्राणम् मे पाहि इति नासिके मुखम् च ।
text_mt: the two nostrils and the mouth with: 'Thou art the protector of breath, protect my breath;'

sanskrit_iast: cakṣuṣpā asi cakṣur me pāhi iti cakṣuṣī |
meaning: चक्षुष्पा असि चक्षुर् मे पाहि इति चक्षुषी ।
text_mt: the two eyes with: 'Thou art the protector of sight, protect my sight;'

sanskrit_iast: śrotrapā asi śrotram me pāhi iti śrotre |
meaning: श्रोत्रपा असि श्रोत्रम् मे पाहि इति श्रोत्रे ।
text_mt: the two ears with: 'Thou art the protector of hearing, protect my hearing;'

sanskrit_iast: indrasya tvā jaṭhare sādayāmi iti nābhim |
meaning: इन्द्रस्य त्वा जठरे सादयामि इति नाभिम् ।
text_mt: the navel with: 'In the belly of Indra I place thee.'

sanskrit_iast: śrotrapā asi śrotram me pāhi iti śrotre |
meaning: श्रोत्रपा असि श्रोत्रम् मे पाहि इति श्रोत्रे ।
text_mt: the two ears with: 'Thou art the protector of hearing, protect my hearing;'

sanskrit_iast: indrasya tvā jaṭhare sādayāmi iti nābhim |
meaning: इन्द्रस्य त्वा जठरे सादयामि इति नाभिम् ।
text_mt: the navel with: 'In the belly of Indra I place thee.'

sanskrit_iast: ko adāt kasmā adāt kāmo adāt kāmāya adāt | kāmo dātā kāmaḥ pratigrahītā kāma etat ta ity anvāhāryam pratigṛhya |
meaning: को अदात् कस्मा अदात् कामो अदात् कामाय अदात् । कामो दाता कामः प्रतिग्रहीता काम एतत् त इत्य् अन्वाहार्यम् प्रतिगृह्य ।
text_mt: Having received the anvāhārya cooked rice with: 'Who gave? To whom did he give? Desire gave; to desire he gave. Desire is the giver, desire the receiver; desire, this is thine,'
[and] being addressed with: 'O Brahman priest, I shall set forth,'

sanskrit_iast: deva savitar etam te yajñam prāhur bṛhaspataye brahmaṇe tena yajñam ava tena yajña patim tena mām ava devena savitrā prasūta iti japitvā om pratiṣṭha iti prasauti |
meaning: देव सवितर् एतम् ते यज्ञम् प्राहुर् बृहस्पतये ब्रह्मणे तेन यज्ञम् अव तेन यज्ञ पतिम् तेन माम् अव देवेन सवित्रा प्रसूत इति जपित्वा ओम् प्रतिष्ठ इति प्रसौति ।
text_mt: having muttered: 'O divine Savitṛ, this sacrifice they have proclaimed for thee, for Bṛhaspati the Brahman priest; through it protect the sacrifice, through it the lord of the sacrifice, through it protect me; impelled by the divine Savitṛ,' he authorizes with: 'Om, stand firm!'
When the Praṇītā waters are dismissed, there is the dismissal of the Brahman priest,
[and] the consuming of the Brahman priest's portion.

sanskrit_iast: adabdhena tvā cakṣuṣā avapaśyāmi rāyas poṣāya suprajāstvāya suvīryāya agner jihvā asi suhūr devebhyo dhāmne dhāmne me bhava yajuṣe yajuṣa ity ājyam avekṣate patnī |
meaning: अदब्धेन त्वा चक्षुषा अवपश्यामि रायस् पोषाय सुप्रजास्त्वाय सुवीर्याय अग्नेर् जिह्वा असि सुहूर् देवेभ्यो धाम्ने धाम्ने मे भव यजुषे यजुष इत्य् आज्यम् अवेक्षते पत्नी ।
text_mt: The sacrificer's wife gazes at the clarified butter with: 'With unblinking eye I look upon thee, for the increase of wealth, for good offspring, for heroic strength; thou art the tongue of Agni, invoking well for the gods; for every abode, for every formula, be mine.'

sanskrit_iast: tejo asi śukram asy amṛtam asi vaiśvadevam asi ity āsannam vedau yajamānaḥ |
meaning: तेजो असि शुक्रम् अस्य् अमृतम् असि वैश्वदेवम् असि इत्य् आसन्नम् वेदौ यजमानः ।

sanskrit_iast: dhruvā asadann ṛtasya yonau sukṛtasya loke tā viṣṇo pāhi pāhi yajñam pāhi yajña patim ity āsannāni havīṃṣy abhimṛśya | pāhi mām yajñanyam ity ātmānam |
meaning: ध्रुवा असदन्न् ऋतस्य योनौ सुकृतस्य लोके ता विष्णो पाहि पाहि यज्ञम् पाहि यज्ञ पतिम् इत्य् आसन्नानि हवींष्य् अभिमृश्य । पाहि माम् यज्ञन्यम् इत्य् आत्मानम् ।
text_mt:
The sacrificer [addresses the clarified butter] placed on the altar with: 'Thou art brilliance, thou art splendor, thou art nectar, thou art sacred to all the gods.' Having touched the oblations placed [there] with: 'Firmly have they sat in the womb of sacred order, in the world of the well-performed [deed]; do thou, O Viṣṇu, protect them, protect the sacrifice, protect the lord of the sacrifice,' [he touches] himself with: 'Protect me, the leader of the sacrifice.'
Having sipped water with: 'Thou art rain, tear away my sins; thou art knowledge, learn my sin,' having laid a kindling stick on the Āhavanīya fire with: 'O Agni, lord of vows, I shall perform a vow; may I be able [to do] it, may it succeed for me; here I go from untruth to truth,' he restrains his speech,
