sanskrit_iast: krītvā rājānam upanahya upasada upetya | prāyaṇīyam atirātram upetya | iṣṭvā sāmnāyyena adhvaryuḥ śamyām parāsya | tatra gārhapatyam nidhāya ṣaṭ ktriṃśat prakrameṣv āhavanīyam abhyādadhāti |
meaning: क्रीत्वा राजानम् उपनह्य उपसद उपेत्य । प्रायणीयम् अतिरात्रम् उपेत्य । इष्ट्वा साम्नाय्येन अध्वर्युः शम्याम् परास्य । तत्र गार्हपत्यम् निधाय षट् क्त्रिंशत् प्रक्रमेष्व् आहवनीयम् अभ्यादधाति ।
text_mt:
The consecration of the Sarasvatī session takes place at the disappearance of the Sarasvatī. Having purchased the King [Soma], tied him up, undergone the Upasads, and undergone the introductory Atirātra; having offered the curd and milk offering, the Adhvaryu hurls a yoke-pin;
having placed the Gārhapatya there, he sets up the Āhavanīya at [a distance of] thirty-six steps.

sanskrit_iast: tam etam āpūryamāṇa pakṣam āmāvāsyena yanti |
meaning: तम् एतम् आपूर्यमाण पक्षम् आमावास्येन यन्ति ।
text_mt: They go through this waxing fortnight with the New Moon rite.

sanskrit_iast: teṣām paurṇamāsyām gaur ukthyo bṛhat sāmā |
meaning: तेषाम् पौर्णमास्याम् गौर् उक्थ्यो बृहत् सामा ।
text_mt: On their Full Moon day, there is a Gauḥ Ukthya day with the Bṛhat chant.

sanskrit_iast: tam etam apakṣīyamāṇa pakṣam paurṇamāsyena yanti |
meaning: तम् एतम् अपक्षीयमाण पक्षम् पौर्णमास्येन यन्ति ।
text_mt: They go through this waning fortnight with the Full Moon rite.

sanskrit_iast: teṣām amāvāsyāyām āyur ukthyo rathantara sāmā |
meaning: तेषाम् अमावास्यायाम् आयुर् उक्थ्यो रथन्तर सामा ।
text_mt: On their New Moon day, there is an Āyus Ukthya day with the Rathantara chant.
They proceed upstream with the former wing.
Having offered a boiled rice-mess to Apāṃ Napāt;

sanskrit_iast: tad asya anīkam asmin pada ity aponaputriyasya |
meaning: तद् अस्य अनीकम् अस्मिन् पद इत्य् अपोनपुत्रियस्य ।
text_mt: "That face of his in this place" [RV 10.8.5a] is [the offering verse] for the one dedicated to Apāṃ Napāt.
When there are a hundred cows, they let loose a bull among them.
When a thousand are reached, then comes the conclusion;

sanskrit_iast: klākṣam vā prasravaṇam prāpya agnaye kāmāya iṣṭim nirvapanti |
meaning: क्लाक्षम् वा प्रस्रवणम् प्राप्य अग्नये कामाय इष्टिम् निर्वपन्ति ।
text_mt: or, having reached the fountain Plakṣaprāsravaṇa, they offer an iṣṭi to Agni Kāma.

sanskrit_iast: tasyām aśvām ca pauruṣīm ca dhenuke dattvā kāra pacavam prati yamunām avabhṛtham abhyavayanti |
meaning: तस्याम् अश्वाम् च पौरुषीम् च धेनुके दत्त्वा कार पचवम् प्रति यमुनाम् अवभृथम् अभ्यवयन्ति ।
text_mt: At that [iṣṭi], having given a mare and a female slave as milch cows, they go down to the Yamunā at Kārapacava for the purificatory bath.
This is the session of Mitra and Varuṇa.

sanskrit_iast: atirātro abhijid viśvajitau go āyuṣī indra kukṣī atirātraḥ |
meaning: अतिरात्रो अभिजिद् विश्वजितौ गो आयुषी इन्द्र कुक्षी अतिरात्रः ।
text_mt: An Atirātra, the Abhijit and Viśvajit, the Go and Āyus days, the Indra-kukṣi [days], and an Atirātra—

sanskrit_iast: atirātro jyotir gaur āyur viśvajid abhijitāv indra kukṣī atirātraḥ |
meaning: अतिरात्रो ज्योतिर् गौर् आयुर् विश्वजिद् अभिजिताव् इन्द्र कुक्षी अतिरात्रः ।
text_mt: An Atirātra, the Jyotis, Gauḥ, Āyus, Viśvajit and Abhijit, the Indra-kukṣi [days], and an Atirātra—
For a year he should tend the cows of a brahmin.
For a year he should kindle the fire at Vyarṇa Naitaṃdhava.

sanskrit_iast: saṃvatsare parīṇahy agnīn ādhāya dṛṣadvatyā dakṣiṇena tīreṇa āgneyena aṣṭā kapālena śamyā parāse śamyā parāse yajamāna eti |
meaning: संवत्सरे परीणह्य् अग्नीन् आधाय दृषद्वत्या दक्षिणेन तीरेण आग्नेयेन अष्टा कपालेन शम्या परासे शम्या परासे यजमान एति ।
text_mt: After a year, having set up the fires at Parīṇah, along the southern bank of the Dṛṣadvatī, offering an eight-pot-sherd cake to Agni at each throw of a yoke-pin, the sacrificer proceeds.

sanskrit_iast: triḥ prakṣām prati yamunām avabhṛtham abhyavayanti |
meaning: त्रिः प्रक्षाम् प्रति यमुनाम् अवभृथम् अभ्यवयन्ति ।
text_mt: Opposite Triplakṣā, they go down to the Yamunā for the purificatory bath.

sanskrit_iast: atirātraḥ sahasram trivṛtaḥ saṃvatsarā atirātraḥ prajāpateḥ sahasra saṃvatsaram sahasra saṃvatsaram |
meaning: अतिरात्रः सहस्रम् त्रिवृतः संवत्सरा अतिरात्रः प्रजापतेः सहस्र संवत्सरम् सहस्र संवत्सरम् ।
text_mt: An Atirātra, a thousand Trivṛt years, and an Atirātra are Prajāpati's thousand-year sacrifice, his thousand-year sacrifice.
In one-day sacrifices and Ahīnas, there is modification of the base form.

sanskrit_iast: yasminn ahani yad ahaḥ pradiśyeta savanam vā sahautram tat |
meaning: यस्मिन्न् अहनि यद् अहः प्रदिश्येत सवनम् वा सहौत्रम् तत् ।
text_mt: On whichever day a [particular] day or pressing is prescribed, that carries along its Hotṛ functions.

sanskrit_iast: agny ādheyena brahma varcasa kāmo yajeta |
meaning: अग्न्य् आधेयेन ब्रह्म वर्चस कामो यजेत ।
text_mt: One who desires spiritual lustre should sacrifice with the Agnyādheya [sacrifice].
Its stotras are in eight [verses] each.
The Gāyatrī is splendour and spiritual lustre.

sanskrit_iast: etena triḥ samṛddhena brahmaṇā tejo brahma varcasam āpnoti |
meaning: एतेन त्रिः समृद्धेन ब्रह्मणा तेजो ब्रह्म वर्चसम् आप्नोति ।
text_mt: By this threefoldly perfected sacred power, he attains splendour and spiritual lustre.

sanskrit_iast: trivṛd vā annam annam pānam khādayanti tasya sarvasya āptyai |
meaning: त्रिवृद् वा अन्नम् अन्नम् पानम् खादयन्ति तस्य सर्वस्य आप्त्यै ।
text_mt: Food is threefold: food, drink, and chewable food; [this is] for obtaining all of that.
Twenty-four [cows are] the sacrificial fee.

sanskrit_iast: catur viṃśatir vai saṃvatsarasya ardha māsāḥ saṃvatsarasya eva āptyai |
meaning: चतुर् विंशतिर् वै संवत्सरस्य अर्ध मासाः संवत्सरस्य एव आप्त्यै ।
text_mt: Twenty-four indeed are the half-months of the year; [this is] just for obtaining the year.

sanskrit_iast: tasya agnaye pavamānāya pāvakāya śucaya iti paśava upālambhyāḥ savanīyasya |
meaning: तस्य अग्नये पवमानाय पावकाय शुचय इति पशव उपालम्भ्याः सवनीयस्य ।
text_mt: For it, animals to Agni Pavamāna, to Pāvaka, [and] to Śuci are to be seized in place of the savanīya animal.

sanskrit_iast: ādityā vaśā anubandhyāyā upālambhya evam vidhā |
meaning: आदित्या वशा अनुबन्ध्याया उपालम्भ्य एवम् विधा ।
text_mt: A barren cow to Aditi is to be seized in place of the subsequently bound victim of this kind.

sanskrit_iast: tad yad evam paśavo niyuktā bhavanti na id agny ādheyād ayāni iti |
meaning: तद् यद् एवम् पशवो नियुक्ता भवन्ति न इद् अग्न्य् आधेयाद् अयानि इति ।
text_mt: The reason why the animals are bound thus is: 'Lest I depart from the establishment of the fires'.

sanskrit_iast: tasya prātaḥ savanīyān anu puroḷāśān agnaye pavamānāya aṣṭa kapālam puroḷāśam nirvapati |
meaning: तस्य प्रातः सवनीयान् अनु पुरोऌआशान् अग्नये पवमानाय अष्ट कपालम् पुरोऌआशम् निर्वपति ।
text_mt: For it, following the morning-pressing sacrificial cakes, he offers an eight-pot-sherd sacrificial cake to Agni Pavamāna.
Following the midday-pressing sacrificial cakes, [he offers one] to Agni Pāvaka.

sanskrit_iast: tṛtīya savanīyān anu puroḷāśān agnaye śucaye |
meaning: तृतीय सवनीयान् अनु पुरोऌआशान् अग्नये शुचये ।
text_mt: Following the third-pressing sacrificial cakes, [he offers one] to Agni Śuci.

sanskrit_iast: āvapanam vai savanīyāḥ puroḷāśāḥ | āvapana eva tad āvapati |
meaning: आवपनम् वै सवनीयाः पुरोऌआशाः । आवपन एव तद् आवपति ।
text_mt: The savanīya sacrificial cakes are indeed an insertion; he inserts that into the very insertion.

sanskrit_iast: atha yad ādityā vaśā anubandhyāyā upālambhyā bhavaty aditim vā anvagny ādheyam saṃtiṣṭhate |
meaning: अथ यद् आदित्या वशा अनुबन्ध्याया उपालम्भ्या भवत्य् अदितिम् वा अन्वग्न्य् आधेयम् संतिष्ठते ।
text_mt: Now, as to why a barren cow to Aditi is to be seized in place of the subsequently bound victim: the establishment of the fires concludes along with Aditi.

sanskrit_iast: yā anvagny ādheyasya saṃsthā tām eva tad yajñasya saṃsthām karoti |
meaning: या अन्वग्न्य् आधेयस्य संस्था ताम् एव तद् यज्ञस्य संस्थाम् करोति ।
text_mt: Whatever is the conclusion of the establishment of the fires, he thereby makes that very conclusion for the sacrifice.

sanskrit_iast: evam paśavaḥ puroḷāśāś ca anvāyāty ante havir yajñeṣu someṣu |
meaning: एवम् पशवः पुरोऌआशाश् च अन्वायात्य् अन्ते हविर् यज्ञेषु सोमेषु ।
text_mt: Thus the animals and the sacrificial cakes are appended in the havis sacrifices [and] in the Soma sacrifices.
The triplet 'yad vāhiṣṭham' is the ājya-śastra.
The Prauga-śastra is the one belonging to Madhucchandas.

sanskrit_iast: trayas trayas tṛcā hotrakāṇām prātaḥ savane stotriya anurūpau paryāsaś ca |
meaning: त्रयस् त्रयस् तृचा होत्रकाणाम् प्रातः सवने स्तोत्रिय अनुरूपौ पर्यासश् च ।
text_mt: Three triplets each belong to the Hotrakas at the morning pressing: the stotriya, anurūpa, and the paryāsa.

sanskrit_iast: indra marutva iha pāhi somam iti tṛcam marutvatīyam |
meaning: इन्द्र मरुत्व इह पाहि सोमम् इति तृचम् मरुत्वतीयम् ।
text_mt: The triplet 'indra marutva iha pāhi somam' is the Marutvatīya-śastra.

sanskrit_iast: nṛṇām u tvā nṛtamam gīrbhir ukthair iti tṛcam niṣkevalyam |
meaning: नृणाम् उ त्वा नृतमम् गीर्भिर् उक्थैर् इति तृचम् निष्केवल्यम् ।
text_mt: The triplet 'nṛṇām u tvā nṛtamam gīrbhir ukthaiḥ' is the Niṣkevalya-śastra.

sanskrit_iast: adhvaryo vīra pra mahe sutānām iti tṛcam maitrā varuṇasya uktha mukhīyam |
meaning: अध्वर्यो वीर प्र महे सुतानाम् इति तृचम् मैत्रा वरुणस्य उक्थ मुखीयम् ।
text_mt: The triplet 'adhvaryo vīra pra mahe sutānām' is the opening verse of the uktha for the Maitrāvaruṇa priest.
The preceding one is for the Brāhmaṇācchaṃsin.

sanskrit_iast: ud u ṣya devaḥ savitā hiraṇyayā | ghṛtavatī bhuvanānām | indra ṛbhubhir vājavadbhiḥ | svasti no mimītām | vaiśvānaram manasā | pra yantu vājāḥ | samiddham agnim samidhā girā gṛṇa iti tṛcāni vaiśvadeva āgni mārutayoḥ sūktānām sthāne |
meaning: उद् उ ष्य देवः सविता हिरण्यया । घृतवती भुवनानाम् । इन्द्र ऋभुभिर् वाजवद्भिः । स्वस्ति नो मिमीताम् । वैश्वानरम् मनसा । प्र यन्तु वाजाः । समिद्धम् अग्निम् समिधा गिरा गृण इति तृचानि वैश्वदेव आग्नि मारुतयोः सूक्तानाम् स्थाने ।
text_mt: The triplets 'ud u ṣya devaḥ savitā hiraṇyayā', 'ghṛtavatī bhuvanānām', 'indra ṛbhubhir vājavadbhiḥ', 'svasti no mimītām', 'vaiśvānaram manasā', 'pra yantu vājāḥ', and 'samiddham agnim samidhā girā gṛṇe' take the place of the hymns of the Vaiśvadeva-śastra and Āgnimāruta-śastra.

sanskrit_iast: tṛca klṛptam ity etasyām codanāyām etat śastram pratīyeta |
meaning: तृच क्लृप्तम् इत्य् एतस्याम् चोदनायाम् एतत् शस्त्रम् प्रतीयेत ।
text_mt: Under this injunction 'arranged in triplets', this recitation is to be understood.
Or the one-day ritual is arranged in triplets.
By this the two Agnihotra sacrifices are explained.
Milk to Agni belongs to the former.

sanskrit_iast: prājāpatyā vaśā anubandhyāyā upālabhya evam vidhā |
meaning: प्राजापत्या वशा अनुबन्ध्याया उपालभ्य एवम् विधा ।
text_mt: A barren cow to Prajāpati is to be seized in place of the subsequently bound victim of this kind.
One desirous of fiery energy should sacrifice with the Punarādheya.
Its chants are on five verses each.
The recitation is from the Agniṣṭut which is entirely dedicated to Agni.

sanskrit_iast: darśa pūrṇa māsāv anna adya kāmasya |
meaning: दर्श पूर्ण मासाव् अन्न अद्य कामस्य ।
text_mt: The New and Full Moon sacrifices are for one desirous of food to eat.

sanskrit_iast: iḷādadhāv āgrayaṇaḥ soma iṣṭiś ca apravargyaḥ |
meaning: इऌआदधाव् आग्रयणः सोम इष्टिश् च अप्रवर्ग्यः ।
text_mt: In the Iḷādadha [ritual], the Āgrayaṇa is a Soma sacrifice, and it is without the Pravargya.
The four Dākṣāyaṇa sacrifices are for one desirous of all desires.
In it the offerings of the seasonal sacrifices are appended.
And animals for the deities of the seasonal periods.

sanskrit_iast: eka kapāla devatābhyaś ca anubandhyāyā upālambhyā evam vidhāḥ |
meaning: एक कपाल देवताभ्यश् च अनुबन्ध्याया उपालम्भ्या एवम् विधाः ।
text_mt: And barren cows of this kind for the deities of the single-pot-sherd cakes are to be seized in place of the subsequently bound victim.

sanskrit_iast: prajāpatir ha prajāti kāmas tapas taptvā etam yajña kratum apaśyad vaiśvadevam | tam āharat | tena ayajata | tena iṣṭvā prājāyata | tena prajāti kāmo yajeta |
meaning: प्रजापतिर् ह प्रजाति कामस् तपस् तप्त्वा एतम् यज्ञ क्रतुम् अपश्यद् वैश्वदेवम् । तम् आहरत् । तेन अयजत । तेन इष्ट्वा प्राजायत । तेन प्रजाति कामो यजेत ।
text_mt: Prajāpati, desirous of offspring, performed asceticism and saw this sacrificial rite, the Vaiśvadeva; he took it; he sacrificed with it; having sacrificed with it, he procreated; one desirous of offspring should sacrifice with it.
An animal to the Viśve Devas is to be seized in place of the savanīya animal.

sanskrit_iast: dyāvā pṛthivīyā vaśā anubandhyāyā upālambhyā evam vidhā |
meaning: द्यावा पृथिवीया वशा अनुबन्ध्याया उपालम्भ्या एवम् विधा ।
text_mt: A barren cow to Dyāvāpṛthivī is to be seized in place of the subsequently bound victim of this kind.

sanskrit_iast: avabhṛthād udetya udavasānīyayā iṣṭvā muni sattra iṣṭyā yajamāna āste ahar ahaś caturo māsān āgneyyā āgnā vaiṣṇavyā vā antarāleṣu |
meaning: अवभृथाद् उदेत्य उदवसानीयया इष्ट्वा मुनि सत्त्र इष्ट्या यजमान आस्ते अहर् अहश् चतुरो मासान् आग्नेय्या आग्ना वैष्णव्या वा अन्तरालेषु ।
text_mt: Having emerged from the purificatory bath and having sacrificed with the concluding departure sacrifice, the sacrificer sits down [to perform] the Muni-sattra sacrifice, day by day for four months, with an offering to Agni or to Agni and Viṣṇu in the intervals.

sanskrit_iast: vaiśvadevena vai prajāpatiḥ prajā asṛjata | tāḥ sṛṣṭā aprasūtā varuṇasya yavān jakṣuḥ | tāḥ varuṇo varuṇa pāśaiḥ pratyamuñcat | tāḥ prajāḥ prajāpatim pitaram etya upādhāvan | upa tam yajña kratum jānīhi yena iṣṭvā varuṇa pāśebhyaḥ sarvasmāc ca pāpmanaḥ sampramucyemahi iti | tata etam prajāpatiś caturthe māsi dvirātram yajña kratum apaśyad varuṇa pragāsam | tam āharat | tena ayajata | tena iṣṭvā varuṇam aprīṇāt | sa prīto varuṇo varuṇa pāśebhyaḥ sarvasmāc ca pāpmanaḥ prajā prāmuñcat | pra ha vā asya prajā varuṇa pāśebhyaḥ sarvasmāc ca pāpmanaḥ sampramucyate ya evaṃvidvān varuṇa praghāsair yajate |
meaning: वैश्वदेवेन वै प्रजापतिः प्रजा असृजत । ताः सृष्टा अप्रसूता वरुणस्य यवान् जक्षुः । ताः वरुणो वरुण पाशैः प्रत्यमुञ्चत् । ताः प्रजाः प्रजापतिम् पितरम् एत्य उपाधावन् । उप तम् यज्ञ क्रतुम् जानीहि येन इष्ट्वा वरुण पाशेभ्यः सर्वस्माच् च पाप्मनः सम्प्रमुच्येमहि इति । तत एतम् प्रजापतिश् चतुर्थे मासि द्विरात्रम् यज्ञ क्रतुम् अपश्यद् वरुण प्रगासम् । तम् आहरत् । तेन अयजत । तेन इष्ट्वा वरुणम् अप्रीणात् । स प्रीतो वरुणो वरुण पाशेभ्यः सर्वस्माच् च पाप्मनः प्रजा प्रामुञ्चत् । प्र ह वा अस्य प्रजा वरुण पाशेभ्यः सर्वस्माच् च पाप्मनः सम्प्रमुच्यते य एवंविद्वान् वरुण प्रघासैर् यजते ।
text_mt:
With the Vaiśvadeva, Prajāpati created creatures.

Being created, not yet delivered, they ate the barley of Varuṇa.

Varuṇa bound them with the fetters of Varuṇa.

Those creatures approached and ran to Prajāpati, their father,

[saying]: 'Find that sacrificial rite by sacrificing with which we may be freed from the fetters of Varuṇa and from all evil!'

Then Prajāpati saw this two-night sacrificial rite in the fourth month, the Varuṇapraghāsa.

He took it; he sacrificed with it.

Having sacrificed with it, he propitiated Varuṇa.

Varuṇa, being pleased, freed the creatures from Varuṇa's nooses and from all evil.

Verily, his creatures are completely freed from Varuṇa's nooses and from all evil, who knowing thus sacrifices with the Varuṇapraghāsa offerings.
On the former [day], an animal for Varuṇa is to be seized in place of the savanīya victim;

sanskrit_iast: kāyī vaśā anūbandhyāyā upālambhyā evam vidhā |
meaning: कायी वशा अनूबन्ध्याया उपालम्भ्या एवम् विधा ।
text_mt: A barren cow for Ka is to be seized in place of the subsequently bound victim; in such manner [it is performed].

sanskrit_iast: tāḥ prajāḥ prajāpatim abruvan kasmai nu no anna adyāya asṛṣṭhā iti | tata etam prajāpatiś caturthe māsi trirātram yajña kratum apaśyat sāka medham | tam āharat | tena ayajata | tena iṣṭvā anna adyam āpnot | tena anna adya kāmo yajeta |
meaning: ताः प्रजाः प्रजापतिम् अब्रुवन् कस्मै नु नो अन्न अद्याय असृष्ठा इति । तत एतम् प्रजापतिश् चतुर्थे मासि त्रिरात्रम् यज्ञ क्रतुम् अपश्यत् साक मेधम् । तम् आहरत् । तेन अयजत । तेन इष्ट्वा अन्न अद्यम् आप्नोत् । तेन अन्न अद्य कामो यजेत ।
text_mt:
Those creatures said to Prajāpati: 'For what food have you created us?'

Then, in the fourth month, Prajāpati saw this three-day sacrificial rite, the Sākamedha.

Having sacrificed with it, he attained food.

One desiring food should sacrifice with it.
An Agniṣṭoma, an Ukthya, and an Atirātra [are the three days].

sanskrit_iast: agnaye anīkavate prathame paśur upālambhyaḥ savanīyasya |
meaning: अग्नये अनीकवते प्रथमे पशुर् उपालम्भ्यः सवनीयस्य ।
text_mt: On the first [day], an animal for Agni Anīkavat is to be seized in place of the savanīya victim;
on the second, for the Santapana Maruts;

sanskrit_iast: vaiśvakarmaṇī vaśā anūbandhyāyā upālambhyā evam vidhā |
meaning: वैश्वकर्मणी वशा अनूबन्ध्याया उपालम्भ्या एवम् विधा ।
text_mt: A barren cow for Viśvakarman is to be seized in place of the subsequently bound victim; in such manner [it is performed].
The recitation is like that of a one-day rite, or according to the Pṛṣṭhya [ṣaḍaha].

sanskrit_iast: viśvajito vā bṛhat pṛṣṭhāt tṛtīye ahani śastram |
meaning: विश्वजितो वा बृहत् पृष्ठात् तृतीये अहनि शस्त्रम् ।
text_mt: Or on the third day the recitation is from the Viśvajit with the Bṛhat as pṛṣṭha-stotra,
in the rite for one desiring long life, in the Mahāyajña,

sanskrit_iast: tāḥ prajāḥ prajāpatim abruvan kasyai nu naḥ pratiṣṭhāyā asṛṣṭhā iti | tata etam prajāpatir yajña kratum apaśyat śunāsīrīyam | tam āharat | tena ayajata | tena iṣṭvā pratyatiṣṭhata | tena pratiṣṭhā kāmo yajeta |
meaning: ताः प्रजाः प्रजापतिम् अब्रुवन् कस्यै नु नः प्रतिष्ठाया असृष्ठा इति । तत एतम् प्रजापतिर् यज्ञ क्रतुम् अपश्यत् शुनासीरीयम् । तम् आहरत् । तेन अयजत । तेन इष्ट्वा प्रत्यतिष्ठत । तेन प्रतिष्ठा कामो यजेत ।
text_mt:
Those creatures said to Prajāpati: 'Upon what support have you created us?'

Then Prajāpati saw this sacrificial rite, the Śunāsīrīya.

He took it; he sacrificed with it.

Having sacrificed with it, he found firm support.

One desiring firm support should sacrifice with it.
An animal for Śunāsīra is to be seized in place of the savanīya victim.

sanskrit_iast: saurī vaśā anūbandhyāyā upālambhyā evam vidhā |
meaning: सौरी वशा अनूबन्ध्याया उपालम्भ्या एवम् विधा ।
text_mt: A barren cow for Sūrya is to be seized in place of the subsequently bound victim; in such manner [it is performed].
At the Vaiśvadeva he gives twenty [cows as sacrificial fee];
at the Varuṇapraghāsas, thirty;
at the Sākamedhas, fifty;
Indeed, one hundred and twenty are the days of a season.
In the four-month sacrifices accompanied by animal victims:
on the preceding day is the animal ritual;
on the following day is the animal sacrifice for the Viśve Devas.

sanskrit_iast: paśu puroḷāśam anu cāturmāsya devatā yathā parva |
meaning: पशु पुरोऌआशम् अनु चातुर्मास्य देवता यथा पर्व ।
text_mt: Following the sacrificial cake for the animal, the deities of the four-month sacrifice are [worshipped] according to the seasonal period.
It concludes with the spit for roasting the heart.
At the Varuṇapraghāsas there are [two animals,] one for Varuṇa and one for the Maruts.
They erect the sacrificial post on the northern [altar].
At the latter two [four-month sacrifices], [the animals are] for Mahendra and for Śunāsīra.
Or the animals are offered according to each deity.
That is explained by the eleven-victim set.

sanskrit_iast: ānīkavataḥ sāṃtapano gṛha medhīyaḥ krīlino maitraś ca mahā haviṣi |
meaning: आनीकवतः सांतपनो गृह मेधीयः क्रीलिनो मैत्रश् च महा हविषि ।
text_mt: The animal for Agni Anīkavat, that for the Santapana Maruts, for the Gṛhamedhīya, for the Krīḍin Maruts, and for Mitra-Varuṇa [or Mitra] at the Mahāhavis.
: Or at each seasonal joint [the sacrifice] ends with the victim to Indra and Agni.

sanskrit_iast: athavā apy eka parvaṇy eka paśau ca aindrāgne parāñci havīṃṣi |
meaning: अथवा अप्य् एक पर्वण्य् एक पशौ च ऐन्द्राग्ने पराञ्चि हवींषि ।
text_mt: : Alternatively, even when there is a single seasonal joint and a single victim to Indra and Agni, the oblations follow in order.

sanskrit_iast: tryambakād ūrdhvam anuyāja prabhṛti | manotā ādi paśunā vā |
meaning: त्र्यम्बकाद् ऊर्ध्वम् अनुयाज प्रभृति । मनोता आदि पशुना वा ।
text_mt: : After the Tryambaka [offerings], beginning with the after-offerings, or beginning with the Manotā [hymn] for the animal victim.
: All the animal sacrifices have the same sacrificial fees as the Soma sacrifices.
: The animal sacrifices have the sacrificial fees of the seasonal animal sacrifices.
: The Pratyavarohaṇīya [rite is] for one who desires firm standing.
: It is a Jyotiṣṭoma modified in its ritual intention.
: The Paśubandha [is] for one who desires cattle.
: The triṣṭubh metre has eleven syllables.

sanskrit_iast: pibā somam abhi yam ugra tarda etāyāma upa gavyanta indram iti nividdhāne |
meaning: पिबा सोमम् अभि यम् उग्र तर्द एतायाम उप गव्यन्त इन्द्रम् इति निविद्धाने ।
text_mt: : "Drink the soma, towards which, O fierce piercer..." [and] "Let us go towards Indra, seeking cattle..." are the two [hymns containing] the insertion of the deity's name.

sanskrit_iast: ūrdhvam gavyam mahi gṛṇāna indra etāyāma upa gavyanta indram iti go saṃstave tad etasya ahno rūpam |
meaning: ऊर्ध्वम् गव्यम् महि गृणान इन्द्र एतायाम उप गव्यन्त इन्द्रम् इति गो संस्तवे तद् एतस्य अह्नो रूपम् ।
text_mt: : "Upwards, bovine...", "Greatly praised, O Indra...", "Let us go towards Indra, seeking cattle..."—this praise of cows is the characteristic mark of this day.
: And in the Udbhid, the Valabhid, and the Gosava.

sanskrit_iast: indro ha āyuṣ kāmas tapas tepe | sa tapas taptvā etam yajña kratum apaśyat sautrāmaṇam | tam āharat | tena ayajata | tena iṣṭvā dīrgha āyutvam agacchat | tam u ha bharadvājāya jīrṇāya provāca | anena vā aham iṣṭvā dīrgha āyutvam agaccham anena api tvam yaja iti | tena ha bharadvāja iṣṭvā sarva āyutvam agacchat | sarvam āyur eti ya evam veda ya u ca etena yajate |
meaning: इन्द्रो ह आयुष् कामस् तपस् तेपे । स तपस् तप्त्वा एतम् यज्ञ क्रतुम् अपश्यत् सौत्रामणम् । तम् आहरत् । तेन अयजत । तेन इष्ट्वा दीर्घ आयुत्वम् अगच्छत् । तम् उ ह भरद्वाजाय जीर्णाय प्रोवाच । अनेन वा अहम् इष्ट्वा दीर्घ आयुत्वम् अगच्छम् अनेन अपि त्वम् यज इति । तेन ह भरद्वाज इष्ट्वा सर्व आयुत्वम् अगच्छत् । सर्वम् आयुर् एति य एवम् वेद य उ च एतेन यजते ।
text_mt:
: Now then, the Sautrāmaṇa:
Indra, desiring long life, practiced austerity. Having practiced austerity, he saw this sacrificial rite, the Sautrāmaṇa. He took it; he sacrificed with it. Having sacrificed with it, he attained long life.
: He proclaimed it to Bharadvāja when he had grown old: "By sacrificing with this I attained long life; do you also sacrifice with this." Having sacrificed with it, Bharadvāja attained full lifespan. He who knows this, and he who sacrifices with it, attains full lifespan.
: Its pṛṣṭha-sāman is the Rathantara.
: The sacrificial fee is according to faith.
: There are three nine-verse stotras,

sanskrit_iast: uttara uttarāvad dīrgha āyutvam aśravāmahā iti |
meaning: उत्तर उत्तरावद् दीर्घ आयुत्वम् अश्रवामहा इति ।
text_mt: : [with the thought:] "May we attain long life increasing higher and higher."

sanskrit_iast: tasya aśvino loho ajaḥ sārasvatī meṣī iti paśū upalambhyau savanīyasya |
meaning: तस्य अश्विनो लोहो अजः सारस्वती मेषी इति पशू उपलम्भ्यौ सवनीयस्य ।
text_mt: : Its victims to be seized in addition to the pressing victim are a reddish-brown he-goat for the Aśvins and an ewe for Sarasvatī.

sanskrit_iast: indrāya sutrāmṇe vaśā anūbandhyāyā upālambhyā evam vidhā |
meaning: इन्द्राय सुत्राम्णे वशा अनूबन्ध्याया उपालम्भ्या एवम् विधा ।
text_mt: : For Indra Sutrāman a barren cow is to be seized in addition to the subsequently bound victim; such is the rule.

sanskrit_iast: tad yad evam paśavo niyukā bhavanti net sautrāmaṇyā ayāni iti |
meaning: तद् यद् एवम् पशवो नियुका भवन्ति नेत् सौत्रामण्या अयानि इति ।
text_mt: : As to why the animals are thus assigned, [it is with the thought:] "Lest I depart from the Sautrāmaṇī."

sanskrit_iast: tasya prātaḥ savanīyān anu puroḷāśān bāhyato agnim upasamādhāya surā somena caranti |
meaning: तस्य प्रातः सवनीयान् अनु पुरोऌआशान् बाह्यतो अग्निम् उपसमाधाय सुरा सोमेन चरन्ति ।
text_mt: : Following its morning pressing cakes, having piled up fire on the outside, they proceed with the surā-soma.

sanskrit_iast: tṛtīya savanīyān anu puroḷāśān sāvitram dvādaśa kapālam puroḷāśam nirvapati |
meaning: तृतीय सवनीयान् अनु पुरोऌआशान् सावित्रम् द्वादश कपालम् पुरोऌआशम् निर्वपति ।
text_mt: : Following the cakes of the third pressing, he distributes the twelve-pot-sherd sacrificial cake to Savitṛ.

sanskrit_iast: āvapanam vai savanīyāḥ puroḷāśā āvapana eva tad āvapati |
meaning: आवपनम् वै सवनीयाः पुरोऌआशा आवपन एव तद् आवपति ।
text_mt: : The pressing cakes are indeed an insertion-base; he thus inserts it right into the insertion-base.

sanskrit_iast: atha yad indrāya sutrāmṇe vaśā anūbandhyāyā upālambhyā bhavati indram vā anu sutrāmāṇam sautrāmaṇī saṃtiṣṭhate |
meaning: अथ यद् इन्द्राय सुत्राम्णे वशा अनूबन्ध्याया उपालम्भ्या भवति इन्द्रम् वा अनु सुत्रामाणम् सौत्रामणी संतिष्ठते ।
text_mt: : Now, as for the fact that a barren cow is to be seized in addition to the subsequently bound victim for Indra Sutrāman, the Sautrāmaṇī concludes in accordance with Indra Sutrāman.

sanskrit_iast: yā eva sautrāmaṇyāḥ saṃsthā tām eva tad yajñasya saṃsthā karoti |
meaning: या एव सौत्रामण्याः संस्था ताम् एव तद् यज्ञस्य संस्था करोति ।
text_mt: : Whatever is the conclusion of the Sautrāmaṇī, he thus makes that the conclusion of the sacrifice.
: Some indeed perform it as an Atirātra,

sanskrit_iast: eka viṃśati stomam bṛhat pṛṣṭham ubhaya sāmānam |
meaning: एक विंशति स्तोमम् बृहत् पृष्ठम् उभय सामानम् ।
text_mt: : with a twenty-one-fold stoma, the Bṛhat as pṛṣṭha-sāman, and having both chants.

sanskrit_iast: tasya yad viśvajito bṛhat pṛṣṭhasya śastram tat śastram |
meaning: तस्य यद् विश्वजितो बृहत् पृष्ठस्य शस्त्रम् तत् शस्त्रम् ।
text_mt: : Whatever is the recitation of the Viśvajit with the Bṛhat pṛṣṭha-sāman, that is its recitation.
: Here the oblational soma sacrifices come to an end.

sanskrit_iast: devā ha paśu kāmāś caturo māsān vratam caritvā etam udbhidam yajña kratum apaśyan | tena paśūn āpuḥ | tena paśu kāmo yajeta | udbhidā iṣṭvā yadi manyeta cirān mā paśava āgur iti caturo māsān vratam caritvā balabhidā yajeta | kṣipram ha enam paśava āyanti |
meaning: देवा ह पशु कामाश् चतुरो मासान् व्रतम् चरित्वा एतम् उद्भिदम् यज्ञ क्रतुम् अपश्यन् । तेन पशून् आपुः । तेन पशु कामो यजेत । उद्भिदा इष्ट्वा यदि मन्येत चिरान् मा पशव आगुर् इति चतुरो मासान् व्रतम् चरित्वा बलभिदा यजेत । क्षिप्रम् ह एनम् पशव आयन्ति ।
text_mt: : The gods, desiring cattle, observed a vow for four months and saw this sacrificial rite, the Udbhid. By it they obtained cattle. One desiring cattle should sacrifice with it. Having sacrificed with the Udbhid, if he should think, "Cattle have been slow to come to me," having observed a vow for four months, he should sacrifice with the Balabhid. Quickly indeed do cattle come to him.
: One desiring cattle should sacrifice with the Gosava,
: The bṛhatī metre has thirty-six syllables.
: Thirty-six thousand [cows] is the sacrificial fee of the Gosava,
: One desiring fiery splendor should sacrifice with the Ṛtapeya.
: There are twelve initiatory days and twelve Upasads.

sanskrit_iast: madhyamena aṅguṣṭha parvaṇā audumbaram camasam mitam ghṛtasya vratayet |
meaning: मध्यमेन अङ्गुष्ठ पर्वणा औदुम्बरम् चमसम् मितम् घृतस्य व्रतयेत् ।
text_mt: : He should consume as his vow food ghee measured in an udumbara cup by the middle joint of the thumb.
: On the odd-numbered days of the initiation, milk-porridge.
: A soma cup of the pressed [soma] is the sacrificial fee.
: Speaking truth and cosmic order, they should consume it.

sanskrit_iast: janiṣṭhā ugraḥ sahase turāya kathā mahām avṛdhat kasya kasya hotur iti nividdhāne |
meaning: जनिष्ठा उग्रः सहसे तुराय कथा महाम् अवृधत् कस्य कस्य होतुर् इति निविद्धाने ।
text_mt: : "The fierce one was born for rapid strength..." [and] "How did he grow great? Of which Hotṛ priest...?" are the two [hymns containing] the insertion of the deity's name.

sanskrit_iast: mandamāna ṛtād adhi prajāyā ṛtasya hi śurudhaḥ santi pūrvīr ity ṛtavatī tad etasya ahno rūpam |
meaning: मन्दमान ऋताद् अधि प्रजाया ऋतस्य हि शुरुधः सन्ति पूर्वीर् इत्य् ऋतवती तद् एतस्य अह्नो रूपम् ।
text_mt: : "Exulting above the cosmic order, for offspring..." [and] "For abundant are the provisions of the cosmic order..."—[the verse] containing [the word] ṛta is the characteristic mark of this day.

sanskrit_iast: prajāpatir imam lokam īpsaṃs tapas taptvā etam yajña kratum apaśyad bhūḥ | tena iṣṭvā imam lokam āpnot | tena imam lokam īpsan yajeta |
meaning: प्रजापतिर् इमम् लोकम् ईप्संस् तपस् तप्त्वा एतम् यज्ञ क्रतुम् अपश्यद् भूः । तेन इष्ट्वा इमम् लोकम् आप्नोत् । तेन इमम् लोकम् ईप्सन् यजेत ।
text_mt: : Prajāpati, desiring to obtain this world, practiced austerity and saw this sacrificial rite, Bhūḥ. Having sacrificed with it, he obtained this world. Desiring to obtain this world, one should sacrifice with it.

sanskrit_iast: prajāpatir antarikṣa lokam īpsaṃs tapas taptvā etam yajña kratum apaśyad bhuvaḥ | tena iṣṭvā antarikṣa lokam āpnot | tena antarikṣa lokam īpsan yajeta |
meaning: प्रजापतिर् अन्तरिक्ष लोकम् ईप्संस् तपस् तप्त्वा एतम् यज्ञ क्रतुम् अपश्यद् भुवः । तेन इष्ट्वा अन्तरिक्ष लोकम् आप्नोत् । तेन अन्तरिक्ष लोकम् ईप्सन् यजेत ।
text_mt: : Prajāpati, desiring to obtain the intermediate world, practiced austerity and saw this sacrificial rite, Bhuvaḥ. Having sacrificed with it, he obtained the intermediate world. Desiring to obtain the intermediate world, one should sacrifice with it.

sanskrit_iast: prajāpatir amum lokam īpsaṃs tapas taptvā etam yajña kratum apaśyat svaḥ | tena iṣṭvā amum lokam āpnot | tena amum lokam īpsan yajeta |
meaning: प्रजापतिर् अमुम् लोकम् ईप्संस् तपस् तप्त्वा एतम् यज्ञ क्रतुम् अपश्यत् स्वः । तेन इष्ट्वा अमुम् लोकम् आप्नोत् । तेन अमुम् लोकम् ईप्सन् यजेत ।
text_mt: : Prajāpati, desiring to obtain that world [above], practiced austerity and saw this sacrificial rite, Svaḥ. Having sacrificed with it, he obtained that world. Desiring to obtain that world, one should sacrifice with it.
The sacrificial fee is twenty-one white horses.

sanskrit_iast: sūryo ha tejas kāmas tapas taptvā etam yajña kratum apaśyat śukra stomam | tena iṣṭvā teja āpnot | tena tejas kāmo yajeta |
meaning: सूर्यो ह तेजस् कामस् तपस् तप्त्वा एतम् यज्ञ क्रतुम् अपश्यत् शुक्र स्तोमम् । तेन इष्ट्वा तेज आप्नोत् । तेन तेजस् कामो यजेत ।
text_mt: Sūrya, desiring brilliance, performed austerities and saw this sacrificial rite, the Śukrastoma; having sacrificed with it, he attained brilliance; one desiring brilliance should sacrifice with it.
Twenty-one white horses are the sacrificial gift.

sanskrit_iast: tīvra savaḥ prajayā paśubhis tīvrasya bubhūṣataḥ |
meaning: तीव्र सवः प्रजया पशुभिस् तीव्रस्य बुभूषतः ।
text_mt: The Tīvrasava is for one desiring to become strong in offspring and cattle.

sanskrit_iast: ayam tīvras tīvrasud idra somo vṛtrahatyāya harivo asya pāhi | vajram śiśāno jaṭharam pṛṇasva anādhṛṣyam vṛṣabham tuṃram indram | iti purastān marutvatīyasya nividdhānasya |
meaning: अयम् तीव्रस् तीव्रसुद् इद्र सोमो वृत्रहत्याय हरिवो अस्य पाहि । वज्रम् शिशानो जठरम् पृणस्व अनाधृष्यम् वृषभम् तुंरम् इन्द्रम् । इति पुरस्तान् मरुत्वतीयस्य निविद्धानस्य ।
text_mt: "This strong Soma, pressing fiercely, O Indra; drink of it, O possessor of bay steeds, for the slaying of Vṛtra. Sharpening the vajra, fill your belly, the unassailable, vigorous, swift Indra"—[this hymn is] before the Marutvatīya hymn containing the nivid.
"Of the strong one that is life-giving" [is inserted] in the Niṣkevalya-śastra.

sanskrit_iast: saṃdaṃśa anustomāv iṣu vajrau śyena ajirau mṛtyu antakau kṣuravapi śīrṣacchidau mahaḥ śyenaś ca abhicaraṇīyaḥ |
meaning: संदंश अनुस्तोमाव् इषु वज्रौ श्येन अजिरौ मृत्यु अन्तकौ क्षुरवपि शीर्षच्छिदौ महः श्येनश् च अभिचरणीयः ।
text_mt: The Saṃdaṃśa and Anustoma, the Iṣu and Vajra, the Śyena and Ajira, the Mṛtyu and Antaka, the Kṣurapavi and Śīrṣacchid, and the Great Śyena are rites for sorcery (abhicāra).
The two Manyu hymns are the hymns containing the nivid, modified according to the characteristic marks.

sanskrit_iast: yat pṛṣṭhena abhicareyus tat pṛṣṭhaḥ prākṛto abhicaryamāṇasya |
meaning: यत् पृष्ठेन अभिचरेयुस् तत् पृष्ठः प्राकृतो अभिचर्यमाणस्य ।
text_mt: Whatever pṛṣṭha-sāman they employ for sorcery, that is the natural pṛṣṭha-sāman of the one against whom sorcery is performed.
The sadas is thatched with pointed tops.
The Āgnīdhra shed [is thatched] with [reeds] having arrowheads.
The enclosing-sticks and the firewood consist of bādhaka wood.
The clarified butter is from sick cows.
The pressing-skin is the hide of an anustaraṇī cow.
The two pressing-boards are made from the hub of a corpse's cart.

sanskrit_iast: śava caṃvām āpaḥ saṃsrutās tābhir vasatīvarīḥ pṛñcanti |
meaning: शव चंवाम् आपः संस्रुतास् ताभिर् वसतीवरीः पृञ्चन्ति ।
text_mt: The waters that have flowed through a corpse-trough—with these they mix the vasatīvarī waters.

sanskrit_iast: upota paruṣā adhijya dhanvāno lihita uṣṇīṣā asi baddhāḥ pracareyuḥ |
meaning: उपोत परुषा अधिज्य धन्वानो लिहित उष्णीषा असि बद्धाः प्रचरेयुः ।
text_mt: Wearing coarse garments, with strung bows, their turbans pulled down, with swords girded, they should officiate.

sanskrit_iast: na ha etam kaścana īśīta iyat so advādaśa aham jīvet |
meaning: न ह एतम् कश्चन ईशीत इयत् सो अद्वादश अहम् जीवेत् ।
text_mt: No one indeed could have power over him so that he would live not [even] twelve days.

sanskrit_iast: na ha via tam kaścana stṛṇute ya etaiḥ pratyabhicarati |
meaning: न ह विअ तम् कश्चन स्तृणुते य एतैः प्रत्यभिचरति ।
text_mt: No one indeed overthrows him who performs counter-sorcery with these [rites].
The sadas is for one wishing to strike away evil and enemies.
And the penultimate verses of the śastras are omitted.

sanskrit_iast: upasadaḥ prajā kāmasya paśu kāmasya ca |
meaning: उपसदः प्रजा कामस्य पशु कामस्य च ।
text_mt: The upasads are for one desiring offspring and desiring cattle.
And the penultimate verses of the śastras are inserted.

sanskrit_iast: deva asurāḥ samayatanta | te devā bṛhaspatim purohitam upādhāvann upa tam yajña kratum jānīhi yena iṣṭvā asurān abhibhavemahi iti | sa etam ṛṣabham yajña kratum apaśyat | tena iṣṭvā asurāna abhyabhavat | tena dviṣato bhrātṛvyān abhibubhūṣan yajeta |
meaning: देव असुराः समयतन्त । ते देवा बृहस्पतिम् पुरोहितम् उपाधावन्न् उप तम् यज्ञ क्रतुम् जानीहि येन इष्ट्वा असुरान् अभिभवेमहि इति । स एतम् ऋषभम् यज्ञ क्रतुम् अपश्यत् । तेन इष्ट्वा असुरान अभ्यभवत् । तेन द्विषतो भ्रातृव्यान् अभिबुभूषन् यजेत ।
text_mt: The gods and the Asuras contended. Those gods ran up to Bṛhaspati, the Purohita: "Find out that sacrifice through which, having sacrificed, we may overpower the Asuras." He saw this Ṛṣabha sacrifice. Having sacrificed with it, he overpowered the Asuras. Desiring to overpower hostile rivals, one should sacrifice with it.

sanskrit_iast: pañcadaśa stomasya saptadaśo mādhyaṃdinaḥ pavamānas tad asya ṛṣabha rūpam |
meaning: पञ्चदश स्तोमस्य सप्तदशो माध्यंदिनः पवमानस् तद् अस्य ऋषभ रूपम् ।
text_mt: Of the fifteenfold stoma, the midday pavamāna is seventeenfold; that is its Ṛṣabha form.

sanskrit_iast: pibā somam abhi yam ugra tardas tam u ṣṭuhi yo abhibūty ojā iti nividdhāne |
meaning: पिबा सोमम् अभि यम् उग्र तर्दस् तम् उ ष्टुहि यो अभिबूत्य् ओजा इति निविद्धाने ।
text_mt: "Drink the Soma, against which, O fierce breaker...", "Praise him, indeed, who is overpowering in strength..."—these are the two hymns containing the nivid.

sanskrit_iast: yaḥ śipravān vṛṣabho yo matīnām gīrbhir vardha vṛṣabham carṣaṇīnām ity ṛṣabhavatī tad etasya ahno rūpam |
meaning: यः शिप्रवान् वृषभो यो मतीनाम् गीर्भिर् वर्ध वृषभम् चर्षणीनाम् इत्य् ऋषभवती तद् एतस्य अह्नो रूपम् ।
text_mt: "He who is full-cheeked, a bull...", "With songs strengthen the bull of the peoples..."—these two bull-bearing [hymns] are the form of this day.

sanskrit_iast: sūryo ha tejas kāmas tapas taptvā etam yajña kratum apaśyad vyomānam | tena iṣṭvā teja āpnot | tena tejas kāmo yajeta |
meaning: सूर्यो ह तेजस् कामस् तपस् तप्त्वा एतम् यज्ञ क्रतुम् अपश्यद् व्योमानम् । तेन इष्ट्वा तेज आप्नोत् । तेन तेजस् कामो यजेत ।
text_mt: Sūrya, desiring splendour, having performed tapas, saw this Vyomān sacrifice. Having sacrificed with it, he attained splendour. Desiring splendour, one should sacrifice with it.
Of the seventeenfold stoma, the Ārbhava-pavamāna is twenty-onefold.

sanskrit_iast: ekaviṃśo vā eṣa ya eṣa tapati tad enam svena rūpeṇa samardhayati |
meaning: एकविंशो वा एष य एष तपति तद् एनम् स्वेन रूपेण समर्धयति ।
text_mt: This [sun] that burns is indeed twenty-onefold; thus he provides him with his own form.

sanskrit_iast: imā u tvā purutamasya indram stava iti nividdhāne |
meaning: इमा उ त्वा पुरुतमस्य इन्द्रम् स्तव इति निविद्धाने ।
text_mt: "These to you, of the most...", "Praise Indra..."—these are the two hymns containing the nivid.

sanskrit_iast: sūryeṇa vayunavac cakāra sa sūryaḥ pary urū varāṃsi iti sūrya abhivyāhāre tad etasya ahno rūpam |
meaning: सूर्येण वयुनवच् चकार स सूर्यः पर्य् उरू वरांसि इति सूर्य अभिव्याहारे तद् एतस्य अह्नो रूपम् ।
text_mt: "He made with the sun...", "That sun across the wide expanses..."—these [two verses] with the mention of Sūrya are the form of this day.

sanskrit_iast: vasiṣṭho ha anna adya kāmas tapas taptvā etam yajña kratum apaśyad virājam | tena iṣṭvā anna adyam āpnot | tena anna adya kāmo yajeta |
meaning: वसिष्ठो ह अन्न अद्य कामस् तपस् तप्त्वा एतम् यज्ञ क्रतुम् अपश्यद् विराजम् । तेन इष्ट्वा अन्न अद्यम् आप्नोत् । तेन अन्न अद्य कामो यजेत ।
text_mt: Vasiṣṭha, desiring food, having performed tapas, saw this Virāj sacrifice. Having sacrificed with it, he attained food. Desiring food, one should sacrifice with it.
The first two pavamāna-stotras are fifteenfold; the others are ninefold.
It attains the Virāj.

sanskrit_iast: śrīr virāḷ anna adyam śriyo virājo anna adyasya upāptyai |
meaning: श्रीर् विराऌ अन्न अद्यम् श्रियो विराजो अन्न अद्यस्य उपाप्त्यै ।
text_mt: The Virāj is prosperity and food; [it is] for the attainment of prosperity, Virāj, and food.

sanskrit_iast: mahaścit tvam indra yata etāṃs tvam rāja indra ye ca devā ity akṣara vairāje nividdhāne tad etasya ahno rūpam |
meaning: महश्चित् त्वम् इन्द्र यत एतांस् त्वम् राज इन्द्र ये च देवा इत्य् अक्षर वैराजे निविद्धाने तद् एतस्य अह्नो रूपम् ।
text_mt: "Even of the great, you, O Indra, when...", "These you, O King Indra, and the gods..."—these two syllable-vairāja hymns containing the nivid are the form of this day.

sanskrit_iast: indro ha svārājya kāmas tapas taptvā etam yajña kratum apaśyat svarājam | tena iṣṭvā svārājyam āpnot | tena svārājya kāmo yajeta |
meaning: इन्द्रो ह स्वाराज्य कामस् तपस् तप्त्वा एतम् यज्ञ क्रतुम् अपश्यत् स्वराजम् । तेन इष्ट्वा स्वाराज्यम् आप्नोत् । तेन स्वाराज्य कामो यजेत ।
text_mt: Indra, desiring self-rule, having performed tapas, saw this Svarāj sacrifice. Having sacrificed with it, he attained self-rule. Desiring self-rule, one should sacrifice with it.
The first two pavamāna-stotras are seventeenfold; the others are ninefold.
Those four stotriya-verses go beyond the Virāj.
By them he attains self-rule.

sanskrit_iast: uśanā ha kāvyo asurāṇām purohita āsa | sa ha devānām annam aśitvā paridadre | sa ha aikṣata | katham nu tena yajña kratunā yajeyam yena iṣṭvā pāpmānam apahanyām iti | sa etam uśana stomam yajña kratum apaśyat | tena iṣṭvā pāpmānam apāhata | tena pāpmānam apajighāṃsamāno yajeta |
meaning: उशना ह काव्यो असुराणाम् पुरोहित आस । स ह देवानाम् अन्नम् अशित्वा परिदद्रे । स ह ऐक्षत । कथम् नु तेन यज्ञ क्रतुना यजेयम् येन इष्ट्वा पाप्मानम् अपहन्याम् इति । स एतम् उशन स्तोमम् यज्ञ क्रतुम् अपश्यत् । तेन इष्ट्वा पाप्मानम् अपाहत । तेन पाप्मानम् अपजिघांसमानो यजेत ।
text_mt: Uśanas Kāvya was the Purohita of the Asuras. Having eaten the food of the gods, he burst. He considered: "How now could I sacrifice with that sacrifice by which, having sacrificed, I may strike away evil?" He saw this Uśanastoma sacrifice. Having sacrificed with it, he struck away evil. Desiring to strike away evil, one should sacrifice with it.

sanskrit_iast: trivṛtā eva tad brahmaṇā purastāt pāpmānam apāhata |
meaning: त्रिवृता एव तद् ब्रह्मणा पुरस्तात् पाप्मानम् अपाहत ।
text_mt: By that ninefold stoma, Brahman, he struck away evil in the beginning.

sanskrit_iast: virājā eva tan madhyataḥ pāpmānam apāhata |
meaning: विराजा एव तन् मध्यतः पाप्मानम् अपाहत ।
text_mt: With the Virāj he indeed struck away evil from the middle.

sanskrit_iast: trivṛtā eva tad brahmaṇā upariṣṭāt pāpmānam apāhata |
meaning: त्रिवृता एव तद् ब्रह्मणा उपरिष्टात् पाप्मानम् अपाहत ।
text_mt: With the ninefold sacred power he indeed struck away evil from above.

sanskrit_iast: try aryamā dyaur na ya indra iti nividdhāne |
meaning: त्र्य् अर्यमा द्यौर् न य इन्द्र इति निविद्धाने ।
text_mt: 'tryaryamā' (RV 5.29) and 'dyaur na ya indra' (RV 6.20) are the two nividdhāna hymns.

sanskrit_iast: uśanā yat sahasrair ayātam varivasyann uśane kāvyāya ity uśanavatī tad etasya ahno rūpam |
meaning: उशना यत् सहस्रैर् अयातम् वरिवस्यन्न् उशने काव्याय इत्य् उशनवती तद् एतस्य अह्नो रूपम् ।
text_mt: 'When Uśanā with thousands did go' and 'Serving Uśanā Kāvya'—these contain [the name] Uśanā; that is the characteristic of this day.

sanskrit_iast: sa ha aikṣata | pāpmānam apahatya katham nu tena yajña kratunā yajeyam yena iṣṭvā anna adyam āpnuyām iti | sa etam uttaram uśana stomam yajña kratum apaśyat | tena iṣṭvā anna adyam āpnoti | tena anna adya kāmo yajeta |
meaning: स ह ऐक्षत । पाप्मानम् अपहत्य कथम् नु तेन यज्ञ क्रतुना यजेयम् येन इष्ट्वा अन्न अद्यम् आप्नुयाम् इति । स एतम् उत्तरम् उशन स्तोमम् यज्ञ क्रतुम् अपश्यत् । तेन इष्ट्वा अन्न अद्यम् आप्नोति । तेन अन्न अद्य कामो यजेत ।
text_mt: He indeed considered: 'Having struck away evil, how now might I sacrifice with that rite of sacrifice having sacrificed with which I may obtain food?' He saw this subsequent rite of sacrifice, the Uśanastoma. Having sacrificed with it, he obtains food. One desiring food should sacrifice with it.

sanskrit_iast: trivṛtā eva tad brahmaṇā ubhayato anna adyam parigṛhya ātmann adadhata |
meaning: त्रिवृता एव तद् ब्रह्मणा उभयतो अन्न अद्यम् परिगृह्य आत्मन्न् अदधत ।
text_mt: With the ninefold sacred power they thus enclosed food on both sides and placed it in themselves.

sanskrit_iast: tathā eva etad yajamānas trivṛtā eva tad brahmaṇā ubhayato anna adyam parigṛhya ātman dhatte |
meaning: तथा एव एतद् यजमानस् त्रिवृता एव तद् ब्रह्मणा उभयतो अन्न अद्यम् परिगृह्य आत्मन् धत्ते ।
text_mt: In the same way the sacrificer thus encloses food on both sides with the ninefold sacred power and places it in himself.

sanskrit_iast: vividhaś ca evam stomo anna adya kāmasya |
meaning: विविधश् च एवम् स्तोमो अन्न अद्य कामस्य ।
text_mt: And thus is the diverse stoma for one desiring food.
A thousand [cows] and a hundred horses are the sacrificial fee.

sanskrit_iast: indra agnī vai deveṣv aham śreyase vivadeyātām | te devā ūcuḥ | yadi vā imāv evam vivadiṣyete abhi no asurā bhaviṣyanti | upa tam yajña kratum jānīma yena enau saṃśamayemahi iti | ta etam yajña kratum apaśyann indra agnyoḥ kulāyam | tena enau samaśamayan |
meaning: इन्द्र अग्नी वै देवेष्व् अहम् श्रेयसे विवदेयाताम् । ते देवा ऊचुः । यदि वा इमाव् एवम् विवदिष्येते अभि नो असुरा भविष्यन्ति । उप तम् यज्ञ क्रतुम् जानीम येन एनौ संशमयेमहि इति । त एतम् यज्ञ क्रतुम् अपश्यन्न् इन्द्र अग्न्योः कुलायम् । तेन एनौ समशमयन् ।
text_mt: Indra and Agni indeed disputed among the gods for preeminence. The gods said: 'If indeed these two dispute thus, the Asuras will overcome us. Let us find out that rite of sacrifice by which we may reconcile them.' They saw this rite of sacrifice, the Kulāya of Indra and Agni. By it they reconciled them.

sanskrit_iast: tena brāhmaṇaś ca kṣatriyaś ca samyajeyātām yam puro dhāsyamānaḥ syāt |
meaning: तेन ब्राह्मणश् च क्षत्रियश् च सम्यजेयाताम् यम् पुरो धास्यमानः स्यात् ।
text_mt: With it a Brahmin and a Kṣatriya should sacrifice together, [in the case where the Kṣatriya] is about to appoint [the Brahmin] as his domestic priest.

sanskrit_iast: brahma kṣatre eva tat tanvau saṃsṛjete |
meaning: ब्रह्म क्षत्रे एव तत् तन्वौ संसृजेते ।
text_mt: Thereby the spiritual power (brahman) and the temporal power (kṣatra) unite their two bodies.
The two stomas are the ninefold and the fifteenfold.
Agni is the ninefold; Indra is the fifteenfold.

sanskrit_iast: indra agnī eva tat tanvau samasṛjatām |
meaning: इन्द्र अग्नी एव तत् तन्वौ समसृजताम् ।
text_mt: Thereby Indra and Agni united their two bodies.

sanskrit_iast: tiṣṭhā harī tam u ṣṭuhi iti nividdhāne |
meaning: तिष्ठा हरी तम् उ ष्टुहि इति निविद्धाने ।
text_mt: 'tiṣṭhā harī' (RV 3.35) and 'tam u ṣṭuhi' (RV 6.18) are the two nividdhāna hymns.

sanskrit_iast: agneḥ piba jihvayā somam indra agnir na śuṣkam vanam indra hetir ity aindre agnimatī tad etasya ahno rūpam |
meaning: अग्नेः पिब जिह्वया सोमम् इन्द्र अग्निर् न शुष्कम् वनम् इन्द्र हेतिर् इत्य् ऐन्द्रे अग्निमती तद् एतस्य अह्नो रूपम् ।
text_mt: 'Drink the Soma with Agni's tongue, O Indra' and 'Like Agni, a dry forest, Indra's missile'—these [verses] dedicated to Indra contain [the name] Agni; that is the characteristic of this day.

sanskrit_iast: mitrā varuṇayor vai vairājyam anyatara aicchat svārājyam anyataraḥ | tāv etam yajña kratum apaśyatām virāṭ svarājam | tena iṣṭvā vairājyam anyatara āpnot svārājyam anyataraḥ |
meaning: मित्रा वरुणयोर् वै वैराज्यम् अन्यतर ऐच्छत् स्वाराज्यम् अन्यतरः । ताव् एतम् यज्ञ क्रतुम् अपश्यताम् विराट् स्वराजम् । तेन इष्ट्वा वैराज्यम् अन्यतर आप्नोत् स्वाराज्यम् अन्यतरः ।
text_mt: Of Mitra and Varuṇa, one desired paramount rule (vairājya), the other desired self-rule (svārājya). They saw this rite of sacrifice, the Virāṭsvarāj. Having sacrificed with it, one obtained paramount rule, the other self-rule.

sanskrit_iast: jyeṣṭha stomaḥ kaniṣṭha kulīnasya jyaiṣṭhyam kāmayamānasya |
meaning: ज्येष्ठ स्तोमः कनिष्ठ कुलीनस्य ज्यैष्ठ्यम् कामयमानस्य ।
text_mt: The Jyeṣṭhastoma is for one born of the younger line who desires preeminence.
The Bahiṣpavamāna is seventeenfold.
This is indeed the eldest among stomas.

sanskrit_iast: tam eva tad yajña mukhe yunakti |
meaning: तम् एव तद् यज्ञ मुखे युनक्ति ।
text_mt: He employs that very one at the beginning of the sacrifice.

sanskrit_iast: janiṣṭhā ugraḥ sahasre turāya pra vaḥ satām jyeṣṭhatamāya suṣṭutim iti jyeṣṭha abhivyāhāre nividdhāne tad etasya ahno rūpam |
meaning: जनिष्ठा उग्रः सहस्रे तुराय प्र वः सताम् ज्येष्ठतमाय सुष्टुतिम् इति ज्येष्ठ अभिव्याहारे निविद्धाने तद् एतस्य अह्नो रूपम् ।
text_mt: 'He was born powerful for the swift in the thousand' and 'Direct your good praise to the eldest of the true'—these two nividdhāna hymns containing the expression 'eldest' (jyeṣṭha) are the characteristic of this day.

sanskrit_iast: deva asurāḥ samayanta | te devā bṛhaspatim purohitam upādhāvan | upa tam yajña kratum jānīhi yena iṣṭvā asurā na anvaveyur iti | sa etam durāśam yajña kratum apaśyat | tena iṣṭvā asurā na anvavāyan | tato vai devā abhavan parā asurāḥ | bhavaty ātmanā parā asya dveṣyo ya evam veda |
meaning: देव असुराः समयन्त । ते देवा बृहस्पतिम् पुरोहितम् उपाधावन् । उप तम् यज्ञ क्रतुम् जानीहि येन इष्ट्वा असुरा न अन्ववेयुर् इति । स एतम् दुराशम् यज्ञ क्रतुम् अपश्यत् । तेन इष्ट्वा असुरा न अन्ववायन् । ततो वै देवा अभवन् परा असुराः । भवत्य् आत्मना परा अस्य द्वेष्यो य एवम् वेद ।
text_mt: The gods and the Asuras contended. The gods ran to Bṛhaspati, the domestic priest: 'Find out that rite of sacrifice having sacrificed with which the Asuras will not follow after us.' He saw this rite of sacrifice, the Durāśa. Having sacrificed with it, the Asuras did not follow after them. Then indeed the gods flourished and the Asuras perished. He flourishes himself and his enemy perishes who knows thus.

sanskrit_iast: apara pakṣe sauri iṣṭiḥ pūrva ahṇe |
meaning: अपर पक्षे सौरि इष्टिः पूर्व अह्णे ।
text_mt: In the dark fortnight, there is an offering to Sūrya in the forenoon.
'vidhuṃ dadrāṇam' (RV 10.55.5) and 'navo navo' (RV 10.85.19) [are the verses].
A golden [ornament] of a hundred hair-breadths (śatavala) is the sacrificial fee at the former [offering].

sanskrit_iast: stotre stotre stute triṃśatam triṃśatma śata valān dadāti |
meaning: स्तोत्रे स्तोत्रे स्तुते त्रिंशतम् त्रिंशत्म शत वलान् ददाति ।
text_mt: As each stotra is chanted, he gives thirty [pieces] of thirty or a hundred hair-breadths.
Or as much gold as the sacrificer desires.

sanskrit_iast: indro ha apaciti kāmas tapas taptvā etam yajña kratum apaśyad apacitim | tena iṣṭvā apacitim āpnot | tena apaciti kāmo yajeta |
meaning: इन्द्रो ह अपचिति कामस् तपस् तप्त्वा एतम् यज्ञ क्रतुम् अपश्यद् अपचितिम् । तेन इष्ट्वा अपचितिम् आप्नोत् । तेन अपचिति कामो यजेत ।
text_mt: Indra, desiring honor, having performed ascetic toil, saw this rite of sacrifice, the Apaciti. Having sacrificed with it, he obtained honor. One desiring honor should sacrifice with it.
The first two Pavamānas are twenty-fourfold.
The Ājya[-śastras] are ninefold and fifteenfold.
The Pṛṣṭha[-śastras] are seventeenfold and twenty-onefold.
The Ārbhava Pavamāna is twenty-sevenfold.
The Agniṣṭoma-sāman is twenty-onefold.

sanskrit_iast: tasya gāyatrīm abhi prātaḥ savanam saṃtiṣṭhate |
meaning: तस्य गायत्रीम् अभि प्रातः सवनम् संतिष्ठते ।
text_mt: Of this [sacrifice], the morning pressing is completed according to the Gāyatrī.

sanskrit_iast: gāyatrac chandaso vasavaḥ | tena indro vasuṣv apacitim āśnuta |
meaning: गायत्रच् छन्दसो वसवः । तेन इन्द्रो वसुष्व् अपचितिम् आश्नुत ।
text_mt: The Vasus are connected with the Gāyatrī metre; thereby Indra attained honor among the Vasus.

sanskrit_iast: gāyatrac chandaso brāhmaṇāḥ | tena ayam brāhmaṇeṣv apacitim aśnute |
meaning: गायत्रच् छन्दसो ब्राह्मणाः । तेन अयम् ब्राह्मणेष्व् अपचितिम् अश्नुते ।
text_mt: The Brahmins are connected with the Gāyatrī metre; thereby this [sacrificer] attains honor among Brahmins.
The midday pressing [is completed according to] the Triṣṭubh.

sanskrit_iast: triṣṭup chandaso rudrāḥ | tena indro rudreṣv apacitim āśnuta |
meaning: त्रिष्टुप् छन्दसो रुद्राः । तेन इन्द्रो रुद्रेष्व् अपचितिम् आश्नुत ।
text_mt: The Rudras are connected with the Triṣṭubh metre; thereby Indra attained honor among the Rudras.

sanskrit_iast: triṣṭup chandasaḥ kṣatriyāḥ | tena ayam kṣatriyeṣv apacitim aśnute |
meaning: त्रिष्टुप् छन्दसः क्षत्रियाः । तेन अयम् क्षत्रियेष्व् अपचितिम् अश्नुते ।
text_mt: The Kṣatriyas are connected with the Triṣṭubh metre; thereby this [sacrificer] attains honor among Kṣatriyas.
The third pressing [is completed according to] the Jagatī.

sanskrit_iast: jagat chandasa ādityāḥ | tena indra ādityeṣv apacitim āśnuta |
meaning: जगत् छन्दस आदित्याः । तेन इन्द्र आदित्येष्व् अपचितिम् आश्नुत ।
text_mt: The Ādityas are connected with the Jagatī metre; thereby Indra attained honor among the Ādityas.

sanskrit_iast: jagat chandaso viśaḥ | tena ayam vikṣv apacitim aśnute |
meaning: जगत् छन्दसो विशः । तेन अयम् विक्ष्व् अपचितिम् अश्नुते ।
text_mt: The common people (viś) are connected with the Jagatī metre; thereby this [sacrificer] attains honor among the common people.

sanskrit_iast: vācā anvāha vācā śaṃsati vācā yajati |
meaning: वाचा अन्वाह वाचा शंसति वाचा यजति ।
text_mt: With speech he recites [the invitatory verse], with speech he recites the śastra, with speech he recites the offering verse.

sanskrit_iast: anuṣṭup chandaso viśve devāḥ | tena indro viśveṣu deveṣv apacitim āśnuta |
meaning: अनुष्टुप् छन्दसो विश्वे देवाः । तेन इन्द्रो विश्वेषु देवेष्व् अपचितिम् आश्नुत ।
text_mt: The All-gods have the Anuṣṭubh metre. By that, Indra attained honour among all the gods.

sanskrit_iast: anuṣṭup chandasaḥ śūdrāḥ | tena ayam śūdreṣv apacitim aśnute |
meaning: अनुष्टुप् छन्दसः शूद्राः । तेन अयम् शूद्रेष्व् अपचितिम् अश्नुते ।
text_mt: The Śūdras have the Anuṣṭubh metre. By that, this one attains honour among the Śūdras.

sanskrit_iast: aśva rathaḥ khāḍga kavaco vaiyāghra paricchada ārkṣa upāsaṅgo dvaipa dhanvadhiḥ śyāva aśvo dakṣiṇā |
meaning: अश्व रथः खाड्ग कवचो वैयाघ्र परिच्छद आर्क्ष उपासङ्गो द्वैप धन्वधिः श्याव अश्वो दक्षिणा ।
text_mt: A horse-drawn chariot, rhinoceros-hide armor, a tiger-skin cover, a bear-skin quiver, a leopard-skin bow-case, and a dark-brown horse are the sacrificial gift.
[With the thought:] 'May I obtain honor by means of an honorable form.'

sanskrit_iast: indra somam soma pata indram stava iti nividdhāne indra abhivyāhāre | tad etasya ahno rūpam |
meaning: इन्द्र सोमम् सोम पत इन्द्रम् स्तव इति निविद्धाने इन्द्र अभिव्याहारे । तद् एतस्य अह्नो रूपम् ।
text_mt: [The hymns] 'Indra somam' and 'Somapātā indram stava' are the two Nividdhāna [hymns], which make mention of Indra; that is the characteristic of this day.

sanskrit_iast: sūryo ha tviṣi kāmas tapas taptvā etam yajña kratum apaśyat tviṣim | tena iṣṭvā tviṣim āpnot | tena tviṣi kāmo yajeta |
meaning: सूर्यो ह त्विषि कामस् तपस् तप्त्वा एतम् यज्ञ क्रतुम् अपश्यत् त्विषिम् । तेन इष्ट्वा त्विषिम् आप्नोत् । तेन त्विषि कामो यजेत ।
text_mt: Sūrya, desiring brilliance, performed austerities and saw this sacrificial rite, [namely] the Tviṣi. Having sacrificed with it, he obtained brilliance. Desiring brilliance, one should sacrifice with it.

sanskrit_iast: aśva rathaḥ kāṃsya kavacaḥ śveta aśvo dakṣiṇā |
meaning: अश्व रथः कांस्य कवचः श्वेत अश्वो दक्षिणा ।
text_mt: A horse-drawn chariot, bronze armor, and a white horse are the sacrificial gift.
[With the thought:] 'May I obtain brilliance by means of a brilliant form.'

sanskrit_iast: sūrya abhivyāhāre nividdhāne | tad etasya ahno rūpam |
meaning: सूर्य अभिव्याहारे निविद्धाने । तद् एतस्य अह्नो रूपम् ।
text_mt: The two Nividdhāna [hymns] make mention of Sūrya; that is the characteristic of this day.

sanskrit_iast: varuṇo ha vṛṣṭi kāmas tapas taptvā etam yajña kratum apaśyad vṛṣṭim | tena iṣṭvā vṛṣṭim āpnot | tena vṛṣṭi kāmo yajeta |
meaning: वरुणो ह वृष्टि कामस् तपस् तप्त्वा एतम् यज्ञ क्रतुम् अपश्यद् वृष्टिम् । तेन इष्ट्वा वृष्टिम् आप्नोत् । तेन वृष्टि कामो यजेत ।
text_mt: Varuṇa, desiring rain, performed austerities and saw this sacrificial rite, [namely] the Vṛṣṭi. Having sacrificed with it, he obtained rain. Desiring rain, one should sacrifice with it.

sanskrit_iast: ud vām cakṣur varuṇa supratīkam indrā varuṇā yuvam adhvarāya na iti indrā varuṇa abhivyāhāre nividdhāne | tad etasya ahno rūpam |
meaning: उद् वाम् चक्षुर् वरुण सुप्रतीकम् इन्द्रा वरुणा युवम् अध्वराय न इति इन्द्रा वरुण अभिव्याहारे निविद्धाने । तद् एतस्य अह्नो रूपम् ।
text_mt: [The hymns] 'Ud vāṃ cakṣur varuṇa supratīkam' and 'Indrāvaruṇā yuvam adhvarāya naḥ' are the two Nividdhāna [hymns], which make mention of Indrā-Varuṇa; that is the characteristic of this day.

sanskrit_iast: bhānumatī ha tejas kāmas tapas taptvā etam yajña kratum apaśyad ādityam | tena iṣṭvā teja āpnot | tena tejas kāmo yajeta |
meaning: भानुमती ह तेजस् कामस् तपस् तप्त्वा एतम् यज्ञ क्रतुम् अपश्यद् आदित्यम् । तेन इष्ट्वा तेज आप्नोत् । तेन तेजस् कामो यजेत ।
text_mt: Bhānumat, desiring splendor, performed austerities and saw this sacrificial rite, [namely] the Āditya. Having sacrificed with it, he obtained splendor. Desiring splendor, one should sacrifice with it.

sanskrit_iast: yam vai sūryam svar bhānuḥ svar bhānor adha yad ity āditya abhivyāhāre nividdhāne | tad etasya ahno rūpam |
meaning: यम् वै सूर्यम् स्वर् भानुः स्वर् भानोर् अध यद् इत्य् आदित्य अभिव्याहारे निविद्धाने । तद् एतस्य अह्नो रूपम् ।
text_mt: [The hymns] 'Yaṃ vai sūryaṃ svarbhānuḥ' and 'Svarbhānor adha yad' are the two Nividdhāna [hymns], which make mention of the Ādityas; that is the characteristic of this day.

sanskrit_iast: indrā viṣṇur ha svarga kāmas tapas taptvā etam yajña kratum apaśyat svargam | tena iṣṭvā svargam āpnot | tena svarga kāmo yajeta |
meaning: इन्द्रा विष्णुर् ह स्वर्ग कामस् तपस् तप्त्वा एतम् यज्ञ क्रतुम् अपश्यत् स्वर्गम् । तेन इष्ट्वा स्वर्गम् आप्नोत् । तेन स्वर्ग कामो यजेत ।
text_mt: Indrā-Viṣṇu, desiring heaven, performed austerities and saw this sacrificial rite, [namely] the Svarga. Having sacrificed with it, they obtained heaven. Desiring heaven, one should sacrifice with it.

sanskrit_iast: indra abhivyāhāre nividdhāne | tad etasya ahno rūpam |
meaning: इन्द्र अभिव्याहारे निविद्धाने । तद् एतस्य अह्नो रूपम् ।
text_mt: The two Nividdhāna [hymns] make mention of Indra; that is the characteristic of this day.

sanskrit_iast: deva asurāḥ samayatanta | te devā bṛhaspatim purohitam upādhāvan | upa tau yajña kratū jānīhi yābhyām iṣṭvā asurān vinuttyā abhibhavemahi iti | sa etau yajña kratū apaśyad vinutty abhibhūtī | tān vinuttinā vinuttyā abhibhūtinā abhyabhavan |
meaning: देव असुराः समयतन्त । ते देवा बृहस्पतिम् पुरोहितम् उपाधावन् । उप तौ यज्ञ क्रतू जानीहि याभ्याम् इष्ट्वा असुरान् विनुत्त्या अभिभवेमहि इति । स एतौ यज्ञ क्रतू अपश्यद् विनुत्त्य् अभिभूती । तान् विनुत्तिना विनुत्त्या अभिभूतिना अभ्यभवन् ।
text_mt: The gods and the Asuras contended. The gods ran to Bṛhaspati, their Purohita: 'Devise two sacrificial rites by sacrificing with which we may drive away and overcome the Asuras.' He saw these two sacrificial rites: the Vinutti and the Abhibhūti. By the Vinutti they drove them away; by the Abhibhūti they overcame them.

sanskrit_iast: tasya vinutteḥ ṣaḷ ūrdhvāḥ pṛṣṭhya stomāḥ ṣaḷ āvṛttā viṣvañcaḥ stomāḥ |
meaning: तस्य विनुत्तेः षऌ ऊर्ध्वाः पृष्ठ्य स्तोमाः षऌ आवृत्ता विष्वञ्चः स्तोमाः ।
text_mt: For that Vinutti, the six Pṛṣṭhya stomas go forward, [and then] the six turned-back stomas diverge outward.
'Becoming divergent, indeed, they drive [the enemies] away.'

sanskrit_iast: atha abhibhūteḥ ṣaḷ ūrdhvāḥ pṛṣṭhya stomāḥ ṣaḷ āvṛttāḥ samyañcaḥ stomāḥ |
meaning: अथ अभिभूतेः षऌ ऊर्ध्वाः पृष्ठ्य स्तोमाः षऌ आवृत्ताः सम्यञ्चः स्तोमाः ।
text_mt: Now for the Abhibhūti, the six Pṛṣṭhya stomas go forward, [and then] the six turned-back stomas converge together.
'Becoming convergent, indeed, they overcome [the enemies].'

sanskrit_iast: yad viśvajito bṛhat pṛṣṭhasya tad enayoḥ śastram |
meaning: यद् विश्वजितो बृहत् पृष्ठस्य तद् एनयोः शस्त्रम् ।
text_mt: What belongs to the Viśvajit with the Bṛhat [chant] as its Pṛṣṭha is their śastra.
The Rāśi and the Marāya [rites] are for one who desires food.
[They are] the two last Chandomas from the Samūḷha [form].
In the southern [rite], he gives a thousand female cows as the sacrificial gift;
The initiation and the Upasads have a common performance.
Twins or brothers born in close succession should sacrifice together.
The Vighana [rite] is for one wishing to strike away evil and those who hate him;

sanskrit_iast: kayā śubhīya tad id āsīye vā nividdhāne |
meaning: कया शुभीय तद् इद् आसीये वा निविद्धाने ।
text_mt: The two Nividdhāna [hymns] are 'Kayā śubhā' and 'Tad id āsa',
Or for one wishing to strike away a rival and those who hate him.

sanskrit_iast: ādityāś ca ha vā aṅgirasaś ca aspardhanta | vayam pūrve svargam lokam eṣyāma ity ādityā vayam ity aṅgirasaḥ | te aṅgirasa ādityebhyaḥ procuḥ | śvaḥ sutyā no yājayata na iti | teṣām ha agnir dūta āsa | ta ādityā ūcuḥ | yadi vā ete pūrve yakṣyanty ete pūrve svargam lokam gamiṣyanti | abhi no asurā bhaviṣyanti | upa tam yajña kratum jānīma yena vayam pūrve yajemahi iti | ta etam sādyahkram yajña kratum apaśyan | tena iṣṭvā pūrve svargam lokam āyan | tena svarga kāmo yajeta |
meaning: आदित्याश् च ह वा अङ्गिरसश् च अस्पर्धन्त । वयम् पूर्वे स्वर्गम् लोकम् एष्याम इत्य् आदित्या वयम् इत्य् अङ्गिरसः । ते अङ्गिरस आदित्येभ्यः प्रोचुः । श्वः सुत्या नो याजयत न इति । तेषाम् ह अग्निर् दूत आस । त आदित्या ऊचुः । यदि वा एते पूर्वे यक्ष्यन्त्य् एते पूर्वे स्वर्गम् लोकम् गमिष्यन्ति । अभि नो असुरा भविष्यन्ति । उप तम् यज्ञ क्रतुम् जानीम येन वयम् पूर्वे यजेमहि इति । त एतम् साद्यह्क्रम् यज्ञ क्रतुम् अपश्यन् । तेन इष्ट्वा पूर्वे स्वर्गम् लोकम् आयन् । तेन स्वर्ग कामो यजेत ।
text_mt:
The Ādityas and the Aṅgirases contended: 'We shall go to the world of heaven first,' [said] the Ādityas; 'We,' [said] the Aṅgirases. Those Aṅgirases said to the Ādityas: 'Offer the sacrifice for us tomorrow on our pressing day.' Agni was their messenger. Those Ādityas said: 'If these will sacrifice first, they will go to the world of heaven first; the Asuras will prevail over us. Let us devise that sacrificial rite by which we may sacrifice first.'
They saw this Sādyahkra sacrificial rite. Having sacrificed with it, they went first to the world of heaven. Desiring heaven, one should sacrifice with it.
A barley-threshing floor is the high altar;
The Vasatīvarī waters are from the house of one who has sacrificed;
Curds are carried around in skin bags;

sanskrit_iast: tato yat sarpir udaiti tena pracaranti |
meaning: ततो यत् सर्पिर् उदैति तेन प्रचरन्ति ।
text_mt: Whatever melted butter rises from that, with that they proceed.
A horse-drawn chariot is the soma-announcer;
The ritual acts proceed in rapid succession;
The Pravargya is omitted for lack of need;
The three Upasads are performed continuously one after another;
At the time of the pressing victims, the animal sacrifices have a common procedure;
A barren cow for the Aśvins takes the place of the subsequently bound victim;
Or he should sacrifice with a curds-offering for Mitra and Varuṇa.
And so they followed after what had preceded.
This very rule applies to the second [Sādyahkra];
The Pavamāna [chants] are eighteen-fold; the others are ninefold (Trivṛt).
This is that Ukthya [sacrifice] brought forward [in time].

sanskrit_iast: yo agiṣṭome kāmo ya ukthye tayor ubhayor āptyai |
meaning: यो अगिष्टोमे कामो य उक्थ्ये तयोर् उभयोर् आप्त्यै ।
text_mt: Whatever desire there is in the Agniṣṭoma, and whatever in the Ukthya—for the attainment of both.
A bundle of wheat is the headpiece of the sacrificial post.
The Vasatīvarī waters are drawn in an earthen jar.
This very rule applies to the subsequent [rite].
The Pavamāna chants are twenty-four-fold; the others are nine-fold.
That is the Vājapeya abridged.

sanskrit_iast: yaḥ ṣoḷaśini kāmo yo vājapeye tayor ubhayor āptyai |
meaning: यः षोऌअशिनि कामो यो वाजपेये तयोर् उभयोर् आप्त्यै ।
text_mt: Whatever desire there is in the Ṣoḍaśin, and whatever in the Vājapeya—for the attainment of both.

sanskrit_iast: yady asya dviṣan bhrātṛvyo anukriyā yajeta parikriyā yajeta | yadi parikriyā utkriyā |
meaning: यद्य् अस्य द्विषन् भ्रातृव्यो अनुक्रिया यजेत परिक्रिया यजेत । यदि परिक्रिया उत्क्रिया ।
text_mt: If an enemy, a rival, should sacrifice in imitation of him, he should sacrifice outdoing him; if outdoing him, surpassing him.

sanskrit_iast: eka trika trika ekābhyām brahma varcasa kāmo yajeta |
meaning: एक त्रिक त्रिक एकाभ्याम् ब्रह्म वर्चस कामो यजेत ।
text_mt: One desiring spiritual luster should sacrifice with the Ekatrika and the Trikaika.

sanskrit_iast: ekasyām tisṛṣv iti prathamasya stotrāṇi bhavanti |
meaning: एकस्याम् तिसृष्व् इति प्रथमस्य स्तोत्राणि भवन्ति ।
text_mt: For the first, the stotras are [sung] 'on one, on three'.
For the subsequent [sacrifice], 'on three, on one'.
These are twenty-four stotriyā verses.
The Gāyatrī has twenty-four syllables.
The Gāyatrī is fiery energy and spiritual luster.

sanskrit_iast: tad ābhyām tejo brahma varcasam āpoti |
meaning: तद् आभ्याम् तेजो ब्रह्म वर्चसम् आपोति ।
text_mt: Thus, through these two, he obtains fiery energy and spiritual luster.
The Abhijit is for one desiring conquest.
The Viśvajit is for one desiring universal conquest.
Having become Agniṣṭomas, they rested upon one another.
Having become Ukthyas, upon one another.
Having become Atirātras, upon one another.

sanskrit_iast: indro vai vṝn jigīṣaṃs tapas taptvā etam yajña kratum apaśyan nṛjitam | tena iṣṭvā nṝn ajayat | tena nṝn jigīṣan yajeta |
meaning: इन्द्रो वै वॄन् जिगीषंस् तपस् तप्त्वा एतम् यज्ञ क्रतुम् अपश्यन् नृजितम् । तेन इष्ट्वा नॄन् अजयत् । तेन नॄन् जिगीषन् यजेत ।
text_mt: Indra, desiring to conquer men, performed ascetic heat and saw this sacrificial rite, the Nṛjit. Having sacrificed with it, he conquered men. Desiring to conquer men, one should sacrifice with it.

sanskrit_iast: indro vai pṛtanājam jigīṣaṃs tapas taptvā etam yajña kratum apaśyat pṛtanājitam | tena iṣṭvā pṛtanājam ajayat | tena pṛtanājam jigīṣan yajeta |
meaning: इन्द्रो वै पृतनाजम् जिगीषंस् तपस् तप्त्वा एतम् यज्ञ क्रतुम् अपश्यत् पृतनाजितम् । तेन इष्ट्वा पृतनाजम् अजयत् । तेन पृतनाजम् जिगीषन् यजेत ।
text_mt: Indra, desiring to conquer the battle, performed ascetic heat and saw this sacrificial rite, the Pṛtanājit. Having sacrificed with it, he conquered the battle. Desiring to conquer the battle, one should sacrifice with it.

sanskrit_iast: indro vai satrājam jigīṣaṃs tapas taptvā etam yajña kratum apaśyat satrājitam | tena iṣṭvā satrājam ajayat | tena satrājam jigīṣan yajeta |
meaning: इन्द्रो वै सत्राजम् जिगीषंस् तपस् तप्त्वा एतम् यज्ञ क्रतुम् अपश्यत् सत्राजितम् । तेन इष्ट्वा सत्राजम् अजयत् । तेन सत्राजम् जिगीषन् यजेत ।
text_mt: Indra, desiring to conquer entirely, performed ascetic heat and saw this sacrificial rite, the Satrājit. Having sacrificed with it, he conquered entirely. Desiring to conquer entirely, one should sacrifice with it.
The nivid-hymns at the midday pressings are from the first three-day period.

sanskrit_iast: indro vai dhanam jigīṣaṃs tapas taptvā etam yajña kratum apaśyad dhanajitam | tena iṣṭvā dhanam ajayat | tena dhanam jigīṣan yajeta |
meaning: इन्द्रो वै धनम् जिगीषंस् तपस् तप्त्वा एतम् यज्ञ क्रतुम् अपश्यद् धनजितम् । तेन इष्ट्वा धनम् अजयत् । तेन धनम् जिगीषन् यजेत ।
text_mt: Indra, desiring to conquer booty, performed ascetic heat and saw this sacrificial rite, the Dhanajit. Having sacrificed with it, he conquered booty. Desiring to conquer booty, one should sacrifice with it.

sanskrit_iast: indro vai svar jigīṣaṃs tapas taptvā etam yajña kratum apaśyat svar jitam | tena iṣṭvā svar ajayat | tena svar jigīṣan yajeta |
meaning: इन्द्रो वै स्वर् जिगीषंस् तपस् तप्त्वा एतम् यज्ञ क्रतुम् अपश्यत् स्वर् जितम् । तेन इष्ट्वा स्वर् अजयत् । तेन स्वर् जिगीषन् यजेत ।
text_mt: Indra, desiring to conquer heaven, performed ascetic heat and saw this sacrificial rite, the Svarjit. Having sacrificed with it, he conquered heaven. Desiring to conquer heaven, one should sacrifice with it.

sanskrit_iast: utsanna yajña iva vā eṣa yat svarjit |
meaning: उत्सन्न यज्ञ इव वा एष यत् स्वर्जित् ।
text_mt: That which is the Svarjit is like a neglected sacrifice.

sanskrit_iast: indro vai sarvam jigīṣaṃs tapas taptvā etam yajña kratum apaśyat sarvajitam | tena iṣṭvā sarvam ajayat | tena sarvam jigīṣan yajeta |
meaning: इन्द्रो वै सर्वम् जिगीषंस् तपस् तप्त्वा एतम् यज्ञ क्रतुम् अपश्यत् सर्वजितम् । तेन इष्ट्वा सर्वम् अजयत् । तेन सर्वम् जिगीषन् यजेत ।
text_mt: Indra, desiring to conquer all, performed ascetic heat and saw this sacrificial rite, the Sarvajit. Having sacrificed with it, he conquered all. Desiring to conquer all, one should sacrifice with it.

sanskrit_iast: indro vai sarvam ujjigīṣaṃs tapas taptvā etam yajña kratum apaśyad ujjitam | tena iṣṭvā sarvam udajayat | tena sarvam ujjigīṣan yajeta |
meaning: इन्द्रो वै सर्वम् उज्जिगीषंस् तपस् तप्त्वा एतम् यज्ञ क्रतुम् अपश्यद् उज्जितम् । तेन इष्ट्वा सर्वम् उदजयत् । तेन सर्वम् उज्जिगीषन् यजेत ।
text_mt: Indra, desiring to conquer completely, performed ascetic heat and saw this sacrificial rite, the Ujjit. Having sacrificed with it, he conquered completely. Desiring to conquer completely, one should sacrifice with it.

sanskrit_iast: janiṣṭhā ugraḥ sahase turāya tam u ṣṭuhi yo abhibhūty ojā iti nividdhāne |
meaning: जनिष्ठा उग्रः सहसे तुराय तम् उ ष्टुहि यो अभिभूत्य् ओजा इति निविद्धाने ।
text_mt: "The fierce was born for swift strength" and "Praise him who has conquering might" are the two nivid-hymns.

sanskrit_iast: dhāntāt prapitvād udaranta garbhā utturvayāṇam dhṛṣatā ninetha ity udvatī tad etasya ahno rūpam |
meaning: धान्तात् प्रपित्वाद् उदरन्त गर्भा उत्तुर्वयाणम् धृषता निनेथ इत्य् उद्वती तद् एतस्य अह्नो रूपम् ।
text_mt: "From the blow struck at dawn the embryos were born; with bold power you brought out Turvayāṇa"—these [verses] containing 'ud' are the characteristic mark of this day.

sanskrit_iast: indro vai triśīrṣāṇam tvāṣṭram ahanat | arunmukhān yatīn sālāvṛkebhyaḥ prāyacchat | tam sarvāṇi bhūtāny abhyākrośan | sa devebhyaḥ pārśvata iva cacāra | te devā ūcuḥ | yadi vā ayam evam cariṣyaty abhi no asurā bhaviṣyanti | upa tam yajña kratum jānīma yena enam upāhvayemahi iti | ta etam uaphavyam yajña kratum apaśyan | tena enam upāhvayanta | tena avaruddho rājā yajeta rāṣṭram avajigīṣan | aha vā eva gacchati |
meaning: इन्द्रो वै त्रिशीर्षाणम् त्वाष्ट्रम् अहनत् । अरुन्मुखान् यतीन् सालावृकेभ्यः प्रायच्छत् । तम् सर्वाणि भूतान्य् अभ्याक्रोशन् । स देवेभ्यः पार्श्वत इव चचार । ते देवा ऊचुः । यदि वा अयम् एवम् चरिष्यत्य् अभि नो असुरा भविष्यन्ति । उप तम् यज्ञ क्रतुम् जानीम येन एनम् उपाह्वयेमहि इति । त एतम् उअफव्यम् यज्ञ क्रतुम् अपश्यन् । तेन एनम् उपाह्वयन्त । तेन अवरुद्धो राजा यजेत राष्ट्रम् अवजिगीषन् । अह वा एव गच्छति ।
text_mt:
Indra slew the three-headed son of Tvaṣṭṛ. He threw the Yatis, whose mouths were not cut, to the hyenas. All creatures reviled him. He wandered beside the gods, as it were. The gods said: "If he wanders thus, the Asuras will overcome us."
"Let us discover that sacrificial rite by which we might call him back." They saw this sacrificial rite, the Upahavya. By it they called him back. By it an expelled king should sacrifice, desiring to reconquer his kingdom. He surely reaches it.

sanskrit_iast: imā u tvā purutamasya kāror havyam vīra havyā havante ya eka iddhavyaś carṣaṇīnām iti hūtavatī nividdhāne | tad etasya ahno rūpam |
meaning: इमा उ त्वा पुरुतमस्य कारोर् हव्यम् वीर हव्या हवन्ते य एक इद्धव्यश् चर्षणीनाम् इति हूतवती निविद्धाने । तद् एतस्य अह्नो रूपम् ।
text_mt: "These offerings of the most abundant singer; the offerings, O hero, call thee; he who alone is to be invoked by the peoples"—these two containing the call [to invoke] are the nivid-hymns. That is the characteristic mark of this day.

sanskrit_iast: tam abhy eva ākrośann anahar jātatayā vā etat pāpyā vā alakṣmyā | so agnaye sarvāṇi savanāni prāyacchat | tasya agniḥ sarvām anahar jātatām sarvām pāpīm alakṣṇīm niradahat | sa yo anahar jātaḥ syād yam vā pāpī vāg abhivadet so agni ṣṭutā yajeta | tasya agniḥ sarvām anahar jātatām sarvām pāpīm alakṣmīm nirdahati ya evam veda ya u ca enena yajate |
meaning: तम् अभ्य् एव आक्रोशन्न् अनहर् जाततया वा एतत् पाप्या वा अलक्ष्म्या । सो अग्नये सर्वाणि सवनानि प्रायच्छत् । तस्य अग्निः सर्वाम् अनहर् जातताम् सर्वाम् पापीम् अलक्ष्णीम् निरदहत् । स यो अनहर् जातः स्याद् यम् वा पापी वाग् अभिवदेत् सो अग्नि ष्टुता यजेत । तस्य अग्निः सर्वाम् अनहर् जातताम् सर्वाम् पापीम् अलक्ष्मीम् निर्दहति य एवम् वेद य उ च एनेन यजते ।
text_mt:
They reviled him indeed, on account of illegitimacy, or due to this misfortune, or ill luck. He offered all the pressings to Agni. Agni burned away all his illegitimacy, all his evil ill luck.
He who might be born out of wedlock, or whom an evil voice might accuse, should sacrifice with the Agniṣṭut. Agni burns away all his illegitimacy, all his evil ill luck, who knows thus and who sacrifices with this.

sanskrit_iast: trivṛt stomena triṣṭomena vā brahma varcasa kāmaḥ |
meaning: त्रिवृत् स्तोमेन त्रिष्टोमेन वा ब्रह्म वर्चस कामः ।
text_mt: One desiring spiritual luster [performs it] with the nine-fold stoma or with the Triṣṭoma.
One desiring firm standing [performs it] with the Catuṣṭoma.

sanskrit_iast: prātar anuvāka prabhṛti hāriyojana antam sarvam āgneyam |
meaning: प्रातर् अनुवाक प्रभृति हारियोजन अन्तम् सर्वम् आग्नेयम् ।
text_mt: Beginning with the morning recitation and ending with the Hāriyojana cup, everything belongs to Agni.

sanskrit_iast: agnim manye pitaram it pratipat prātar anuvākasya |
meaning: अग्निम् मन्ये पितरम् इत् प्रतिपत् प्रातर् अनुवाकस्य ।
text_mt: "I consider Agni as father" is the opening verse of the morning recitation.

sanskrit_iast: liṅga īpsur uttarayoḥ kratvor agni śabdam kurvīta |
meaning: लिङ्ग ईप्सुर् उत्तरयोः क्रत्वोर् अग्नि शब्दम् कुर्वीत ।
text_mt: Wishing for the characteristic word, he should use the word 'Agni' in the subsequent two rites.

sanskrit_iast: pra devatra ity uddhṛtya somasya mā iti caturdaśa |
meaning: प्र देवत्र इत्य् उद्धृत्य सोमस्य मा इति चतुर्दश ।
text_mt: Excluding "Forth among the gods", [he recites] fourteen verses [beginning with] "Me of Soma..."
While the waters are being poured in, [he recites the verse] "Him the plants..."

sanskrit_iast: aurvabhṛguvad iti tisro ambaya ity uddhṛtya |
meaning: और्वभृगुवद् इति तिस्रो अम्बय इत्य् उद्धृत्य ।
text_mt: Excluding "Like Aurva and Bhṛgu", [he recites] three verses [beginning with] "O waters, mothers..."

sanskrit_iast: upaprayantas trīṇi śata iti prathame uttamā ca agni manthanīyānām |
meaning: उपप्रयन्तस् त्रीणि शत इति प्रथमे उत्तमा च अग्नि मन्थनीयानाम् ।
text_mt: "Approaching..." and "Three hundred..." are the first and the last of the verses for the churning of fire.

sanskrit_iast: agne juṣasva no havir iti prathamā caturthī pañcamī ca savanīyānām |
meaning: अग्ने जुषस्व नो हविर् इति प्रथमा चतुर्थी पञ्चमी च सवनीयानाम् ।
text_mt: 'Agne juṣasva no haviḥ' are the first, fourth, and fifth verses for the savanīya [offerings].

sanskrit_iast: dūtam vo viśva vedasam iti dvi devatyānām |
meaning: दूतम् वो विश्व वेदसम् इति द्वि देवत्यानाम् ।
text_mt: 'Dūtaṃ vo viśvavedasam' is for the dvidaivatya [cups].
'Agnim īḷe purohitam' is for those being drawn forward.
'Agniṃ dūtam' consists of seven [verses] for the prasthita [oblations].
The next four are in place of the Acchāvāka's hymn.
'Agne divaḥ' is the consecratory verse for the ājya-śastra.

sanskrit_iast: upa tvā jāmaya aibhir agne kas te jāmir na yor upabdir agnir vṛtrāṇy agne sutasya agne dhṛta vratāya iti prauga tṛcāni |
meaning: उप त्वा जामय ऐभिर् अग्ने कस् ते जामिर् न योर् उपब्दिर् अग्निर् वृत्राण्य् अग्ने सुतस्य अग्ने धृत व्रताय इति प्रौग तृचानि ।
text_mt: 'Upa tvā jāmayaḥ', 'eibhir agne', 'kas te jāmiḥ', 'na yor upabdiḥ', 'agnir vṛtrāṇi', 'agne sutasya', 'agne dhṛtavratāya' are the triplets of the Prauga-śastra.
He recites the offering verse with 'Agne viśvebhir agnibhiḥ'.

sanskrit_iast: kas te jāmiḥ kayā te agne aṅgira iti stotriya anurūpau maitrāvaruṇasya |
meaning: कस् ते जामिः कया ते अग्ने अङ्गिर इति स्तोत्रिय अनुरूपौ मैत्रावरुणस्य ।
text_mt: 'Kas te jāmiḥ' and 'kayā te agne aṅgiraḥ' are the stotriya and anurūpa [triplets] of the Maitrāvaruṇa priest.
At the midday [pressing], however, they are inverted.
'Agnir vṛtrāṇi' belongs to the Brāhmaṇācchaṃsin.
'Agnir mūrdhā' belongs to the Acchāvāka.
'Arcantas tvā' belongs to the Maitrāvaruṇa.
The following one belongs to the Brāhmaṇācchaṃsin.

sanskrit_iast: agne dhṛta vratāya iti ṣaḷ acchāvākasya |
meaning: अग्ने धृत व्रताय इति षऌ अच्छावाकस्य ।
text_mt: The six [verses beginning with] 'agne dhṛtavratāya' belong to the Acchāvāka.
'Agniṃ vo devam' is for those being drawn forward.

sanskrit_iast: pra vaḥ śukrāya iti sapta prasthitānām |
meaning: प्र वः शुक्राय इति सप्त प्रस्थितानाम् ।
text_mt: 'Pra vaḥ śukrāya' consists of seven [verses] for the prasthita [oblations].
The next two are for the cup for the Marutvatīya.

sanskrit_iast: viśo viśo vas tvam agne yajñānām iti pratipad anucarau marutvatīyasya |
meaning: विशो विशो वस् त्वम् अग्ने यज्ञानाम् इति प्रतिपद् अनुचरौ मरुत्वतीयस्य ।
text_mt: 'Viśo viśo vaḥ' and 'tvam agne yajñānām' are the pratipad and anucara for the Marutvatīya-śastra.

sanskrit_iast: agna ā yāhy agnibhiḥ pra vo yahvam iti pragāthau |
meaning: अग्न आ याह्य् अग्निभिः प्र वो यह्वम् इति प्रगाथौ ।
text_mt: 'Agna ā yāhy agnibhiḥ' and 'pra vo yahvam' are the two pragāthas.

sanskrit_iast: agnim na mā mathitam tvam agne prathamo aṅgirā ṛṣir ity eka pātinīnām |
meaning: अग्निम् न मा मथितम् त्वम् अग्ने प्रथमो अङ्गिरा ऋषिर् इत्य् एक पातिनीनाम् ।
text_mt: 'Agniṃ na mā mathitam' and 'tvam agne prathamo aṅgirā ṛṣiḥ' are in place of the single-standing [hymns].
'Agne sa kṣeṣat' is the hymn containing the nivid.

sanskrit_iast: pāhi no agna ekayā pahai no agne rakṣasa iti stotriya anurūpau pragāthau niṣkevalyasya |
meaning: पाहि नो अग्न एकया पहै नो अग्ने रक्षस इति स्तोत्रिय अनुरूपौ प्रगाथौ निष्केवल्यस्य ।
text_mt: 'Pāhi no agna ekayā' and 'pāhi no agne rakṣasaḥ' are the stotriya and anurūpa pragāthas for the Niṣkevalya-śastra.

sanskrit_iast: pra te agne haviṣmatīm iti dhāyyā |
meaning: प्र ते अग्ने हविष्मतीम् इति धाय्या ।
text_mt: 'Pra te agne haviṣmatīm' is the inserted verse.
'Enā vo agnim' is the pragātha.
'Yathā hotar' is the hymn containing the nivid.

sanskrit_iast: agnim agnim vo adhrigum agne jaritar iti stotriya anurūpau pragāthau brāhmaṇācchaṃsinaḥ |
meaning: अग्निम् अग्निम् वो अध्रिगुम् अग्ने जरितर् इति स्तोत्रिय अनुरूपौ प्रगाथौ ब्राह्मणाच्छंसिनः ।
text_mt: 'Agniṃ-agnim vo adhrigum' and 'agne jaritar' are the stotriya and anurūpa pragāthas of the Brāhmaṇācchaṃsin.

sanskrit_iast: acchā naḥ śīra śociṣam ity acchāvākasya |
meaning: अच्छा नः शीर शोचिषम् इत्य् अच्छावाकस्य ।
text_mt: 'Acchā naḥ śīraśociṣam' belongs to the Acchāvāka.

sanskrit_iast: agne vivasvat tvam agne gṛhapatis tvam it saprathā ity anupūrvam pragāthāḥ |
meaning: अग्ने विवस्वत् त्वम् अग्ने गृहपतिस् त्वम् इत् सप्रथा इत्य् अनुपूर्वम् प्रगाथाः ।
text_mt: 'Agne vivasvat', 'tvam agne gṛhapatiḥ', and 'tvam it saprathāḥ' are the pragāthas in regular order.
And 'Yajasva hotar' are the hymns.

sanskrit_iast: aganma mahā ity āditya grahasya puronuvākyā uttarā yājyā |
meaning: अगन्म महा इत्य् आदित्य ग्रहस्य पुरोनुवाक्या उत्तरा याज्या ।
text_mt: 'Aganma mahā' is the introductory verse for the cup for Āditya; the next one is the consecratory verse.

sanskrit_iast: ūrdhvam ū ṣu ṇo adhvarasya hotar iti nava unnīyamānebhyaḥ |
meaning: ऊर्ध्वम् ऊ षु णो अध्वरस्य होतर् इति नव उन्नीयमानेभ्यः ।
text_mt: The nine [verses beginning with] 'ūrdhvam ū ṣu ṇaḥ' and 'adhvarasya hotar' are for those being drawn forward.

sanskrit_iast: tvām agna ṛtāyava iti sapta prasthitānām |
meaning: त्वाम् अग्न ऋतायव इति सप्त प्रस्थितानाम् ।
text_mt: 'Tvām agna ṛtāyavaḥ' consists of seven [verses] for the prasthita [oblations].

sanskrit_iast: eti pra hotā iti sāvitra grahasya puronuvākyā uttarā yājyā |
meaning: एति प्र होता इति सावित्र ग्रहस्य पुरोनुवाक्या उत्तरा याज्या ।
text_mt: 'Eti pra hotā' is the introductory verse for the cup for Savitṛ; the next one is the consecratory verse.

sanskrit_iast: iyam te navyasy aśvam na tvā iti pratipad anucarau vaiśvadevasya |
meaning: इयम् ते नव्यस्य् अश्वम् न त्वा इति प्रतिपद् अनुचरौ वैश्वदेवस्य ।
text_mt: 'Iyam te navyasī' and 'aśvaṃ na tvā' are the pratipad and anucara for the Vaiśvadeva-śastra.

sanskrit_iast: tvam agne draviṇodā iti tisraḥ sāvitrasya |
meaning: त्वम् अग्ने द्रविणोदा इति तिस्रः सावित्रस्य ।
text_mt: The three [verses beginning with] 'tvam agne draviṇodāḥ' are for the hymn to Savitṛ.
The next three are for the hymn to the Ṛbhus.
Four are for the hymn to Heaven and Earth.
Six from the beginning are for the Vaiśvadeva hymn.
'Abodhi jāraḥ' is in place of the verse to Vāyu.
'Juṣasva saprathastamam' is in place of the Surūpakṛtnu [hymn].

sanskrit_iast: samiddho agnir divi iti tisra eka pātinīnām |
meaning: समिद्धो अग्निर् दिवि इति तिस्र एक पातिनीनाम् ।
text_mt: The three [verses beginning with] 'samiddho agnir divi' are in place of the single-standing [hymns].

sanskrit_iast: tad adya vāca iti pañca janīyāyāḥ |
meaning: तद् अद्य वाच इति पञ्च जनीयायाः ।
text_mt: 'Tad adya vācaḥ' is in place of the verse to the Five Peoples.
'Yajñena vardhata' is the consecratory verse.
'Abhi pravanta' is for the clarified butter.
'Ā vo rājānam' is in place of the verse to Rudra.

sanskrit_iast: vasum na citra mahasam iti mārutasya |
meaning: वसुम् न चित्र महसम् इति मारुतस्य ।
text_mt: 'Vasuṃ na citramahasam' is in place of the hymn to the Maruts.

sanskrit_iast: ā no yajñam divi spṛśam ā no vāyav ity agniṣṭoma sāmnaḥ stotriya anurūpau pragāthau |
meaning: आ नो यज्ञम् दिवि स्पृशम् आ नो वायव् इत्य् अग्निष्टोम साम्नः स्तोत्रिय अनुरूपौ प्रगाथौ ।
text_mt: 'Ā no yajñaṃ divispṛśam' and 'ā no vāyo' are the stotriya and anurūpa pragāthas for the Agniṣṭoma chant.

sanskrit_iast: apsv agna ity āpo hi ṣṭhīyānām |
meaning: अप्स्व् अग्न इत्य् आपो हि ष्ठीयानाम् ।
text_mt: 'Apsv agne' is in place of the verses beginning with 'āpo hi ṣṭhā'.
'Taṃ devā budhne' is in place of the verse to the All-gods.
