sanskrit_iast: yad aṣṭavidham tad aṣṭa rātreṇa āpnoti |
meaning: यद् अष्टविधम् तद् अष्ट रात्रेण आप्नोति ।
text_mt: What is eightfold, that one obtains through an eight-day rite.

sanskrit_iast: atha yan nava vidham tan nava rātreṇa |
meaning: अथ यन् नव विधम् तन् नव रात्रेण ।
text_mt: Now, what is ninefold, that [one obtains] through a nine-day rite.

sanskrit_iast: catasro diśaś catasro avāntara diśa ūrdhvā iyam navamī din nava akṣarā bṛhatī tad yat kim ca navavidham adhidaivatam adhyātmam tat sarvam anena āpnoti |
meaning: चतस्रो दिशश् चतस्रो अवान्तर दिश ऊर्ध्वा इयम् नवमी दिन् नव अक्षरा बृहती तद् यत् किम् च नवविधम् अधिदैवतम् अध्यात्मम् तत् सर्वम् अनेन आप्नोति ।
text_mt: There are four directions, four intermediate directions, and this upwards is the ninth direction; the Bṛhatī [quarter-verse] has nine syllables. Whatever is ninefold with respect to the deities [and] with respect to the self, all that one obtains by means of this.

sanskrit_iast: ṣaḷ aho abhijid viśvajitau vaiśvānaraś ca mahā vratam vā anantaram vā abhijito mahā vratam viśvajin navamaḥ |
meaning: षऌ अहो अभिजिद् विश्वजितौ वैश्वानरश् च महा व्रतम् वा अनन्तरम् वा अभिजितो महा व्रतम् विश्वजिन् नवमः ।
text_mt: A six-day period, the Abhijit and the Viśvajit, and the Vaiśvānara or the Mahāvrata; or immediately following the Abhijit is the Mahāvrata, [and] the Viśvajit is the ninth.

sanskrit_iast: jyotir agniṣṭomo gaur ukthya āyur atirātras trir etam upayanti śalalī piśaṅga ity ācakṣate |
meaning: ज्योतिर् अग्निष्टोमो गौर् उक्थ्य आयुर् अतिरात्रस् त्रिर् एतम् उपयन्ति शलली पिशङ्ग इत्य् आचक्षते ।
text_mt: The Jyotir-Agniṣṭoma, the Gor-Ukthya, [and] the Āyur-Atirātra: they undertake this three times; they call it the Śalalīpiśaṅga.

sanskrit_iast: yan navavidham tan nava rātreṇa āpnoti |
meaning: यन् नवविधम् तन् नव रात्रेण आप्नोति ।
text_mt: What is ninefold, that one obtains through a nine-day rite.
Now, what is tenfold, that [one obtains] through a ten-day rite.

sanskrit_iast: daśa akṣarā vilāḷ annam virāṭ tad yat kim ca daśavidham adhidaivatam adhyātmam tat sarvam enena āpnoti |
meaning: दश अक्षरा विलाऌ अन्नम् विराट् तद् यत् किम् च दशविधम् अधिदैवतम् अध्यात्मम् तत् सर्वम् एनेन आप्नोति ।
text_mt: The Virāj has ten syllables; the Virāj is food. Whatever is tenfold with respect to the deities [and] with respect to the self, all that one obtains by means of this.
One and a half Abhiplava [periods], or nine Agniṣṭomas.
A ten-day rite is a modification of the form [of the sacrifice].

sanskrit_iast: etena ha jalo jātū karṇya iṣṭvā trayāṇām nigusthānām purodhām prāpa kāśya vaidehayoḥ kausalyasya ca |
meaning: एतेन ह जलो जातू कर्ण्य इष्ट्वा त्रयाणाम् निगुस्थानाम् पुरोधाम् प्राप काश्य वैदेहयोः कौसल्यस्य च ।
text_mt: Having sacrificed with this, Jala Jātūkarṇya obtained the office of domestic priest of three kingdoms: of the Kāśya, of the Vaideha, and of the Kausalya.

sanskrit_iast: tasya ha tat śvetaketuḥ śriyam abhidhyāya pitaram adhyūhe palita yajña kāmān yān vā u śriyā yaśasā samardhayitum vā ittha no ātmānam iti |
meaning: तस्य ह तत् श्वेतकेतुः श्रियम् अभिध्याय पितरम् अध्यूहे पलित यज्ञ कामान् यान् वा उ श्रिया यशसा समर्धयितुम् वा इत्थ नो आत्मानम् इति ।
text_mt: Contemplating his prosperity, Śvetaketu challenged his father: 'Old man, desiring sacrifices, [are you able] to provide those people with prosperity and glory, or yourself in this way?'

sanskrit_iast: tam ha uvāca | mā mā evam putra voco yajña kratur eva me vijñāto abhūt tam eva etat kṛtsnake brahma bandhau vyajijñāsiṣi |
meaning: तम् ह उवाच । मा मा एवम् पुत्र वोचो यज्ञ क्रतुर् एव मे विज्ञातो अभूत् तम् एव एतत् कृत्स्नके ब्रह्म बन्धौ व्यजिज्ञासिषि ।
text_mt: He said to him: 'Do not speak to me thus, my son. The sacrificial rite alone has been understood by me. I wished to comprehend only that completely in a nominal Brahmin.'

sanskrit_iast: tad u kila tathā eva āsa yathā eva enam provāca |
meaning: तद् उ किल तथा एव आस यथा एव एनम् प्रोवाच ।
text_mt: And it was indeed just as he said to him.
This is the sacrifice for one desiring the office of domestic priest.

sanskrit_iast: pra purodhām āpnoti ya evam veda |
meaning: प्र पुरोधाम् आप्नोति य एवम् वेद ।
text_mt: He who knows thus obtains the office of domestic priest.
The recitation of the Trikakubh is from the combined Catuṣṭoma.
And then the Mahātrikakubh.
And the Chandomatrikakubh.

sanskrit_iast: agniṣṭud indrastud vaiśvadeva stut pṛṣṭhyo vaiśvānaraś ca |
meaning: अग्निष्टुद् इन्द्रस्तुद् वैश्वदेव स्तुत् पृष्ठ्यो वैश्वानरश् च ।
text_mt: The Agniṣṭut, the Indrastut, the Vaiśvadevastut, the Pṛṣṭhya, and the Vaiśvānara.

sanskrit_iast: ṣaḷaho abhijid aśvajitau mahā vratam vaiśvānaraś ca |
meaning: षऌअहो अभिजिद् अश्वजितौ महा व्रतम् वैश्वानरश् च ।
text_mt: A six-day period, the Abhijit and the Aśvajit, the Mahāvrata, and the Vaiśvānara.

sanskrit_iast: prākṛto agniṣṭomo navamo aṣṭamo vā viśvajid daśamaḥ |
meaning: प्राकृतो अग्निष्टोमो नवमो अष्टमो वा विश्वजिद् दशमः ।
text_mt: The archetypal Agniṣṭoma is the ninth or the eighth; the Viśvajit is the tenth.
What is tenfold, that one obtains through a ten-day rite.

sanskrit_iast: atha yad ekādaśavidham tad ekādaśa rātreṇa |
meaning: अथ यद् एकादशविधम् तद् एकादश रात्रेण ।
text_mt: Now, what is elevenfold, that [one obtains] through an eleven-day rite.

sanskrit_iast: ekādaśa akṣarā triṣṭup traiṣṭubhāḥ paśavas tad yat kim ca ekādaśavidham adhidaivatam adhyātmam tat sarvam enena āpnoti |
meaning: एकादश अक्षरा त्रिष्टुप् त्रैष्टुभाः पशवस् तद् यत् किम् च एकादशविधम् अधिदैवतम् अध्यात्मम् तत् सर्वम् एनेन आप्नोति ।
text_mt: The Triṣṭubh has eleven syllables; cattle belong to the Triṣṭubh. Whatever is elevenfold with respect to the deities [and] with respect to the self, all that one obtains by means of this.
A ten-day rite with transposed metres.
They call it the Pauṇḍarīka.
A thousand horses as the eleventh [part], say some.

sanskrit_iast: ta ete purastād agniṣṭomā upariṣṭād atirātrā uttara uttariṇa eka uttarā ahīnāḥ |
meaning: त एते पुरस्ताद् अग्निष्टोमा उपरिष्टाद् अतिरात्रा उत्तर उत्तरिण एक उत्तरा अहीनाः ।
text_mt: These are the Ahīna sacrifices, beginning with Agniṣṭoma, ending with Atirātra, succeeding one another, increasing by one [day].

sanskrit_iast: uttara uttariṇīm eva tat śriyam virājam anna adyam āpnoti ya evam veda ya evam veda |
meaning: उत्तर उत्तरिणीम् एव तत् श्रियम् विराजम् अन्न अद्यम् आप्नोति य एवम् वेद य एवम् वेद ।
text_mt: He who knows thus, who knows thus, obtains ever increasing prosperity, sovereignty, [and] nourishment.

sanskrit_iast: purastād eva katipaya ahena hotā preṅkha phalakam utpāṭayati |
meaning: पुरस्ताद् एव कतिपय अहेन होता प्रेङ्ख फलकम् उत्पाटयति ।
text_mt: A few days before, the Hotṛ cuts out the plank for the swing.
From a standing udumbara tree only.
From the eastern side, where the sun rises.

sanskrit_iast: yadi purastān na vidyeta atha apy uttarataḥ |
meaning: यदि पुरस्तान् न विद्येत अथ अप्य् उत्तरतः ।
text_mt: If it is not found on the east, then also on the north.

sanskrit_iast: mūle chedayitvā prān vā udan vā tiṣṭhann utpāṭya yady aṇur udumbaraḥ syāt |
meaning: मूले छेदयित्वा प्रान् वा उदन् वा तिष्ठन्न् उत्पाट्य यद्य् अणुर् उदुम्बरः स्यात् ।
text_mt: Having caused it to be cut at the base, standing facing east or facing north, having stripped it off; if the udumbara tree is small,

sanskrit_iast: api de vā trīṇi vā phalakāni saṃtṛḍyuḥ |
meaning: अपि दे वा त्रीणि वा फलकानि संतृड्युः ।
text_mt: they may also pierce together two or three planks.
It is one arm's length facing east [long],
He pierces holes through it in four places at the edges.

sanskrit_iast: atha etasya vai vā udumbarasya anyasya vā viśākhyau chedayanti |
meaning: अथ एतस्य वै वा उदुम्बरस्य अन्यस्य वा विशाख्यौ छेदयन्ति ।
text_mt: Then they cut two forked posts from this very udumbara tree or from another;

sanskrit_iast: yady udumbaro na vidyeta yo anyo vṛkṣaḥ phala grahiṣṇuḥ kalyāṇa abhivyāhāro vā syāt tasya etad upakalpayet |
meaning: यद्य् उदुम्बरो न विद्येत यो अन्यो वृक्षः फल ग्रहिष्णुः कल्याण अभिव्याहारो वा स्यात् तस्य एतद् उपकल्पयेत् ।
text_mt: If an udumbara tree is not found, whatever other tree bears fruit or has an auspicious name, he should prepare it from that.
Then they have two muñja-grass ropes made;
So much [space should be left] on both sides of the Hotṛ.
They construct a chair of Udumbara wood for the Udgātṛ.
Its legs are a span [in height].
The head-pieces and cross-bars are a cubit [in length].

sanskrit_iast: tām saṃhatya mauñjībhiḥ syāndyābhir vivayanti dvi guṇābhiḥ prasala visṛṣṭābhiḥ |
meaning: ताम् संहत्य मौञ्जीभिः स्यान्द्याभिर् विवयन्ति द्वि गुणाभिः प्रसल विसृष्टाभिः ।
text_mt: Having fitted it together, they weave it with cords of muñja grass, two-fold and twisted from left to right.

sanskrit_iast: atha etām vīṇām śata tantrīm upakalpayanti |
meaning: अथ एताम् वीणाम् शत तन्त्रीम् उपकल्पयन्ति ।
text_mt: Then they prepare this hundred-stringed lute.
Its body is made of palāśa wood.

sanskrit_iast: api vā audumbarī sūnā pālāśo daṇḍaḥ |
meaning: अपि वा औदुम्बरी सूना पालाशो दण्डः ।
text_mt: Or, alternatively, the body is of Udumbara wood and the neck of palāśa wood.

sanskrit_iast: tām ānaḍuhena sarva rohitena carmaṇā bāhyato lomnā abhiṣīvyanti |
meaning: ताम् आनडुहेन सर्व रोहितेन चर्मणा बाह्यतो लोम्ना अभिषीव्यन्ति ।
text_mt: They cover it with the hide of an ox that is completely red, with the hair outward.
At the base of it, they pierce the neck in ten places.
Through each, they thread ten cords.

sanskrit_iast: daṇḍa samāsā vīṇā śata tantrī bhavati |
meaning: दण्ड समासा वीणा शत तन्त्री भवति ।
text_mt: Thus joined to the neck, the lute becomes a hundred-stringed one.

sanskrit_iast: vetasa śākhā sapalāśā vādiny upaklṛptā bhavati |
meaning: वेतस शाखा सपलाशा वादिन्य् उपक्लृप्ता भवति ।
text_mt: A reed-branch with leaves is prepared as the plectrum.

sanskrit_iast: ghāṭa karkarīr avaghaṭarikāḥ kāṇḍavīṇāḥ piccorā iti patnya upakalpayanti |
meaning: घाट कर्करीर् अवघटरिकाः काण्डवीणाः पिच्चोरा इति पत्न्य उपकल्पयन्ति ।
text_mt: The wives prepare [lutes called] ghāṭakarkarīs, avaghaṭarikās, kāṇḍavīṇās, and piccorās.
One should play the picchorā by blowing into it with the mouth.
They call it ghāṭarī.

sanskrit_iast: yā ghāṭarī mṛdum vādayet sārātiḥ syāt |
meaning: या घाटरी मृदुम् वादयेत् सारातिः स्यात् ।
text_mt: A woman who plays the ghāṭarī softly would be an adversary.
The Adhvaryu prepares four drums along with drumsticks.

sanskrit_iast: pūrvasyai dvāryā abhito dvāra bāhū bahiḥ sadaḥ saṃdhau sahananāv āsañjayati |
meaning: पूर्वस्यै द्वार्या अभितो द्वार बाहू बहिः सदः संधौ सहननाव् आसञ्जयति ।
text_mt: By the front door, on both sides of the doorposts, at the junction outside the sadas, he fastens two [drums] with drumsticks.

sanskrit_iast: aparasyai dvāryā abhito dvāra bāhū antaḥ sadaḥ saṃdhau sahananāv āsañjayati |
meaning: अपरस्यै द्वार्या अभितो द्वार बाहू अन्तः सदः संधौ सहननाव् आसञ्जयति ।
text_mt: By the back door, on both sides of the doorposts, at the junction inside the sadas, he fastens two [drums] with drumsticks.

sanskrit_iast: yadi ṣaṭ syur dakṣiṇa ardhe sadasa ekam uttara ardha ekam |
meaning: यदि षट् स्युर् दक्षिण अर्धे सदस एकम् उत्तर अर्ध एकम् ।
text_mt: If there are six, [he fastens] one in the southern half of the sadas and one in the northern half.

sanskrit_iast: muñjānām ca kuśānām ca kūrcam adhvaryave saṃskurvanti |
meaning: मुञ्जानाम् च कुशानाम् च कूर्चम् अध्वर्यवे संस्कुर्वन्ति ।
text_mt: They prepare a cushion of muñja and kuśa grass for the Adhvaryu.
Standing upon it, he makes the ritual response.

sanskrit_iast: atha itare dīkṣitāḥ pratipuruṣam bṛsīḥ kurvate yathā prādeśa mātreṇa upari bhūmeḥ syuḥ |
meaning: अथ इतरे दीक्षिताः प्रतिपुरुषम् बृसीः कुर्वते यथा प्रादेश मात्रेण उपरि भूमेः स्युः ।
text_mt: Then the other consecrated participants make cushions for each person, such that they are a span above the ground.

sanskrit_iast: atha yā mārjālīyam paryeṣyantyo bhavanti tābhyaḥ pratyekam navān kalaśān upakalpayanti |
meaning: अथ या मार्जालीयम् पर्येष्यन्त्यो भवन्ति ताभ्यः प्रत्येकम् नवान् कलशान् उपकल्पयन्ति ।
text_mt: Then for the women who are to go around the mārjālīya, they prepare new water-jars for each of them.

sanskrit_iast: atha etam aśvaratham upakalpayanti vitata varūtham |
meaning: अथ एतम् अश्वरथम् उपकल्पयन्ति वितत वरूथम् ।
text_mt: Then they prepare this horse-drawn chariot with its protective fender spread out.

sanskrit_iast: rājānam vā rāja mātram vājer astāram |
meaning: राजानम् वा राज मात्रम् वाजेर् अस्तारम् ।
text_mt: And a king or one of royal rank as an archer for the contest.

sanskrit_iast: yadi rājā vā rāja mātro vā na vidyeta ya etām dhiyam vidyāt sa etat kuryāt |
meaning: यदि राजा वा राज मात्रो वा न विद्येत य एताम् धियम् विद्यात् स एतत् कुर्यात् ।
text_mt: If a king or one of royal rank is not to be found, whoever knows this sacred procedure should perform this.

sanskrit_iast: uttareṇa āgnīdhram prāñcyau prahve sthūṇe viminvanty ākhaṇāya |
meaning: उत्तरेण आग्नीध्रम् प्राञ्च्यौ प्रह्वे स्थूणे विमिन्वन्त्य् आखणाय ।
text_mt: North of the Āgnīdhra hut, they erect two posts inclined towards the east for the target-skin.

sanskrit_iast: tad iḷa saṃvartam vā utkaram vā carmaṇā abhivitanvanti |
meaning: तद् इऌअ संवर्तम् वा उत्करम् वा चर्मणा अभिवितन्वन्ति ।
text_mt: Over the mound or the rubbish-heap, they stretch a hide.
He must not pierce it with a feathered [arrow].

sanskrit_iast: jaghanena āgnīdhram bahir vedya vaṭam khananti |
meaning: जघनेन आग्नीध्रम् बहिर् वेद्य वटम् खनन्ति ।
text_mt: Behind the Āgnīdhra hut, outside the altar, they dig a pit.

sanskrit_iast: tam etasya upālambhyasya ṛṣabhasya carmaṇā prācīna grīveṇa udīcīna grīveṇa vā uttarato lomnā abhiṣīvyanti |
meaning: तम् एतस्य उपालम्भ्यस्य ऋषभस्य चर्मणा प्राचीन ग्रीवेण उदीचीन ग्रीवेण वा उत्तरतो लोम्ना अभिषीव्यन्ति ।
text_mt: They cover it with the hide of this ox that is to be offered, with the neck pointing east or with the neck pointing north, with the hairy side upward.

sanskrit_iast: tam tasya eva lāṅgūlena kāle bhūmi dundubhim āghnanti |
meaning: तम् तस्य एव लाङ्गूलेन काले भूमि दुन्दुभिम् आघ्नन्ति ।
text_mt: At the appointed time, they beat this earth-drum with that very ox's tail.

sanskrit_iast: atha śūdra āryau strī pumāṃsau baṇḍa khalatī ity upakalpayanti |
meaning: अथ शूद्र आर्यौ स्त्री पुमांसौ बण्ड खलती इत्य् उपकल्पयन्ति ।
text_mt: Then they arrange for a Śūdra man and an Ārya woman, a eunuch and a bald man.

sanskrit_iast: tad etat purāṇam utsannam na kāryam etasmin samupaklṛpte |
meaning: तद् एतत् पुराणम् उत्सन्नम् न कार्यम् एतस्मिन् समुपक्लृप्ते ।
text_mt: This is an ancient practice and has fallen into disuse; it should not be performed once this has been prepared.

sanskrit_iast: saṃsthite daśame ahani sado havir dhānāni samūhanti |
meaning: संस्थिते दशमे अहनि सदो हविर् धानानि समूहन्ति ।
text_mt: When the tenth day has concluded, they sweep together the sadas and the cartshed.
And the Āgnīdhra shed and the wife's hall.
Then they spread thickly with fresh kuśa grass.

sanskrit_iast: katipayān kuśa bhārān nidadhati prātar bṛsībhyaḥ |
meaning: कतिपयान् कुश भारान् निदधति प्रातर् बृसीभ्यः ।
text_mt: They deposit several bundles of kuśa grass for the morning cushions.

sanskrit_iast: atha mahā rātre mahā vratāya prātar anuvākam upākurvanti |
meaning: अथ महा रात्रे महा व्रताय प्रातर् अनुवाकम् उपाकुर्वन्ति ।
text_mt: Then in the dead of night, they begin the morning chant for the Mahāvrata.
So that he may recite about a thousand [verses].
Its stoma is the twenty-five-fold one.

sanskrit_iast: atha ete pariṣṭavaṇīyā bhavanti tṛvṛt pañcadaśaḥ saptadaśa ekaviṃśa iti |
meaning: अथ एते परिष्टवणीया भवन्ति तृवृत् पञ्चदशः सप्तदश एकविंश इति ।
text_mt: Then these are the subsidiary chants: the threefold, the fifteenfold, the seventeenfold, and the twenty-onefold.

sanskrit_iast: aindrāgno vā aikādaśinānām vā ekaḥ savanīyaḥ |
meaning: ऐन्द्राग्नो वा ऐकादशिनानाम् वा एकः सवनीयः ।
text_mt: The pressing-day animal offering is either dedicated to Indra-and-Agni or is one of the eleven victim set.

sanskrit_iast: aindraś ca ṛṣabhaḥ prājāpatyaś ca aja upālambhyau |
meaning: ऐन्द्रश् च ऋषभः प्राजापत्यश् च अज उपालम्भ्यौ ।
text_mt: And a bull dedicated to Indra and a goat dedicated to Prajāpati are to be offered.

sanskrit_iast: te yatra vapāsu hutāṣu samprasarpanti tad etat preṅkha miśram bahir vedi prakṣālya antareṇa cātvāla utkarau tīrtham tena prapadya uttareṇa āgnīdhrīyam dhiṣṇyam paryāhṛtya pūrvayā dvārā sadaḥ prahṛtya agreṇa uttareṇa hotur dhiṣṇyam prān upanidadhati |
meaning: ते यत्र वपासु हुताषु सम्प्रसर्पन्ति तद् एतत् प्रेङ्ख मिश्रम् बहिर् वेदि प्रक्षाल्य अन्तरेण चात्वाल उत्करौ तीर्थम् तेन प्रपद्य उत्तरेण आग्नीध्रीयम् धिष्ण्यम् पर्याहृत्य पूर्वया द्वारा सदः प्रहृत्य अग्रेण उत्तरेण होतुर् धिष्ण्यम् प्रान् उपनिदधति ।
text_mt: When they glide forward as the omenta are offered, having washed outside the altar that [swing-plank] along with the swing, entering by the path between the pit and the rubbish-heap, carrying it around to the north of the Āgnīdhra hearth, bringing it forward through the eastern door of the sadas, they deposit it facing east in front and north of the Hotṛ's hearth.

sanskrit_iast: evam eva yasya yasya bahir vedi bhavati yathā saṃcaraḥ samprasarpaṇe bhavati tathā āhṛtya uttarata upanidadhati |
meaning: एवम् एव यस्य यस्य बहिर् वेदि भवति यथा संचरः सम्प्रसर्पणे भवति तथा आहृत्य उत्तरत उपनिदधति ।
text_mt: In this very manner, whatever belongs outside the altar, bringing it in according to the route taken when gliding forward, they deposit it to the north.

sanskrit_iast: tasya traiṣṭubham prātaḥ savanam syād iti paiṅgyam śuṣka bhṛṅgārīyam |
meaning: तस्य त्रैष्टुभम् प्रातः सवनम् स्याद् इति पैङ्ग्यम् शुष्क भृङ्गारीयम् ।
text_mt: Its morning pressing should be in the Triṣṭubh metre: thus holds the Paiṅgya and the Śuṣkabhṛṅgārīya.

sanskrit_iast: viśo viśo vo atithim ity ājyam |
meaning: विशो विशो वो अतिथिम् इत्य् आज्यम् ।
text_mt: "To every clan your guest…" is the ājya-śastra.

sanskrit_iast: tasya dvādaśa ardharcaśaḥ śastvā agnim naro dīdhitibhir araṇyor ity etat pañcaviṃśaty ṛcam upasaṃśaṃsati |
meaning: तस्य द्वादश अर्धर्चशः शस्त्वा अग्निम् नरो दीधितिभिर् अरण्योर् इत्य् एतत् पञ्चविंशत्य् ऋचम् उपसंशंसति ।
text_mt: Having recited twelve [verses] of it half-verse by half-verse, he recites in addition this twenty-five-verse hymn: "Men [have generated] Agni with their reflections from the two kindling sticks…".

sanskrit_iast: kuvid aṅga namasā ye vṛdhāsa iti vāyavyam ca aindravāyavam ca |
meaning: कुविद् अङ्ग नमसा ये वृधास इति वायव्यम् च ऐन्द्रवायवम् च ।
text_mt: "Will they not with reverence… they who have grown…" are the Vāyu and Indra-Vāyu triplets.
And the Mitra-Varuṇa triplet is as on the Viṣuvant day.

sanskrit_iast: ka u śravat katamo yajñiyānām ity āśvinam |
meaning: क उ श्रवत् कतमो यज्ञियानाम् इत्य् आश्विनम् ।
text_mt: "Who will hear? Which of those worthy of sacrifice…" is the Aśvin triplet.

sanskrit_iast: kathā mahām avṛdhat kasya hotur ity aindram |
meaning: कथा महाम् अवृधत् कस्य होतुर् इत्य् ऐन्द्रम् ।
text_mt: "How has the great one grown? Of which Hotṛ…" is the Indra triplet.

sanskrit_iast: uta syā naḥ sarasvatī juṣāṇa iti sārasvatam |
meaning: उत स्या नः सरस्वती जुषाण इति सारस्वतम् ।
text_mt: "May this Sarasvatī, finding pleasure…" is the Sarasvatī triplet.
Or the morning pressing is that of the one-day sacrifice.
The morning pressing is arranged.
Now then the midday pressing.

sanskrit_iast: ā tvā ratham yathā ūtaya iti marutvatīyasya pratipat |
meaning: आ त्वा रथम् यथा ऊतय इति मरुत्वतीयस्य प्रतिपत् ।
text_mt: "[Come] to us, into the chariot, for our help…" is the introductory verse of the Marutvatīya-śastra.

sanskrit_iast: idam vaso sutam andha ity anucaraḥ |
meaning: इदम् वसो सुतम् अन्ध इत्य् अनुचरः ।
text_mt: "This pressed food, O Vasu…" is the following verse.
This alone is the regular one-day arrangement.

sanskrit_iast: asatsu me jaritaḥ sābhivega iti vāsukram pūrvam śastvā mahān indro nṛvadā carṣaṇiprā ity etasmiṃs traiṣṭubhe nividam dadhāti |
meaning: असत्सु मे जरितः साभिवेग इति वासुक्रम् पूर्वम् शस्त्वा महान् इन्द्रो नृवदा चर्षणिप्रा इत्य् एतस्मिंस् त्रैष्टुभे निविदम् दधाति ।
text_mt: Having first recited the Vāsukra hymn, "Among non-beings, O singer, is my strong impulse…", he inserts the nivid into this Triṣṭubh hymn: "The great Indra, who like a man fills the peoples…".
He should recite both hymns verse-quarter by verse-quarter.

sanskrit_iast: saṃsthite prātaḥ savane preṅkhāvaṭau khānayed iti sā sthitiḥ |
meaning: संस्थिते प्रातः सवने प्रेङ्खावटौ खानयेद् इति सा स्थितिः ।
text_mt: When the morning pressing is concluded, he should have the two swing-pits dug—such is the rule.
When the Marutvatīya-śastra has been recited—so says Paiṅgya.

sanskrit_iast: jaghanena svam dhiṣṇyam padam ca catur aṅgulam ca pramāya tat paścād udīcīna agram phalakam nidhāya ubhayataś catur aṅgule upadhāya bahiś catur aṅgulābhyām lekhe lekhayitvā preṅkhāvaṭau khānayed dakṣiṇam pūrvam atha uttaram |
meaning: जघनेन स्वम् धिष्ण्यम् पदम् च चतुर् अङ्गुलम् च प्रमाय तत् पश्चाद् उदीचीन अग्रम् फलकम् निधाय उभयतश् चतुर् अङ्गुले उपधाय बहिश् चतुर् अङ्गुलाभ्याम् लेखे लेखयित्वा प्रेङ्खावटौ खानयेद् दक्षिणम् पूर्वम् अथ उत्तरम् ।
text_mt: Having measured behind his own dhiṣṇya-hearth a foot and four finger-breadths, having placed behind that the board pointing northwards, having set [it] with four finger-breadths on both sides, having had two lines drawn outside the four finger-breadths, he should have the two swing-pits dug, the southern one first, then the northern.

sanskrit_iast: prāñcau vā udañcau vā utkirā utkiranti |
meaning: प्राञ्चौ वा उदञ्चौ वा उत्किरा उत्किरन्ति ।
text_mt: They throw out the dug-out earth either eastward or northward.

sanskrit_iast: tad viśākhyāv avadhāya udīcīna agram vaṃśam abhyādadhāti |
meaning: तद् विशाख्याव् अवधाय उदीचीन अग्रम् वंशम् अभ्यादधाति ।
text_mt: Having inserted two forked posts there, he lays a crossbeam upon them pointing northwards.

sanskrit_iast: yadi hrasvaḥ syād ūrdhva bāhur mimīte |
meaning: यदि ह्रस्वः स्याद् ऊर्ध्व बाहुर् मिमीते ।
text_mt: If he be short, he measures with his arms raised.

sanskrit_iast: dṛḍha paryuṣṭe paryṛṣati yathā na vyatheyātām |
meaning: दृढ पर्युष्टे पर्यृषति यथा न व्यथेयाताम् ।
text_mt: He wedges it firmly round with props, so that they may not waver.

sanskrit_iast: atha etat preṅkha phalakam rajjubhiś caturdhā anteṣu parivyayati yathā na sambhraśyeta |
meaning: अथ एतत् प्रेङ्ख फलकम् रज्जुभिश् चतुर्धा अन्तेषु परिव्ययति यथा न सम्भ्रश्येत ।
text_mt: Then he winds this swing-board fourfold with ropes at the ends, so that it may not fall apart.

sanskrit_iast: uttareṇa dakṣiṇām preṅkha sthūṇām dakṣiṇām rajjum badhnanti |
meaning: उत्तरेण दक्षिणाम् प्रेङ्ख स्थूणाम् दक्षिणाम् रज्जुम् बध्नन्ति ।
text_mt: They fasten the southern rope north of the southern swing-post.

sanskrit_iast: dakṣiṇena uttarām preṅkha sthūṇām uttarām rajjum badhnanti |
meaning: दक्षिणेन उत्तराम् प्रेङ्ख स्थूणाम् उत्तराम् रज्जुम् बध्नन्ति ।
text_mt: They fasten the northern rope south of the northern swing-post.

sanskrit_iast: tat sambādhya prāsyati yathā prādeśa mātreṇa upari bhūmeḥ syāt |
meaning: तत् सम्बाध्य प्रास्यति यथा प्रादेश मात्रेण उपरि भूमेः स्यात् ।
text_mt: Having drawn it tight, he hangs it so that it is a span above the ground.

sanskrit_iast: tad abhi nivīḷham paryṛṣati yathā na vyatheta |
meaning: तद् अभि निवीऌहम् पर्यृषति यथा न व्यथेत ।
text_mt: He packs it round firmly, so that it may not shake.

sanskrit_iast: tat sambādhya uttarasyām preṅkha sthūṇāyām apāśrayati |
meaning: तत् सम्बाध्य उत्तरस्याम् प्रेङ्ख स्थूणायाम् अपाश्रयति ।
text_mt: Having drawn it tight, he leans it against the northern swing-post.

sanskrit_iast: tat śaste marutvatīye yathā sthānam sthāpayet |
meaning: तत् शस्ते मरुत्वतीये यथा स्थानम् स्थापयेत् ।
text_mt: When the Marutvatīya-śastra has been recited, he should set it in place.

sanskrit_iast: atha adhvaryur māhendram graham gṛhītvā iti |
meaning: अथ अध्वर्युर् माहेन्द्रम् ग्रहम् गृहीत्वा इति ।
text_mt: Then the Adhvaryu, having drawn the draught for the Great Indra, [proceeds].
He sits down facing east in front of the Hotṛ's dhiṣṇya-hearth.

sanskrit_iast: tam hotā āha adhvarya upa nu rama iti |
meaning: तम् होता आह अध्वर्य उप नु रम इति ।
text_mt: The Hotṛ says to him: "O Adhvaryu, pause now!"

sanskrit_iast: sa uttareṇa uttarām preṅkha sthūṇām uttareṇa adhvaryum prana upaniṣkramya pūrvayā dvārā āgnīdhram prapadya uttareṇa āgnīdhrīyam dhiṣṇyam paryetya paścāt prān upaviśya dakṣiṇam jānv ācya sruveṇa ājya sthālyā upahatya juhoti |
meaning: स उत्तरेण उत्तराम् प्रेङ्ख स्थूणाम् उत्तरेण अध्वर्युम् प्रन उपनिष्क्रम्य पूर्वया द्वारा आग्नीध्रम् प्रपद्य उत्तरेण आग्नीध्रीयम् धिष्ण्यम् पर्येत्य पश्चात् प्रान् उपविश्य दक्षिणम् जान्व् आच्य स्रुवेण आज्य स्थाल्या उपहत्य जुहोति ।
text_mt: He, having stepped out towards the east north of the northern swing-post and north of the Adhvaryu, entering the Āgnīdhra shed by the eastern door, going round north of the Āgnīdhrīya dhiṣṇya-hearth, sitting down behind it facing east and bending his right knee, having scooped [ghee] from the ghee-pan with the sruva-spoon, offers:

sanskrit_iast: āyuṣmad gāyatram viśvāyū rathantaram sarva āyur bṛhat sāma āyur vāmadevyam atyāyur yajñāyajñīyam teṣām aham āyuṣā ayuṣmān bhūyāsam asyai prāṇaḥ saṃcarati prajāyai hṛdayāya kam sarvā vinuḍya saṃtṛḍyo mayy astu śaradaḥ śatam svāhā iti prathamām |
meaning: आयुष्मद् गायत्रम् विश्वायू रथन्तरम् सर्व आयुर् बृहत् साम आयुर् वामदेव्यम् अत्यायुर् यज्ञायज्ञीयम् तेषाम् अहम् आयुषा अयुष्मान् भूयासम् अस्यै प्राणः संचरति प्रजायै हृदयाय कम् सर्वा विनुड्य संतृड्यो मय्य् अस्तु शरदः शतम् स्वाहा इति प्रथमाम् ।
text_mt:
"Long-lived is the Gāyatra, all-living the Rathantara, full-lived the Bṛhat, life-giving the Vāmadevya, surpassing in life the Yajñāyajñīya; through their life may I become long-lived. May breath circulate for this offspring, for a well-being to the heart; having thrust away and pierced through all [evils], may there be a hundred autumns in me, svāhā!"—thus the first [oblation].
"To the sky, svāhā! To the intermediate space, svāhā! To the earth, svāhā!"—thus three [oblations].

sanskrit_iast: dive svāhā antarikṣāya svāhā pṛthivyai svāhā iti tisraḥ |
meaning: दिवे स्वाहा अन्तरिक्षाय स्वाहा पृथिव्यै स्वाहा इति तिस्रः ।

sanskrit_iast: gave svāhā vāce svāhā vācaspataye svāhā ity aparās tisraḥ |
meaning: गवे स्वाहा वाचे स्वाहा वाचस्पतये स्वाहा इत्य् अपरास् तिस्रः ।

sanskrit_iast: yad idam iti haitiham daivyam saha uccaret | tad vayam yajāmahe yad asmabhyam iti dravat | vāco rājan yajāmahe vācaspate sahasva me | yo asmān abhidāsati | svāhā ity aṣṭamīm hutvā yathā āyatanam sruvam nidhāya yathā prapannam upaniṣkramya agreṇa sada uttareṇa srutim prān tiṣṭhan parimādān japān japati |
meaning: यद् इदम् इति हैतिहम् दैव्यम् सह उच्चरेत् । तद् वयम् यजामहे यद् अस्मभ्यम् इति द्रवत् । वाचो राजन् यजामहे वाचस्पते सहस्व मे । यो अस्मान् अभिदासति । स्वाहा इत्य् अष्टमीम् हुत्वा यथा आयतनम् स्रुवम् निधाय यथा प्रपन्नम् उपनिष्क्रम्य अग्रेण सद उत्तरेण स्रुतिम् प्रान् तिष्ठन् परिमादान् जपान् जपति ।
text_mt:
"To the cow, svāhā! To speech, svāhā! To the lord of speech, svāhā!"—thus three others. / "What here…"—thus the traditional divine [formula] should be uttered together: "That we worship which [is given] to us"—running quickly.
"O King of speech, we worship; O Lord of speech, overpower for me / him who acts with hostility towards us. / Svāhā!"—having offered the eighth [oblation], having placed the sruva-spoon in its proper receptacle, having stepped out just as he entered, standing facing east in front of the sadas [and] north of the track, he mutters the Parimād formulas:

sanskrit_iast: vāg āyur viśva āyur viśvam āyur ehy evā hi indra upehi viśvatha vidā maghavan vidā iti |
meaning: वाग् आयुर् विश्व आयुर् विश्वम् आयुर् एह्य् एवा हि इन्द्र उपेहि विश्वथ विदा मघवन् विदा इति ।
text_mt: "Speech, life, all-life, full life; come indeed, O Indra, approach all-round; find [us], O bounteous one, find [us]!"

sanskrit_iast: atha atra eva tiṣṭhann agnim yathā aṅgam upatiṣṭhate |
meaning: अथ अत्र एव तिष्ठन्न् अग्निम् यथा अङ्गम् उपतिष्ठते ।
text_mt: Then, standing right there, he attends upon Agni limb by limb:

sanskrit_iast: namas te gāyatrāya yat te śiro yat te pura iti pūrva ardham |
meaning: नमस् ते गायत्राय यत् ते शिरो यत् ते पुर इति पूर्व अर्धम् ।
text_mt: "Homage to thee, the Gāyatra! What is thy head, what is thy front…"—[thus] the front half.

sanskrit_iast: namas te rathantarāya yas te dakṣiṇo bāhur yas te dakṣiṇaḥ pakṣa iti dakṣiṇam pakṣam |
meaning: नमस् ते रथन्तराय यस् ते दक्षिणो बाहुर् यस् ते दक्षिणः पक्ष इति दक्षिणम् पक्षम् ।
text_mt: "Homage to thee, the Rathantara! What is thy right arm, what is thy right wing…"—[thus] the right wing.

sanskrit_iast: namas te bṛhate yas ta uttaro bāhur yas ta uttaraḥ pakṣa ity uttaram pakṣam |
meaning: नमस् ते बृहते यस् त उत्तरो बाहुर् यस् त उत्तरः पक्ष इत्य् उत्तरम् पक्षम् ।
text_mt: "Homage to thee, the Bṛhat! What is thy left arm, what is thy left wing…"—[thus] the left wing.

sanskrit_iast: namas te vāmadevyāya yat te madhyam yas ta ātmā iti madhyam |
meaning: नमस् ते वामदेव्याय यत् ते मध्यम् यस् त आत्मा इति मध्यम् ।
text_mt: "Homage to thee, the Vāmadevya! What is thy middle, what is thy self…"—[thus] the middle.

sanskrit_iast: namas te yajñāyajñīyāya yat te puccham yā pratiṣṭhā iti puccham |
meaning: नमस् ते यज्ञायज्ञीयाय यत् ते पुच्छम् या प्रतिष्ठा इति पुच्छम् ।
text_mt: "Homage to thee, the Yajñāyajñīya! What is thy tail, what is thy support…"—[thus] the tail.

sanskrit_iast: samiddhasya eva etān bhāgān upatiṣṭheta yady uttara vedau bhavati |
meaning: समिद्धस्य एव एतान् भागान् उपतिष्ठेत यद्य् उत्तर वेदौ भवति ।
text_mt: He should attend upon these parts of the kindled [fire] alone, if it is on the high altar.

sanskrit_iast: atha atra eva tiṣṭhann ādityam upatiṣṭhate |
meaning: अथ अत्र एव तिष्ठन्न् आदित्यम् उपतिष्ठते ।
text_mt: Then, standing right there, he attends upon the sun:

sanskrit_iast: ākāśam śālāyai kuryur iti ha eka āhuḥ |
meaning: आकाशम् शालायै कुर्युर् इति ह एक आहुः ।
text_mt: "They should make an opening in the hall," so say some.
He attends upon it, however, merely in its direction:

sanskrit_iast: subhūr nāmā asi śreṣṭho rāśmir devānām saṃsadyayā tanvā brahma jinvasi tayā mā jinva tayā mā janaya tayā mā pāhi brahma varcasam anna adyam mayi tviṣim dhā namas te astu mā mā hiṃsīr iti |
meaning: सुभूर् नामा असि श्रेष्ठो राश्मिर् देवानाम् संसद्यया तन्वा ब्रह्म जिन्वसि तया मा जिन्व तया मा जनय तया मा पाहि ब्रह्म वर्चसम् अन्न अद्यम् मयि त्विषिम् धा नमस् ते अस्तु मा मा हिंसीर् इति ।
text_mt: "Well-born by name art thou, the best ray of the gods; with the body assembled together by which thou quickenest the sacred word, with that quicken me, with that bring me forth, with that protect me; bestow on me sacred brilliance, fitness for food, splendor; homage be to thee, do not harm me!"
Then, turning to the right, he enters.

sanskrit_iast: paścāt preṅkham prān upaviśya tad anvārabhyān anusṛjan vāg yata āsta ādhisarpaṇāt |
meaning: पश्चात् प्रेङ्खम् प्रान् उपविश्य तद् अन्वारभ्यान् अनुसृजन् वाग् यत आस्त आधिसर्पणात् ।
text_mt: Sitting down behind the swing facing east, holding on to it without letting go, he remains with restrained speech until the creeping upon [the swing].

sanskrit_iast: sa purastād eva chandogebhyaḥ śīrṣaṇyāṃs tṛcān nigādayeta |
meaning: स पुरस्ताद् एव छन्दोगेभ्यः शीर्षण्यांस् तृचान् निगादयेत ।
text_mt: He should recite aloud the head-triplets for the Sāmaveda chanters beforehand.
He should converse with the Adhvaryu beforehand.

sanskrit_iast: dvādaśa kṛtvas tūṣṇīm śaṃse pratyāgṛṇītād vihṛtam ātmānam ca pada anuṣaṅgāṃś ca saṃśiṣya abhyavahṛtam tvam pratyāgṛṇītād iti |
meaning: द्वादश कृत्वस् तूष्णीम् शंसे प्रत्यागृणीताद् विहृतम् आत्मानम् च पद अनुषङ्गांश् च संशिष्य अभ्यवहृतम् त्वम् प्रत्यागृणीताद् इति ।
text_mt: [The Hotṛ says to the Pratiprasthātṛ]: 'Respond twelve times during the silent recitation; having left over the distributed self and the foot-adjuncts, respond to what is brought down.'

sanskrit_iast: atha prastotāram āha saptasu stotriyāsu pariśiṣṭāsu naḥ prabrūtāt tāvadd hi idam japyam iti |
meaning: अथ प्रस्तोतारम् आह सप्तसु स्तोत्रियासु परिशिष्टासु नः प्रब्रूतात् तावद्द् हि इदम् जप्यम् इति ।
text_mt: Then he says to the Prastotṛ: 'When seven stotriyā verses are remaining, report to us, for so much is to be muttered.'
Then the Adhvaryu brings forth the chant.

sanskrit_iast: yatra eva udgātā āsandīm adihrohaty atha prastotā pratihartārau bṛsyāv adhisarpataḥ |
meaning: यत्र एव उद्गाता आसन्दीम् अदिह्रोहत्य् अथ प्रस्तोता प्रतिहर्तारौ बृस्याव् अधिसर्पतः ।
text_mt: Just when the Udgātṛ ascends the chair, then the Prastotṛ and the Pratihartṛ glide onto the grass cushions;
The Udgātṛ alone first plays the lute;
the wives play after him.
He beats the earth-drum.
The noise-makers make noise.

sanskrit_iast: atha pūrṇa kumbhā apo bibhratyo mārjālīyam pariyanti |
meaning: अथ पूर्ण कुम्भा अपो बिभ्रत्यो मार्जालीयम् परियन्ति ।
text_mt: Then women bearing jars filled with water walk around the Mārjālīya;

sanskrit_iast: hai mahā idam madhv idam madhv ity etām vācam vadanti |
meaning: है महा इदम् मध्व् इदम् मध्व् इत्य् एताम् वाचम् वदन्ति ।
text_mt: they speak this speech: 'Hai mahā3, this is honey, this is honey!'
thereafter, clockwise silently.
Then they harness this horse-chariot;
in front of the southern shoulder of the sacrificial altar.

sanskrit_iast: tam samnaddha ātiṣṭhati rājā vā rāja mātro vā dhanuś ca trīṃś ca iṣūn ādāya |
meaning: तम् सम्नद्ध आतिष्ठति राजा वा राज मात्रो वा धनुश् च त्रींश् च इषून् आदाय ।
text_mt: A king or one of royal rank, having girded himself, mounts it, taking a bow and three arrows.

sanskrit_iast: so abhito vedim triḥ prasalavi parivartamāna etam ākhaṇam vidhyati |
meaning: सो अभितो वेदिम् त्रिः प्रसलवि परिवर्तमान एतम् आखणम् विध्यति ।
text_mt: Turning around the sacrificial altar thrice clockwise, he shoots at this target;
he should not shoot through it with the feathered part.
In the same way a second time, in the same way a third time.
They unyoke it facing northeast;
they unyoke it right there.

sanskrit_iast: atha prastotā saptasu stotriyāsu pariśiṣṭā svāhā velā iti |
meaning: अथ प्रस्तोता सप्तसु स्तोत्रियासु परिशिष्टा स्वाहा वेला इति ।
text_mt: Then the Prastotṛ, when seven stotriyā verses are remaining, says: 'It is the time!'

sanskrit_iast: atha hotā dakṣiṇena prādeśena preṅkha phalakam ca bhūmim ca samṛśan japati sam mahān mahatyā dadhād iti |
meaning: अथ होता दक्षिणेन प्रादेशेन प्रेङ्ख फलकम् च भूमिम् च समृशन् जपति सम् महान् महत्या दधाद् इति ।
text_mt: Then the Hotṛ, touching both the swing-plank and the ground with his right span, mutters: 'May the great unite with the great.'

sanskrit_iast: atha upari preṅkha phalake prādeśam nidhāya japati sam devo devyā dadhād iti |
meaning: अथ उपरि प्रेङ्ख फलके प्रादेशम् निधाय जपति सम् देवो देव्या दधाद् इति ।
text_mt: Then, placing his span on the swing-plank, he mutters: 'May the god unite with the goddess.' / Then, holding his span at the distance of a span above the swing-plank, he mutters: 'May the Brahman unite with the Brāhmaṇī.'

sanskrit_iast: atha upari preṅkha phalakāt prādeśa mātre prādeśam dhārayan japati sam brahma brāhmaṇyā dadhād iti |
meaning: अथ उपरि प्रेङ्ख फलकात् प्रादेश मात्रे प्रादेशम् धारयन् जपति सम् ब्रह्म ब्राह्मण्या दधाद् इति ।
text_mt: Then, drawing the swing-plank near, he breathes in thrice and breathes out thrice.

sanskrit_iast: atha upanidhāya preṅkha phalakam trir abhyanya trir abhyavān iti |
meaning: अथ उपनिधाय प्रेङ्ख फलकम् त्रिर् अभ्यन्य त्रिर् अभ्यवान् इति ।

sanskrit_iast: atha enad urasā saṃspṛśya dakṣiṇam bhāgam ātmano atiharan japaty arko asi vasavas tvā gāyatreṇa chandasā ārohantu tān aham anvārohāmi rājyāya iti |
meaning: अथ एनद् उरसा संस्पृश्य दक्षिणम् भागम् आत्मनो अतिहरन् जपत्य् अर्को असि वसवस् त्वा गायत्रेण छन्दसा आरोहन्तु तान् अहम् अन्वारोहामि राज्याय इति ।
text_mt: Then, touching it with his chest, shifting the right part of his body across, he mutters: 'You are the sun. May the Vasus mount you with the Gāyatrī metre; them I mount after for kingship.'

sanskrit_iast: atha uttaram bhāgam ātmano atiharan japati rudrās tvā traiṣṭubhena chandasā ārohantu tān aham anvārohāmi svārājyāya iti |
meaning: अथ उत्तरम् भागम् आत्मनो अतिहरन् जपति रुद्रास् त्वा त्रैष्टुभेन छन्दसा आरोहन्तु तान् अहम् अन्वारोहामि स्वाराज्याय इति ।
text_mt: Then, shifting the left part of his body across, he mutters: 'May the Rudras mount you with the Triṣṭubh metre; them I mount after for self-rule.'

sanskrit_iast: atha dakṣiṇam bhāgam ātmano atiharan japaty ādityās tvā jāgatena chandasā ārohantu tān aham anvārohāmi sāṃrājyāya iti |
meaning: अथ दक्षिणम् भागम् आत्मनो अतिहरन् जपत्य् आदित्यास् त्वा जागतेन छन्दसा आरोहन्तु तान् अहम् अन्वारोहामि सांराज्याय इति ।
text_mt: Then, shifting the right part of his body across, he mutters: 'May the Ādityas mount you with the Jagatī metre; them I mount after for universal rule.'

sanskrit_iast: atha uttaram bhāgam ātmano atiharan japati viśve tvā devā ānuṣṭubhena chandasā ārohantu tān aham anvārohāmi kāmaprāya iti |
meaning: अथ उत्तरम् भागम् आत्मनो अतिहरन् जपति विश्वे त्वा देवा आनुष्टुभेन छन्दसा आरोहन्तु तान् अहम् अन्वारोहामि कामप्राय इति ।
text_mt: Then, shifting the left part of his body across, he mutters: 'May the All-gods mount you with the Anuṣṭubh metre; them I mount after for the fulfillment of desires.'

sanskrit_iast: atha samadhiṛpya prāñcau pādā upāvahṛtya bhūmau pratiṣṭhāpayati |
meaning: अथ समधिऋप्य प्राञ्चौ पादा उपावहृत्य भूमौ प्रतिष्ठापयति ।
text_mt: Then, having mounted properly, letting his two feet hang forward, he establishes them on the ground.

sanskrit_iast: atha trir abhyanya trir abhyavān iti |
meaning: अथ त्रिर् अभ्यन्य त्रिर् अभ्यवान् इति ।
text_mt: Then he breathes in thrice and breathes out thrice.

sanskrit_iast: atha upari preṅkha phalake dakṣiṇa uttariṇam upastham kṛtvā dakṣiṇena prādeśena paścāt preṅkha phalakam upaspṛśati prajāpatiṣ ṭvā ārohatu vāyuḥ preṅkhayatv iti |
meaning: अथ उपरि प्रेङ्ख फलके दक्षिण उत्तरिणम् उपस्थम् कृत्वा दक्षिणेन प्रादेशेन पश्चात् प्रेङ्ख फलकम् उपस्पृशति प्रजापतिष् ट्वा आरोहतु वायुः प्रेङ्खयत्व् इति ।
text_mt: Then, crossing his right leg over the left upon the swing-plank, he touches the swing-plank behind with his right span: 'May Prajāpati mount you; may Vāyu swing you.'

sanskrit_iast: atha trir abhyanya trir abhyavān iti |
meaning: अथ त्रिर् अभ्यन्य त्रिर् अभ्यवान् इति ।
text_mt: Then he breathes in thrice and breathes out thrice.
Then, holding his hands extended forward, he mutters:

sanskrit_iast: sam vāk prāṇena sam aham prāṇena sam cakṣur manasā sam aham manasā sam prajāpatiḥ paśubhiḥ sam aham paśubhiḥ suparṣo asi garutmān premām vācam vadiṣyāmi bahu kariṣyantīm bahu kariṣyan bāhor bhūyaḥ svargam iṣyantīm svargam iṣyann iti |
meaning: सम् वाक् प्राणेन सम् अहम् प्राणेन सम् चक्षुर् मनसा सम् अहम् मनसा सम् प्रजापतिः पशुभिः सम् अहम् पशुभिः सुपर्षो असि गरुत्मान् प्रेमाम् वाचम् वदिष्यामि बहु करिष्यन्तीम् बहु करिष्यन् बाहोर् भूयः स्वर्गम् इष्यन्तीम् स्वर्गम् इष्यन्न् इति ।
text_mt: 'Speech has united with breath, I have united with breath; sight with mind, I with mind; Prajāpati with domestic animals, I with domestic animals. You are the well-winged Garutmān; I will speak forth this speech that is to produce much, intending to produce much, more than much, aiming for heaven, aiming for heaven.'

sanskrit_iast: atha trir abhyanya trir abhyavān iti |
meaning: अथ त्रिर् अभ्यन्य त्रिर् अभ्यवान् इति ।
text_mt: Then he breathes in thrice and breathes out thrice.

sanskrit_iast: sa visṛṣṭa vān matsaram vininīṣamāṇa āsta ā stotrasya pravadanāt |
meaning: स विसृष्ट वान् मत्सरम् विनिनीषमाण आस्त आ स्तोत्रस्य प्रवदनात् ।
text_mt: Having restrained his speech, intending to subdue intoxication, he sits until the singing forth of the chant.

sanskrit_iast: yatra eva hotā preṅkham adhirohati tat sarve sagṛha patikā bṛsīr adhisarpanti |
meaning: यत्र एव होता प्रेङ्खम् अधिरोहति तत् सर्वे सगृह पतिका बृसीर् अधिसर्पन्ति ।
text_mt: Just when the Hotṛ mounts the swing, all [the priests] along with the sacrificer glide onto their grass cushions.
When the last stotriyā verse remains, he pierces the drums;
he pierces the earth-drum.
The noise-makers cease their noise.

sanskrit_iast: atha pūrṇa kumbhā apo bibhratyo mārjālīyam pariyanti |
meaning: अथ पूर्ण कुम्भा अपो बिभ्रत्यो मार्जालीयम् परियन्ति ।
text_mt: Then women bearing jars filled with water walk around the Mārjālīya;

sanskrit_iast: mārjālīye tāḥ kalaśān avaninīya upanidhāya yathā etam utsṛjyante |
meaning: मार्जालीये ताः कलशान् अवनिनीय उपनिधाय यथा एतम् उत्सृज्यन्ते ।
text_mt: having poured out the jars onto the Mārjālīya and having set them down, they are dismissed as they came.

sanskrit_iast: prokte hotā vācam yacchaty ā anuvaṣaṭ kārāt |
meaning: प्रोक्ते होता वाचम् यच्छत्य् आ अनुवषट् कारात् ।
text_mt: When this is said, the Hotṛ restrains his speech until the secondary vaṣaṭ-call.
[The Hotṛ] delights at the ritual call at the commencement;

sanskrit_iast: adhvaryo śoṃsāvo ity uccair āhūya yathā asya vāk sarvā anyā vāco ativadet |
meaning: अध्वर्यो शोंसावो इत्य् उच्चैर् आहूय यथा अस्य वाक् सर्वा अन्या वाचो अतिवदेत् ।
text_mt: Having called aloud, 'Adhvaryu, let us two recite!' so that his voice surpasses all other voices;

sanskrit_iast: uccair āhūya trir upāṃśu him kṛtya upāṃśu tūṣṇīm śaṃsam | tasya atas tasya ataḥ |
meaning: उच्चैर् आहूय त्रिर् उपांशु हिम् कृत्य उपांशु तूष्णीम् शंसम् । तस्य अतस् तस्य अतः ।
text_mt: having called aloud, having made the 'him'-sound thrice in a low voice, [he recites] the silent recitation in a low voice: 'Of him from here, of him from here.'

sanskrit_iast: uccair āhūya trir upāṃśu him kṛtya |
meaning: उच्चैर् आहूय त्रिर् उपांशु हिम् कृत्य ।
text_mt: Having called aloud, having made the 'him'-sound thrice in a low voice,

sanskrit_iast: brahma jajñānam prathamam purastād iyam pitre rāṣṭryā ity agre viśve devā mama śṛṇvantu yajñiyā ity etās tisra ṛcas tūṣṇīm śaṃsas tā upāṃśv apraṇuvan pacchaḥ |
meaning: ब्रह्म जज्ञानम् प्रथमम् पुरस्ताद् इयम् पित्रे राष्ट्र्या इत्य् अग्रे विश्वे देवा मम शृण्वन्तु यज्ञिया इत्य् एतास् तिस्र ऋचस् तूष्णीम् शंसस् ता उपांश्व् अप्रणुवन् पच्छः ।
text_mt: 'Brahman born first in the east', 'This ruler for the father' at the beginning, 'May all the sacrificial gods hear me'—these three verses are the silent recitation; [he recites] them in a low voice, verse-quarter by verse-quarter, without the syllable Om.
Then he releases his voice for himself.

sanskrit_iast: tad id āsa bhuvaneṣu jyeṣṭham iti stotriyas tṛcaḥ |
meaning: तद् इद् आस भुवनेषु ज्येष्ठम् इति स्तोत्रियस् तृचः ।
text_mt: 'That indeed was the oldest in the worlds' is the stotriya triplet.

sanskrit_iast: vane na vā yo nyadhāyi ca akann ity aṣṭau |
meaning: वने न वा यो न्यधायि च अकन्न् इत्य् अष्टौ ।
text_mt: 'Like in the wood, or what was deposited'—eight verses;

sanskrit_iast: śākmanā śokā aruṇaḥ suparṇa iti tṛcam |
meaning: शाक्मना शोका अरुणः सुपर्ण इति तृचम् ।
text_mt: 'With power, bright, the ruddy eagle'—a triplet;

sanskrit_iast: yo adadhāj jyotiṣi jyotir antar mahat tan nāma guhyam puruspṛg idam ta ekam para ū ta ekam iti tisra eka pātinyaḥ |
meaning: यो अदधाज् ज्योतिषि ज्योतिर् अन्तर् महत् तन् नाम गुह्यम् पुरुस्पृग् इदम् त एकम् पर ऊ त एकम् इति तिस्र एक पातिन्यः ।
text_mt: 'He who placed light within light', 'Great is that secret name, widely sought', 'This one of yours, beyond is one of yours'—three single-standing verses;
Together with the first one recited thrice, there are twenty-five.
That is the twenty-fivefold body (ātman).
He recites it connected with the Nada [hymn].
The first padas are in Triṣṭubh metre; the subsequent ones belong to the Nada.

sanskrit_iast: prathamena traiṣṭubhena padena prathamam nadasya padam upasaṃdhāya avasyati |
meaning: प्रथमेन त्रैष्टुभेन पदेन प्रथमम् नदस्य पदम् उपसंधाय अवस्यति ।
text_mt: Connecting the first pada of the Nada with the first Triṣṭubh pada, he pauses.
Connecting the second [pada of the Nada] with the second Triṣṭubh [pada], he pronounces the praṇava.
Connecting the third [pada of the Nada] with the third Triṣṭubh [pada], he pauses.
Connecting the fourth [pada of the Nada] with the fourth Triṣṭubh [pada], he pronounces the praṇava.
Thus interlinked, he recites the first [verse] thrice.

sanskrit_iast: evam vihṛtā eva yā tṛtīyā sūktasya tasyā uttaram ardharcam utsṛjati nadasya ca uttaram |
meaning: एवम् विहृता एव या तृतीया सूक्तस्य तस्या उत्तरम् अर्धर्चम् उत्सृजति नदस्य च उत्तरम् ।
text_mt: Of that which is the third [verse] of the hymn thus interlinked, he leaves out the second half-verse and the second half-verse of the Nada.
He recites those two before the two-pada verses.

sanskrit_iast: ātmānam śastvā atha sūda dohasam śaṃsati | tā asya sūda dohasa iti tām ardharcaśaḥ |
meaning: आत्मानम् शस्त्वा अथ सूद दोहसम् शंसति । ता अस्य सूद दोहस इति ताम् अर्धर्चशः ।
text_mt: Having recited the body (ātman), he then recites the Sūdadohas verse, namely, 'Those milk-yielding cows of his...' (tā asya sūdadohasaḥ), reciting it by half-verse.
Then he recites these head triplets.

sanskrit_iast: indram id gāthina indreṇa sam hi indro dadhīca uttiṣṭhann ojasā saha ud ghed abhi śrutām agham ud u tyam jāta vedasam ity eteṣām tṛcānām yeṣu sāmagāḥ stuvīraṃs tāni śaṃset |
meaning: इन्द्रम् इद् गाथिन इन्द्रेण सम् हि इन्द्रो दधीच उत्तिष्ठन्न् ओजसा सह उद् घेद् अभि श्रुताम् अघम् उद् उ त्यम् जात वेदसम् इत्य् एतेषाम् तृचानाम् येषु सामगाः स्तुवीरंस् तानि शंसेत् ।
text_mt:
Among these triplets: 'Indra alone the singers...' (indram id gāthinaḥ), 'Together indeed with Indra...' (indreṇa saṃ hi), 'Indra [found] of Dadhīc...' (indro dadhīcaḥ), 'Rising with vigor...' (uttiṣṭhann ojasā saha), 'Up indeed to the famous one...' (ud ghed abhi śrutam agham), 'Up that all-knowing one...' (ud u tyaṃ jātavedasam)—he should recite those upon which the Sāman singers chant.

Some indeed chant upon this nine-verse hymn: 'Up that all-knowing one...' (ud u tyaṃ jātavedasam).

sanskrit_iast: ud u tyam jāta vedasam ity etasminn u ha eke navarce stuvate |
meaning: उद् उ त्यम् जात वेदसम् इत्य् एतस्मिन्न् उ ह एके नवर्चे स्तुवते ।

sanskrit_iast: te yadi tathā kuryur etad eva śaṃset |
meaning: ते यदि तथा कुर्युर् एतद् एव शंसेत् ।
text_mt: If they should do so, he should recite only this.

sanskrit_iast: ud u tyam jāta vedasam ity etasya u ha eke prathame tṛce stuvate |
meaning: उद् उ त्यम् जात वेदसम् इत्य् एतस्य उ ह एके प्रथमे तृचे स्तुवते ।
text_mt: Some indeed chant upon the first triplet of this hymn: 'Up that all-knowing one...' (ud u tyaṃ jātavedasam).

sanskrit_iast: te yadi tathā kuryur itareṣām ye kāmayeta te upāharet |
meaning: ते यदि तथा कुर्युर् इतरेषाम् ये कामयेत ते उपाहरेत् ।
text_mt: If they should do so, he may bring in whichever of the others he desires.

sanskrit_iast: tāny ardharcaśaḥ śastvā atha sūda dohasam |
meaning: तान्य् अर्धर्चशः शस्त्वा अथ सूद दोहसम् ।
text_mt: Having recited them by half-verse, then [he recites] the Sūdadohas verse.

sanskrit_iast: yasya idam oja ārujas tujo yujo balam sahaḥ | indrasya rantyam bṛhat | anādhṛṣṭam vipanyayā nādhṛṣa ādadharṣayā | dhṛṣāṇam dhṛṣitam śavaḥ | sa no dadātu tam rayim puru piśaṅga saṃdṛśam | indraspati stava stomo janeṣu iti |
meaning: यस्य इदम् ओज आरुजस् तुजो युजो बलम् सहः । इन्द्रस्य रन्त्यम् बृहत् । अनाधृष्टम् विपन्यया नाधृष आदधर्षया । धृषाणम् धृषितम् शवः । स नो ददातु तम् रयिम् पुरु पिशङ्ग संदृशम् । इन्द्रस्पति स्तव स्तोमो जनेषु इति ।
text_mt:
Then he recites this neck triplet: / 'Whose is this vigor, crushing down, impulse, alliance, strength, might; / the vast delight of Indra, / unassailable through praise, unassailable through bold assault, / daring, bold power.'
'May he give us that wealth appearing multi-colored; / O Lord of Indra, may there be praise among the people.'

sanskrit_iast: tam ardharcaśaḥ śastvā atha sūda dohasam |
meaning: तम् अर्धर्चशः शस्त्वा अथ सूद दोहसम् ।
text_mt: Having recited it by half-verse, then [he recites] the Sūdadohas verse.

sanskrit_iast: urum no lokam anu neṣi vidvān ity akṣā |
meaning: उरुम् नो लोकम् अनु नेषि विद्वान् इत्य् अक्षा ।
text_mt: The axle-verse is: 'Guide us, knowing, to broad space...' (uruṃ no lokam anu neṣi vidvān).

sanskrit_iast: tām pacchaḥ śastvā atha sūda dohasam |
meaning: ताम् पच्छः शस्त्वा अथ सूद दोहसम् ।
text_mt: Having recited it pada by pada, then [he recites] the Sūdadohas verse.

sanskrit_iast: atha rathantarasya stotriyam punar ādāyam kakup kāram atha sūda dohasam |
meaning: अथ रथन्तरस्य स्तोत्रियम् पुनर् आदायम् ककुप् कारम् अथ सूद दोहसम् ।
text_mt: Then the stotriya of the Rathantara, resuming and making a kakubh; then the Sūdadohas verse.

sanskrit_iast: atha rathantarasya anurūpam punar ādāyam kakup kāram atha sūda dohasam |
meaning: अथ रथन्तरस्य अनुरूपम् पुनर् आदायम् ककुप् कारम् अथ सूद दोहसम् ।
text_mt: Then the anurūpa of the Rathantara, resuming and making a kakubh; then the Sūdadohas verse.

sanskrit_iast: ataḥ dhāyyām pacchaḥ śastvā atha sūda dohasam |
meaning: अतः धाय्याम् पच्छः शस्त्वा अथ सूद दोहसम् ।
text_mt: Then, having recited the dhāyyā pada by pada, then [he recites] the Sūdadohas verse.

sanskrit_iast: atha rāthantaram pragātham ardharcaśaḥ śastvā atha sūda dohasam |
meaning: अथ राथन्तरम् प्रगाथम् अर्धर्चशः शस्त्वा अथ सूद दोहसम् ।
text_mt: Then, having recited the Rathantara-pragātha by half-verse, then [he recites] the Sūdadohas verse.

sanskrit_iast: ya eka idd havyaś carṣaṇīnām iti sūktam tat pacchas tasya dvitīyām uddhṛtya viśvo hy anyo arir ā jagāma iti yā etasya dvitīyā tām iha dvitīyām karoti sūktam śastvā atha sūda dohasam |
meaning: य एक इद्द् हव्यश् चर्षणीनाम् इति सूक्तम् तत् पच्छस् तस्य द्वितीयाम् उद्धृत्य विश्वो ह्य् अन्यो अरिर् आ जगाम इति या एतस्य द्वितीया ताम् इह द्वितीयाम् करोति सूक्तम् शस्त्वा अथ सूद दोहसम् ।
text_mt: The hymn is: 'He who alone is to be invoked by the peoples...' (ya eka idd havyaś carṣaṇīnām); that is [recited] pada by pada. Having removed its second verse, he makes the second verse of 'For every other stranger has arrived...' (viśvo hy anyo arir ājagāma) the second verse here. Having recited the hymn, then [he recites] the Sūdadohas verse.

sanskrit_iast: tam indram johavīmi maghavānam ugram iti prahastakas tṛcaḥ |
meaning: तम् इन्द्रम् जोहवीमि मघवानम् उग्रम् इति प्रहस्तकस् तृचः ।
text_mt: The prahastaka triplet is: 'That Indra I call upon, the bounteous, the fierce...' (tam indraṃ johavīmi maghavānam ugram).

sanskrit_iast: tam pacchaḥ śastvā atha sūda dohasam |
meaning: तम् पच्छः शस्त्वा अथ सूद दोहसम् ।
text_mt: Having recited it pada by pada, then [he recites] the Sūdadohas verse.

sanskrit_iast: sa sūrye janayan jyotir indro ayā dhiyā taraṇir aṅgirasvān | ṛtena śuṣmī havamāno arkair abhi spṛdha usro vedim tatarda | ity akṣā |
meaning: स सूर्ये जनयन् ज्योतिर् इन्द्रो अया धिया तरणिर् अङ्गिरस्वान् । ऋतेन शुष्मी हवमानो अर्कैर् अभि स्पृध उस्रो वेदिम् ततर्द । इत्य् अक्षा ।
text_mt: The axle-verse is: 'He, Indra, generating light in the sun, through this prayer swift, accompanied by the Aṅgirases, / vehement through truth, invoked with songs of praise, the bull burst the altar facing the rivals.'

sanskrit_iast: tām pacchaḥ śastvā atha sūda dohasam |
meaning: ताम् पच्छः शस्त्वा अथ सूद दोहसम् ।
text_mt: Having recited it pada by pada, then [he recites] the Sūdadohas verse.

sanskrit_iast: atha bṛhataḥ stotriyam punar ādāyam kakup kāram atha sūda dohasam |
meaning: अथ बृहतः स्तोत्रियम् पुनर् आदायम् ककुप् कारम् अथ सूद दोहसम् ।
text_mt: Then the stotriya of the Bṛhat, resuming and making a kakubh; then the Sūdadohas verse.

sanskrit_iast: atha bṛhato anurūpam punar ādāyam kakup kāram atha sūda dohasam |
meaning: अथ बृहतो अनुरूपम् पुनर् आदायम् ककुप् कारम् अथ सूद दोहसम् ।
text_mt: Then the anurūpa of the Bṛhat, resuming and making a kakubh; then the Sūdadohas verse.

sanskrit_iast: atha bārhatam pragātahm ardharcaśaḥ śastvā atha sūda dohasam |
meaning: अथ बार्हतम् प्रगातह्म् अर्धर्चशः शस्त्वा अथ सूद दोहसम् ।
text_mt: Then, having recited the Bṛhat-pragātha by half-verse, then [he recites] the Sūdadohas verse.

sanskrit_iast: viśvo hy anyo arir ā jagāma iti sūktam tat pacchas tasya dvitīyām uddhṛtya ya eka idd havyaś carṣaṇīnām iti yā etasya dvitīyā tām iha dvitīyām karoti |
meaning: विश्वो ह्य् अन्यो अरिर् आ जगाम इति सूक्तम् तत् पच्छस् तस्य द्वितीयाम् उद्धृत्य य एक इद्द् हव्यश् चर्षणीनाम् इति या एतस्य द्वितीया ताम् इह द्वितीयाम् करोति ।
text_mt: The hymn is: 'For every other stranger has arrived...' (viśvo hy anyo arir ājagāma); that is [recited] pada by pada. Having removed its second verse, he makes the second verse of 'He who alone is to be invoked by the peoples...' (ya eka idd havyaś carṣaṇīnām) the second verse here.
Having recited the hymn, then [he recites] the Sūdadohas verse.

sanskrit_iast: viśvāḥ pṛtanā abhibhūtaram naram iti prahastakas tṛcaḥ |
meaning: विश्वाः पृतना अभिभूतरम् नरम् इति प्रहस्तकस् तृचः ।
text_mt: The prahastaka triplet is: 'The man victorious over all host...' (viśvāḥ pṛtanā abhibhūtaram naram).

sanskrit_iast: tasya pacchaḥ prathamām śaṃsaty ardharcaśa uttare |
meaning: तस्य पच्छः प्रथमाम् शंसत्य् अर्धर्चश उत्तरे ।
text_mt: Of it, he recites the first verse pada by pada, [and] the two subsequent ones by half-verse.
Having recited the prahastaka, then [he recites] the Sūdadohas verse.

sanskrit_iast: atha etāni catur uttarāṇi tṛcāni śaṃsati |
meaning: अथ एतानि चतुर् उत्तराणि तृचानि शंसति ।
text_mt: Then he recites these four subsequent triplets.

sanskrit_iast: indrāya madvane sutam indram vṛtrāya hantave gāyanti tvā gāyatriṇo na tvā bṛhanto adraya iti catvāri tṛcāni |
meaning: इन्द्राय मद्वने सुतम् इन्द्रम् वृत्राय हन्तवे गायन्ति त्वा गायत्रिणो न त्वा बृहन्तो अद्रय इति चत्वारि तृचानि ।
text_mt: There are four triplets: 'For Indra, the exhilarating, the pressed...' (indrāya madvane sutam), 'Indra to slay Vṛtra...' (indraṃ vṛtrāya hantave), 'Singers of the Gāyatra sing of you...' (gāyanti tvā gāyatriṇaḥ), [and] 'Not the lofty mountains to you...' (na tvā bṛhanto adrayaḥ).

sanskrit_iast: itthā hi soma in mada iti pāṅktam tṛcam tat paṅkti śaṃsam |
meaning: इत्था हि सोम इन् मद इति पाङ्क्तम् तृचम् तत् पङ्क्ति शंसम् ।
text_mt: The triplet in Paṅkti metre is: 'Thus indeed, O Soma, in exhilaration...' (itthā hi soma in made); that is recited in paṅkti style.

sanskrit_iast: sam ca tve jagmur gira indra pūrvīr ād aṅgirāḥ prathamam dadhire vaya iti traiṣṭubha jāgate tṛce |
meaning: सम् च त्वे जग्मुर् गिर इन्द्र पूर्वीर् आद् अङ्गिराः प्रथमम् दधिरे वय इति त्रैष्टुभ जागते तृचे ।
text_mt: The two triplets in Triṣṭubh and Jagatī metres are: 'Together in you have united the many songs, O Indra...' (saṃ ca tve jagmur gira indra pūrvīḥ) and 'Then first the Aṅgirases assumed vigor...' (ād aṅgirāḥ prathamam dadhire vayaḥ).

sanskrit_iast: te pacchaḥ śastvā atha sūda dohasam |
meaning: ते पच्छः शस्त्वा अथ सूद दोहसम् ।
text_mt: Having recited them pada by pada, then [he recites] the Sūdadohas verse.
Then he recites these sets of eighty verses (aśītis).

sanskrit_iast: mahān indro ya ojasā ity etayā gāyatrīm aśītim pratipadyate |
meaning: महान् इन्द्रो य ओजसा इत्य् एतया गायत्रीम् अशीतिम् प्रतिपद्यते ।
text_mt: He begins the Gāyatrī set of eighty with 'Great is Indra who through might...' (mahān indro ya ojasā).

sanskrit_iast: indra it somapā eka ity aṣṭau |
meaning: इन्द्र इत् सोमपा एक इत्य् अष्टौ ।
text_mt: Eight [triplets beginning with] 'Indra alone the drinker of soma...' (indra it somapā ekaḥ).

sanskrit_iast: eva id eṣa tuvi kūrmir iti trīṇi |
meaning: एव इद् एष तुवि कूर्मिर् इति त्रीणि ।
text_mt: Three [triplets beginning with] 'Thus indeed is he of mighty deeds...' (eva id eṣa tuvikūrmiḥ).

sanskrit_iast: ā ghā ye agnim indhata iti caturdaśa |
meaning: आ घा ये अग्निम् इन्धत इति चतुर्दश ।
text_mt: Fourteen [triplets beginning with] 'Truly, those who kindle Agni...' (ā ghā ye agnim indhate).
Those are forty triplets.

sanskrit_iast: pra kṛtāny ṛjīṣiṇa iti daśa tṛcāni |
meaning: प्र कृतान्य् ऋजीषिण इति दश तृचानि ।
text_mt: Ten triplets beginning with 'The deeds of the eager one...' (prakṛtāny ṛjīṣiṇaḥ).

sanskrit_iast: apād u śipry andhasa iti pañca |
meaning: अपाद् उ शिप्र्य् अन्धस इति पञ्च ।
text_mt: Five [tṛcas beginning with] 'apād u śipry andhasaḥ'.

sanskrit_iast: ā tvā viśantv indava iti catvāri |
meaning: आ त्वा विशन्त्व् इन्दव इति चत्वारि ।
text_mt: [The hymn beginning] 'May the drops enter you' consists of four [tṛcas].

sanskrit_iast: yad adya kac ca vtrahann iti pañca |
meaning: यद् अद्य कच् च व्त्रहन्न् इति पञ्च ।
text_mt: [The hymn beginning] 'Whatever today, O slayer of Vṛtra' consists of five.
[The hymn beginning] 'Possessing wives, these pressed [somas]' consists of four.

sanskrit_iast: idam hy anv ojasā uttiṣṭhann ojasā saha abhi pra gopatim iti trīṇi tṛcāni |
meaning: इदम् ह्य् अन्व् ओजसा उत्तिष्ठन्न् ओजसा सह अभि प्र गोपतिम् इति त्रीणि तृचानि ।
text_mt: [The hymns beginning] 'For hereby according to strength', 'Rising up together with strength', and 'Directly to the lord of cows' are three tṛcas.

sanskrit_iast: teṣām yat purastāt kṛtam syāt tad uddharet |
meaning: तेषाम् यत् पुरस्तात् कृतम् स्यात् तद् उद्धरेत् ।
text_mt: Whatever among them has been used previously, he should set that aside.

sanskrit_iast: yady u vai na kuryur ud eva haret |
meaning: यद्य् उ वै न कुर्युर् उद् एव हरेत् ।
text_mt: And if they do not perform it, he should simply take it out.

sanskrit_iast: ya ānayat parāvata iti daśa tṛcāni |
meaning: य आनयत् परावत इति दश तृचानि ।
text_mt: [The hymn beginning] 'He who brought from the distance' consists of ten tṛcas.
Those make forty tṛcas.

sanskrit_iast: yā indra bhuja ābhara ity etayā bārhatīm aśītim pratipadyate |
meaning: या इन्द्र भुज आभर इत्य् एतया बार्हतीम् अशीतिम् प्रतिपद्यते ।
text_mt: With [the verse beginning] 'What enjoyments, O Indra, bring [them]' he begins the Bārhata eighty.
Those are nine genuine Bṛhatī verses.

sanskrit_iast: viśve ta indra vīryam iti tisraḥ |
meaning: विश्वे त इन्द्र वीर्यम् इति तिस्रः ।
text_mt: [The hymn beginning] 'All your heroic power, O Indra' consists of three.

sanskrit_iast: tam ghem itthā namasvina iti dve |
meaning: तम् घेम् इत्था नमस्विन इति द्वे ।
text_mt: [The hymn beginning] 'Indeed, him thus with reverence' consists of two.

sanskrit_iast: na sīma deva āpad iti ṣaṭ |
meaning: न सीम देव आपद् इति षट् ।
text_mt: [The hymn beginning] 'Him neither god reached' consists of six.
Those are twenty genuine Bṛhatī verses.
[The hymn beginning] 'He who continually [helps], active among men' consists of four.

sanskrit_iast: mo ṣu tvā vāghataś cana iti catvāra uddhṛtya dvipadām |
meaning: मो षु त्वा वाघतश् चन इति चत्वार उद्धृत्य द्विपदाम् ।
text_mt: [The hymn beginning] 'Let not the sacrificers [detain] you' consists of four, setting aside the Dvipadā verse.

sanskrit_iast: ud in v asya ricyata iti pañca |
meaning: उद् इन् व् अस्य रिच्यत इति पञ्च ।
text_mt: [The hymn beginning] 'Now his [wealth] indeed overflows' consists of five.

sanskrit_iast: tat tvā yāmi suvīryam yukṣvā hi vṛtrahantama iti dvau dvau |
meaning: तत् त्वा यामि सुवीर्यम् युक्ष्वा हि वृत्रहन्तम इति द्वौ द्वौ ।
text_mt: [The hymns beginning] 'That heroic might of yours I ask' and 'Harness indeed, O greatest slayer of Vṛtra' consist of two each.

sanskrit_iast: yad indra prāg apāg udag iti sapta |
meaning: यद् इन्द्र प्राग् अपाग् उदग् इति सप्त ।
text_mt: [The hymn beginning] 'Whether, O Indra, eastward, westward, northward' consists of seven.
[The hymn beginning] 'Rain down, O you of abundant wealth' consists of two.

sanskrit_iast: avipro vā yad avidhad iti pañca |
meaning: अविप्रो वा यद् अविधद् इति पञ्च ।
text_mt: [The hymn beginning] 'Or whether the non-sage worshipped' consists of five.

sanskrit_iast: yaḥ śakro mṛkṣo aśvya iti ṣaṭ |
meaning: यः शक्रो मृक्षो अश्व्य इति षट् ।
text_mt: [The hymn beginning] 'He who is mighty, cleansing, related to horses' consists of six.
Those make forty Pragāthas.
Then he recites genuine Bṛhatī verses.

sanskrit_iast: mahe cana tvām adriva iti pañcaviṃśatiḥ |
meaning: महे चन त्वाम् अद्रिव इति पञ्चविंशतिः ।
text_mt: [The hymn beginning] 'Not even for great [gain], O wielder of the stone' consists of twenty-five.

sanskrit_iast: tāsām viṃśatim śastvā atha sūda dohasam |
meaning: तासाम् विंशतिम् शस्त्वा अथ सूद दोहसम् ।
text_mt: Having recited twenty of them, then [he recites] the Sūdadohas verse.
[The verse beginning] 'Desiring cows' is the verse containing the nivid.

sanskrit_iast: tām pacchaḥ śastvā āhūya nividam dadhāti |
meaning: ताम् पच्छः शस्त्वा आहूय निविदम् दधाति ।
text_mt: Having recited it quarter by quarter, having called out, he inserts the nivid.

sanskrit_iast: tām paccho vyavagrāham śastvā sama sūktām |
meaning: ताम् पच्छो व्यवग्राहम् शस्त्वा सम सूक्ताम् ।
text_mt: Having recited it quarter by quarter, pausing after each, [he recites] the one that completes the hymn;

sanskrit_iast: uttamena padena praṇutya sa jātebhir iti nividā śaṃsati |
meaning: उत्तमेन पदेन प्रणुत्य स जातेभिर् इति निविदा शंसति ।
text_mt: having recited [it] with the last quarter [intoned without pause], he recites along with the nivid [beginning] 'With those born [together]'.

sanskrit_iast: tām pacchaḥ śastvāa tha sūda dohasam |
meaning: ताम् पच्छः शस्त्वाअ थ सूद दोहसम् ।
text_mt: Having recited it quarter by quarter, then [he recites] the Sūdadohas verse.
Then he recites genuine Bṛhatī verses.
He begins with those that were left over from the twenty-five.

sanskrit_iast: vayam gha tvā sutāvanta iti pañcadaśa |
meaning: वयम् घ त्वा सुतावन्त इति पञ्चदश ।
text_mt: [The hymn beginning] 'We indeed, having pressed soma, [call] upon you' consists of fifteen.
Those are twenty genuine Bṛhatī verses.

sanskrit_iast: ye ṣaṇṇām trayaḥ pariśiṣṭās taiḥ pratipadyate |
meaning: ये षण्णाम् त्रयः परिशिष्टास् तैः प्रतिपद्यते ।
text_mt: He begins with the three that were left over from the six.
[The hymn beginning] 'He who is king of the peoples' consists of three.

sanskrit_iast: tam vo dasmam ṛtīṣaham ity ekaḥ |
meaning: तम् वो दस्मम् ऋतीषहम् इत्य् एकः ।
text_mt: [The hymn beginning] 'Him to you, the wonder-worker, who withstands assaults' consists of one.

sanskrit_iast: ā no viśvāsu havya iti trayaḥ |
meaning: आ नो विश्वासु हव्य इति त्रयः ।
text_mt: [The hymn beginning] 'To us in all [battles] to be invoked' consists of three.

sanskrit_iast: tvām id ā hyo nara iti catvāraḥ |
meaning: त्वाम् इद् आ ह्यो नर इति चत्वारः ।
text_mt: [The hymn beginning] 'The men [invoked] you indeed yesterday' consists of four.
Then the six hymns of the Vālakhilyas.

sanskrit_iast: teṣām dvau pragāthā utsṛjati indra nihavam ca vaiśvadevam ca ā no viśve sajoṣasa iti |
meaning: तेषाम् द्वौ प्रगाथा उत्सृजति इन्द्र निहवम् च वैश्वदेवम् च आ नो विश्वे सजोषस इति ।
text_mt: He leaves out two Pragāthas of them: the one invoking Indra and the one to All the Gods beginning 'To us, all [gods] together with one accord'.
Those make forty Pragāthas.
Then he recites genuine Bṛhatī verses:

sanskrit_iast: matsy apāyi te maho asmā asmā id andhaso balam dhehi tanūṣu no yujāno haritā rathe tava id indra aham āśasā amāsu pakvam airaya iyam yā nīcy arkiṇī pra te ratham mithū kṛtam antar yaccha jighāṃsatas tvam viśvasya jagata iti daśa eka pātinyaḥ |
meaning: मत्स्य् अपायि ते महो अस्मा अस्मा इद् अन्धसो बलम् धेहि तनूषु नो युजानो हरिता रथे तव इद् इन्द्र अहम् आशसा अमासु पक्वम् ऐरय इयम् या नीच्य् अर्किणी प्र ते रथम् मिथू कृतम् अन्तर् यच्छ जिघांसतस् त्वम् विश्वस्य जगत इति दश एक पातिन्यः ।
text_mt: The ten single verses [beginning]: 'Exhilarate, it has been drunk', 'Great [wealth] for this one', 'To this presser of soma', 'Put strength in our bodies', 'Yoking the two bay horses to your chariot', 'Yours indeed, O Indra, am I by prayer', 'In the raw [cows] you placed the cooked [milk]', 'This low-hanging, praising [dawn]', 'Forth your chariot', 'Turn away the double-dealing, intending to strike', and 'You of the whole world'.

sanskrit_iast: ayam te astu haryata ā mandrair indra haribhir iti sūkte |
meaning: अयम् ते अस्तु हर्यत आ मन्द्रैर् इन्द्र हरिभिर् इति सूक्ते ।
text_mt: The two hymns [beginning] 'May this be pleasant to you' and 'With charming, bay horses, O Indra'.

sanskrit_iast: te ardharcaśaḥ śastvā atha sūda dohasam |
meaning: ते अर्धर्चशः शस्त्वा अथ सूद दोहसम् ।
text_mt: Having recited them by half-verses, then [he recites] the Sūdadohas verse.

sanskrit_iast: indraḥ suteṣu someṣv ity etayā auṣṇihīm aśītim pratipadyate |
meaning: इन्द्रः सुतेषु सोमेष्व् इत्य् एतया औष्णिहीम् अशीतिम् प्रतिपद्यते ।
text_mt: With [the verse beginning] 'Indra in the pressed somas' he begins the Auṣṇihī eighty.

sanskrit_iast: ya indra somapātama ity ekādaśa teṣām ekam utsṛjati indram vṛtrāya hantava iti |
meaning: य इन्द्र सोमपातम इत्य् एकादश तेषाम् एकम् उत्सृजति इन्द्रम् वृत्राय हन्तव इति ।
text_mt: [The hymn beginning] 'He who, O Indra, is the greatest soma-drinker' consists of eleven; he leaves out one of them, namely 'Indra, to slay Vṛtra'.

sanskrit_iast: tam v abhi pra gāyata iti catvāri |
meaning: तम् व् अभि प्र गायत इति चत्वारि ।
text_mt: [The hymn beginning] 'Sing forth to him' consists of four.
[The hymn beginning] 'O friends, we pray' consists of nine.

sanskrit_iast: ya eka id vidayata ā yāhy adribhiḥ sutam iti dve tṛce |
meaning: य एक इद् विदयत आ याह्य् अद्रिभिः सुतम् इति द्वे तृचे ।
text_mt: [The hymns beginning] 'He who alone distributes' and 'Come to the [soma] pressed with stones' are two tṛcas.
Those are thirty-six tṛcas.
Then he recites one hundred and four Gāyatrī verses.

sanskrit_iast: nakir indra tvad uttara iti ṣaṭ |
meaning: नकिर् इन्द्र त्वद् उत्तर इति षट् ।
text_mt: [The hymn beginning] ‘No one is higher than you, O Indra’ (nakir indra tvad uttaraḥ) consists of six [verses];

sanskrit_iast: divaś cid ghā duhitaram iti caturdaśa |
meaning: दिवश् चिद् घा दुहितरम् इति चतुर्दश ।
text_mt: ‘Even of the daughter of the sky’ (divaś cid ghā duhitaram) consists of fourteen;

sanskrit_iast: ā tū na indra vṛtrahann ity eka viṃśatiḥ |
meaning: आ तू न इन्द्र वृत्रहन्न् इत्य् एक विंशतिः ।
text_mt: ‘Come now to us, O Indra, Vṛtra-slayer’ (ā tū na indra vṛtrahan) consists of twenty-one;

sanskrit_iast: ā va indram krivim yathā yad indra aham yathā tvam iti pañcadaśarce |
meaning: आ व इन्द्रम् क्रिविम् यथा यद् इन्द्र अहम् यथा त्वम् इति पञ्चदशर्चे ।
text_mt: ‘[We invoke] you, Indra, like Krivi’ (ā va indraṃ krivim yathā) and ‘If, O Indra, I [were like you]’ (yad indrāham yathā tvam) are two hymns of fifteen verses each;

sanskrit_iast: pra saṃrājam carṣaṇīnām uttvā mandantu stomā iti dvādaśarce |
meaning: प्र संराजम् चर्षणीनाम् उत्त्वा मन्दन्तु स्तोमा इति द्वादशर्चे ।
text_mt: ‘For the sovereign ruler of men’ (pra saṃrājam carṣaṇīnām) and ‘Let the praises gladden you’ (ud u tvā mandantu stomāḥ) are two hymns of twelve verses each;

sanskrit_iast: ā pra drava parāvata iti nava |
meaning: आ प्र द्रव परावत इति नव ।
text_mt: ‘Hasten here from afar’ (ā pra drava parāvataḥ) consists of nine;
thus are the one hundred and four Gāyatrī [verses].

sanskrit_iast: vayam u tvām apūrvyā ity aṣṭau kākubhāḥ pragāthāḥ |
meaning: वयम् उ त्वाम् अपूर्व्या इत्य् अष्टौ काकुभाः प्रगाथाः ।
text_mt: [Beginning with] ‘We indeed [praise] you, the peerless’ (vayam u tvām apūrvya), there are eight Kakubh Pragātha pairs;
‘Sing a Sāman to Indra’ (indrāya sāma gāyata) is recited entirely.

sanskrit_iast: tad ardharcaśaḥ śastvā ataḥ sūda dohasam |
meaning: तद् अर्धर्चशः शस्त्वा अतः सूद दोहसम् ।
text_mt: Having recited that by half-verses, thereafter [he recites] the Sūdadohas verse.
Then he recites this hymn of Vaśa by half-verses:
Its seventeenth [verse] is a Jagatī; [he recites] that quarter-verse by quarter-verse.

sanskrit_iast: atha ekaviṃśī dvāviṃśī caturviṃśī ca paṅktayas tāḥ paṅkti śaṃsam |
meaning: अथ एकविंशी द्वाविंशी चतुर्विंशी च पङ्क्तयस् ताः पङ्क्ति शंसम् ।
text_mt: Then the twenty-first, twenty-second, and twenty-fourth are Paṅktis; [he recites] them with the Paṅkti-recitation.

sanskrit_iast: śatam dāse balbūtha iti pañca padā tasyai trīṇi padāni samasya avasyed dvābhyām praṇuyāt |
meaning: शतम् दासे बल्बूथ इति पञ्च पदा तस्यै त्रीणि पदानि समस्य अवस्येद् द्वाभ्याम् प्रणुयात् ।
text_mt: ‘A hundred upon the Dāsa Balbūtha’ (śataṃ dāse balbūthe) has five quarters; joining three quarters of it together, he should pause, and conclude with the praṇava after two.

sanskrit_iast: trayodaśī ca triṃśattamī ca dvipade te pacchaḥ śastvā atha sūda dohasam |
meaning: त्रयोदशी च त्रिंशत्तमी च द्विपदे ते पच्छः शस्त्वा अथ सूद दोहसम् ।
text_mt: The thirteenth and the thirtieth are Dvipadās; having recited those two quarter-verse by quarter-verse, then [he recites] the Sūdadohas verse.

sanskrit_iast: atha etau vihṛtāv ardharcāv atha sūda dohasam |
meaning: अथ एतौ विहृताव् अर्धर्चाव् अथ सूद दोहसम् ।
text_mt: Then [reciting] these two half-verses transposed, then [he recites] the Sūdadohas verse.

sanskrit_iast: atra catur viṃśati kṛtvaḥ śastā bhavati |
meaning: अत्र चतुर् विंशति कृत्वः शस्ता भवति ।
text_mt: At this point it has been recited twenty-four times.
Then he recites these Dvipadā verses:

sanskrit_iast: imā nu kam bhuvanā sīṣadhāma iti pañca |
meaning: इमा नु कम् भुवना सीषधाम इति पञ्च ।
text_mt: ‘Now indeed may we guide these creatures’ (imā nu kam bhuvanā sīṣadhāma) consists of five;

sanskrit_iast: ā yāhi vanasā saha iti catasraḥ |
meaning: आ याहि वनसा सह इति चतस्रः ।
text_mt: ‘Come with desire’ (ā yāhi vanasā saha) consists of four;

sanskrit_iast: eṣa brahmā ya ṛtviya iti tisraḥ |
meaning: एष ब्रह्मा य ऋत्विय इति तिस्रः ।

sanskrit_iast: pra va indrāya vṛtrahantamāya viprā gātham gāyata yaj jujoṣati | arcanty arkam marutaḥ svarkā ā stobhati śruto yuvā sa indraḥ | upaprakṣe madhumati kṣiyantaḥ puṣyema rayim dhīmahe ta indra | viśvato dāvan viśvato na ā bhara yam tvā śaviṣṭham īmahe | sa supraṇītī nṛtamaḥ svarāḷ asi maṃhiṣṭho vāja sātaye | tvam hi rādhasyata eka īśiṣe sanād amṛkta ojasā | iti ṣaṭ |
meaning: प्र व इन्द्राय वृत्रहन्तमाय विप्रा गाथम् गायत यज् जुजोषति । अर्चन्त्य् अर्कम् मरुतः स्वर्का आ स्तोभति श्रुतो युवा स इन्द्रः । उपप्रक्षे मधुमति क्षियन्तः पुष्येम रयिम् धीमहे त इन्द्र । विश्वतो दावन् विश्वतो न आ भर यम् त्वा शविष्ठम् ईमहे । स सुप्रणीती नृतमः स्वराऌ असि मंहिष्ठो वाज सातये । त्वम् हि राधस्यत एक ईशिषे सनाद् अमृक्त ओजसा । इति षट् ।
text_mt:
‘This is the priest who is fit for the season’ (eṣa brahmā ya ṛtviyaḥ) consists of three; / ‘Sing, O inspired poets, a song to Indra, the greatest slayer of Vṛtra, which he will enjoy. / The Maruts of beautiful praise sing a chant; the famous youthful Indra stomps:’
‘Dwelling in sweet abundance may we increase wealth; we ponder on you, O Indra. / Giver from every side, bring to us from every side that which we ask of you, the mightiest. / With good guidance, most manly, you are the independent ruler, most generous for winning booty. / For you alone have power over the bounty, untouched since old by your might’—thus six [verses];

sanskrit_iast: ā dhūrṣv asmai vajram eko ayā vājam deva hitam sanema iti |
meaning: आ धूर्ष्व् अस्मै वज्रम् एको अया वाजम् देव हितम् सनेम इति ।
text_mt: [and] ‘The vajra onto the yokes for him, he alone went; may we win the god-given prize’ (ā dhūrṣv asmai vajram eko ayā vājam devahitam sanema).
Those are twenty-one Dvipadās; [he recites] them quarter-verse by quarter-verse.

sanskrit_iast: atha etad aindrāgnam sūktam gāyatrī śaṃsam śaṃsati indra agnī yuvam su na iti |
meaning: अथ एतद् ऐन्द्राग्नम् सूक्तम् गायत्री शंसम् शंसति इन्द्र अग्नी युवम् सु न इति ।
text_mt: Then he recites this hymn to Indra and Agni with the Gāyatrī-recitation: ‘O Indra and Agni, you two well to us’ (indrāgnī yuvaṃ su naḥ).

sanskrit_iast: tasya dvitīyā sapta padā tasyā anuṣṭubham pūrvām karoti śaṃsam gāyatrīm uttarām |
meaning: तस्य द्वितीया सप्त पदा तस्या अनुष्टुभम् पूर्वाम् करोति शंसम् गायत्रीम् उत्तराम् ।
text_mt: Its second [verse] has seven quarters; he makes the prior recitation an Anuṣṭubh and the subsequent one a Gāyatrī.
The final [verse] is a Triṣṭubh; [he recites] that quarter-verse by quarter-verse.
Then he recites this insertion:

sanskrit_iast: tubhya idam indra pari ṣicyate madhv ity ekā |
meaning: तुभ्य इदम् इन्द्र परि षिच्यते मध्व् इत्य् एका ।
text_mt: ‘For you, O Indra, this sweet [soma] is poured out around’ (tubhyedam indra pari ṣicyate madhu) is one verse;

sanskrit_iast: viśvajite dhana jite svar jita iti ṣaṭ |
meaning: विश्वजिते धन जिते स्वर् जित इति षट् ।
text_mt: ‘To the all-conquering, prize-conquering, realm-conquering’ (viśvajite dhanajite svarjite) consists of six;

sanskrit_iast: svādor itthā viṣūvata iti pāṅktam tṛcam tat paṅkti śaṃsam |
meaning: स्वादोर् इत्था विषूवत इति पाङ्क्तम् तृचम् तत् पङ्क्ति शंसम् ।
text_mt: ‘Of the sweet, indeed, of the solstice’ (svādor itthā viṣūvataḥ) is a triplet in Paṅkti metre; [he recites] that with the Paṅkti-recitation.

sanskrit_iast: pra vo mahe mahivṛdhe bharadhvam iti vairājam tṛcam tad ardharcaśaḥ |
meaning: प्र वो महे महिवृधे भरध्वम् इति वैराजम् तृचम् तद् अर्धर्चशः ।
text_mt: ‘Offer to the great one who increases greatness’ (pra vo mahe mahivṛdhe bharadhvam) is a triplet in Vairāja metre; [he recites] that by half-verses.

sanskrit_iast: praty asmai pipīṣata ity ānuṣṭubham tṛcam tad ardharcaśaḥ |
meaning: प्रत्य् अस्मै पिपीषत इत्य् आनुष्टुभम् तृचम् तद् अर्धर्चशः ।
text_mt: ‘To him who desires to drink’ (praty asmai pipīṣate) is a triplet in Anuṣṭubh metre; [he recites] that by half-verses.
Then he recites this collection of Anuṣṭubhs:

sanskrit_iast: ehi stomān abhi svara iti nava |
meaning: एहि स्तोमान् अभि स्वर इति नव ।
text_mt: ‘Come, greet the praises’ (ehi stomān abhi svara) consists of nine;
‘All [chants] have magnified Indra’ (indraṃ viśvā avīvṛdhan) consists of eight;

sanskrit_iast: asāvi soma indra ta iti ṣaṭ | ā nas te gantu matsara iti catasraḥ |
meaning: असावि सोम इन्द्र त इति षट् । आ नस् ते गन्तु मत्सर इति चतस्रः ।
text_mt: ‘Soma has been pressed, O Indra, for you’ (asāvi soma indra te) consists of six; ‘Let your exhilarating [drop] come to us’ (ā nas te gantu matsaraḥ) consists of four;

sanskrit_iast: matsi no vasya iṣṭaya iti pañca |
meaning: मत्सि नो वस्य इष्टय इति पञ्च ।
text_mt: ‘Exhilarate us for the seeking of wealth’ (matsi no vasya iṣṭaye) consists of five;

sanskrit_iast: yas te sādhiṣṭho avasa iti sapta |
meaning: यस् ते साधिष्ठो अवस इति सप्त ।
text_mt: ‘Which is your most effective [aid] for protection’ (yas te sādhiṣṭho avase) consists of seven;

sanskrit_iast: uroṣ ṭa indra rādhasa iti dve |
meaning: उरोष् ट इन्द्र राधस इति द्वे ।
text_mt: ‘Broad is your bounty, O Indra’ (uroṣ ṭa indra rādhasaḥ) consists of two;

sanskrit_iast: yad indra citra mehana iti cataraḥ |
meaning: यद् इन्द्र चित्र मेहन इति चतरः ।
text_mt: ‘O Indra of wonderful gifts’ (yad indra citra mehanā) consists of four;
‘He who is wealthy, most wealthy’ (yo rayivo rayiṃtamaḥ) consists of six;

sanskrit_iast: ā indra yāhi haribhir iti pañcadaśa |
meaning: आ इन्द्र याहि हरिभिर् इति पञ्चदश ।
text_mt: ‘Come, O Indra, with your bay steeds’ (endra yāhi haribhiḥ) consists of fifteen;
‘As of old, the increaser of poets’ (sa pratnathā kavivṛdhaḥ) is a triplet;
‘When you were born peerless’ (yaj jāyathā apūrvya) consists of two;

sanskrit_iast: ā tvā giro rathīr iva iti sarvam |
meaning: आ त्वा गिरो रथीर् इव इति सर्वम् ।
text_mt: ‘To you the songs, like a charioteer’ (ā tvā giro rathīr iva) is recited entirely;

sanskrit_iast: śāsa itthā mahān asi iti sarvam |
meaning: शास इत्था महान् असि इति सर्वम् ।
text_mt: ‘Direct thus, you are great’ (śāsā itthā mahān asi) is recited entirely;
Then he recites this century of Triṣṭubh verses:

sanskrit_iast: adhvaryavo bharata indrāya somam iti ca |
meaning: अध्वर्यवो भरत इन्द्राय सोमम् इति च ।
text_mt: and [the hymn] ‘Bring soma, O Adhvaryus, to Indra’ (adhvaryavo bharatendrāya somam);

sanskrit_iast: ā yāhy arvān upa vandhureṣṭhā yudhmasya te vṛṣabhasya svarāja iti sūkte |
meaning: आ याह्य् अर्वान् उप वन्धुरेष्ठा युध्मस्य ते वृषभस्य स्वराज इति सूक्ते ।
text_mt: the two hymns: ‘Come hitherward, standing on the chariot seat’ (ā yāhy arvāṅ upa vandhureṣṭhāḥ) and ‘Of your bull-like, belligerent sovereign’ (yudhmasya te vṛṣabhasya svarājaḥ);

sanskrit_iast: nṛṇām u tvā nṛtamam gīrbhir ukthair iti tṛcam |
meaning: नृणाम् उ त्वा नृतमम् गीर्भिर् उक्थैर् इति तृचम् ।
text_mt: the triplet: ‘You, the most manly of men, with songs and chants’ (nṝṇām u tvā nṛtamaṃ gīrbhir ukthaiḥ);

sanskrit_iast: ā satyo yātu maghavān ṛjīṣī iti sarvam |
meaning: आ सत्यो यातु मघवान् ऋजीषी इति सर्वम् ।
text_mt: ‘Let the truthful Maghavan who drinks the dregs come’ (ā satyo yātu maghavān ṛjīṣī) is recited entirely;

sanskrit_iast: yoniṣ ṭa indra sadane akāry ud u brahmāṇi iti sūkte |
meaning: योनिष् ट इन्द्र सदने अकार्य् उद् उ ब्रह्माणि इति सूक्ते ।
text_mt: [and] the two hymns: ‘A seat has been prepared for you, O Indra, in the dwelling’ (yoniṣ ṭa indra sadane akāri) and ‘Up the sacred utterances’ (ud u brahmāṇi).

sanskrit_iast: tatra purastād ud brahmīyasya pada anuṣaṅgān śaṃsati yo vyatīṃr aphāṇayad ity etasmiṃs tṛce prathamāyā ardharcam uktvā uparamati |
meaning: तत्र पुरस्ताद् उद् ब्रह्मीयस्य पद अनुषङ्गान् शंसति यो व्यतींर् अफाणयद् इत्य् एतस्मिंस् तृचे प्रथमाया अर्धर्चम् उक्त्वा उपरमति ।
text_mt: There, before the Ud-brahmīya, he recites the verse-quarter intertwinings: in the tṛca 'yo vyatīṁr aphāṇayat', having recited the half-verse of the first [verse], he pauses.

sanskrit_iast: atha prathamāyai tṛtīyena padena dvitīyāyai prathamam padam upasaṃdhāya praṇauti |
meaning: अथ प्रथमायै तृतीयेन पदेन द्वितीयायै प्रथमम् पदम् उपसंधाय प्रणौति ।
text_mt: Then, having joined the first quarter of the second [verse] to the third quarter of the first, he recites the praṇava.

sanskrit_iast: atha prathamāyā uttamena padena dvitīyāyai dvitīyam padam upasaṃdhāya avasyati |
meaning: अथ प्रथमाया उत्तमेन पदेन द्वितीयायै द्वितीयम् पदम् उपसंधाय अवस्यति ।
text_mt: Then, having joined the second quarter of the second [verse] to the last quarter of the first, he stops.

sanskrit_iast: atha dvitīyāyai tṛtīyena padena uttamāyai pathamam padam upasaṃdhāya praṇauti |
meaning: अथ द्वितीयायै तृतीयेन पदेन उत्तमायै पथमम् पदम् उपसंधाय प्रणौति ।
text_mt: Then, having joined the first quarter of the last [verse] to the third quarter of the second, he recites the praṇava.

sanskrit_iast: atha dvitīyāyā uttamena padena uttamāyai dvitīyam padam upasaṃdhāya avasyati |
meaning: अथ द्वितीयाया उत्तमेन पदेन उत्तमायै द्वितीयम् पदम् उपसंधाय अवस्यति ।
text_mt: Then, having joined the second quarter of the last [verse] to the last quarter of the second, he stops.
Then what remains is [recited] by half-verses; with that he recites the praṇava.

sanskrit_iast: atho ud brahmīyasya uttamām pariśiṣya āhvayate |
meaning: अथो उद् ब्रह्मीयस्य उत्तमाम् परिशिष्य आह्वयते ।
text_mt: Then, leaving aside the final [verse] of the Ud-brahmīya, he utters the call.
He concludes with [that verse] recited three times.

sanskrit_iast: paridhāya uktha vīryam japaty aikāhikam pūrvam māhāvratikam uttaram mahad asi yaśo asi bhargo asi bhogo asi bhuñjad asi mama bhogāya bhava iti |
meaning: परिधाय उक्थ वीर्यम् जपत्य् ऐकाहिकम् पूर्वम् माहाव्रतिकम् उत्तरम् महद् असि यशो असि भर्गो असि भोगो असि भुञ्जद् असि मम भोगाय भव इति ।
text_mt: Having concluded, he mutters the power of the uktha: first the one for the single-day rite, then the Mahāvrata one: 'Great art thou, glory art thou, radiance art thou, enjoyment art thou, enjoying art thou; be thou for my enjoyment'.

sanskrit_iast: tad etat sakṛt śastāyām sūda dohasi yāvat śastram upasarjanyām saṃkhyāyamānāyām ṛte tūṣṇīm śaṃsam bṛhatī sahasram sampadyate |
meaning: तद् एतत् सकृत् शस्तायाम् सूद दोहसि यावत् शस्त्रम् उपसर्जन्याम् संख्यायमानायाम् ऋते तूष्णीम् शंसम् बृहती सहस्रम् सम्पद्यते ।
text_mt: This recitation, when the Sūdadohas is recited once and the appended verse is counted, without the silent recitation, amounts to one thousand bṛhatī verses.
for the stotriya, for the nivid, [and] for the concluding verse.
Even while the secondary vaṣaṭ-call has not been made, they untie the swing.
As [the Adhvaryu] approaches holding the cup, he steps down towards the east.
He pushes the swing-board away to the west.

sanskrit_iast: parāmṛśan graham japati yad imam prajayam prājaiṣam tam anvasāni iti |
meaning: परामृशन् ग्रहम् जपति यद् इमम् प्रजयम् प्राजैषम् तम् अन्वसानि इति ।
text_mt: Touching the cup, he mutters: 'That offspring which I have won, may I pursue that'.
